IDE是集成开发环境，CLI是命令行界面，UI是用户界面，DOM是网页文档的结构.en: IDE is the integrated development environment, CLI the command-line interface, UI the user interface, and DOM the tree of structural objects of a web document. The code, selection and page information that each entry point attaches automatically can differ.<span class="concept-micro">The model seeing the selected function in the IDE does not mean the same task in the CLI has received that function; check this turn's input objects first.

程序之间约定输入、输出与行为的接口。 例：不是人类界面的按钮本身。.en: An interface on which programs agree about input, output and behavior. Example: not the buttons of a human interface themselves.

Schema是一份字段和类型等结构规则；结构化输出机制让模型更容易返回符合规则的.en: A schema is a set of structural rules about fields, types and the like; a structured-output mechanism makes it easier for the model to return data that follows those rules. Valid fields still do not mean that the target file exists, that access has been granted, or that the request is right for the business.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: path is required to be a string; {"path":3} does not match the type rule, and {"path":"missing.py"} follows the structure yet may still find no file.

JSON：结构化文本，不是执行动作.en: JSON: structured text, not an action being executed

JSON是一种用对象、数组、字符串、数字等表达数据的文本格式。花括号对象把字段名.en: JSON is a text format that expresses data as objects, arrays, strings, numbers and so on. A braced object maps field names to values; a bracketed array keeps the order of its items. Parsing JSON only yields data; it does not automatically run a tool name inside it.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: {"path":"a.py","limit":3} has two fields; "3" is a string while 3 is a number, and a schema can require either one.

对数据字段及类型等结构的约束描述。 例：path是字符串，不表示可以读取任意路径.en: A description of the constraints on the structure of data — fields, types and the like. Example: path being a string does not mean any path may be read.

表达对象、数组、字符串、数值等结构化数据的文本格式。 例：合法JSON不保证字段.en: A text format that expresses structured data such as objects, arrays, strings and numbers. Example: valid JSON does not guarantee that the field contents are valid for the business.

按输入编号取出对应可学习向量的参数表及操作。 例：E形状[6,4]，编号2取E的.en: The parameter table, and the operation on it, that takes out the learnable vector for an input ID. Example: E has shape [6,4], and ID 2 takes row 2 of E.

通用处理器，适合多种控制和数值任务。 例：本包基础实验使用CPU与Python标.en: A general-purpose processor, suited to many kinds of control and numeric work. Example: the basic experiments in this package use the CPU and the Python standard library.

适合大规模并行数值运算的处理器。 例：数据搬到GPU不改变编号语义，但消耗时间和.en: A processor suited to large-scale parallel numeric computation. Example: moving data to the GPU does not change what the IDs mean, but it costs time and VRAM.

Patch、图像通道与视觉投影.en: Patch, image channels and the visual projection

图像中的patch是切分的小块，RGB是红绿蓝3个通道；软件工程中的patch则.en: A patch in an image is a small block cut out of it, and RGB is the 3 channels red, green and blue; a patch in software engineering is a code patch — the same word for both. An image block, once flattened, can become a vector through a learnable transformation; it is not a lookup in a text vocabulary.<span class="concept-micro">Independent image example: one 16×16×3 block holds 768 numbers, and after projection it can become d features. d is fixed by the model design.

模型接到的是一份请求，不是整个工作区.en: What the model receives is one request, not the whole workspace

各行是独立对象或条件的对照，不暗示上一行的结果自动进入下一行。.en: Each row is a comparison of an independent object or condition; it does not imply that the row above feeds into the one below.

怎样把图中的变化读明白.en: How to read the changes in the figure

。本例数字和宿主场景为明确给定的教学设定，不是商业模型输出或生产性能测量。.en: . The numbers and host setting in this example are an explicitly given teaching construction, not commercial model output or a production performance measurement.

。示例输入和场景由本书明确设定。.en: . The example input and setting are stated explicitly by this book.

按模型配套规则把文本与Token编号相互转换的工具。 例：不能随意换分词器而保留.en: A tool that converts between text and token IDs under the rules that go with a model. Example: you cannot swap in another tokenizer at will and keep incompatible model parameters.

把Unicode字符编码为变长字节序列的一种规则。 例：网络分片可能切在一个汉字.en: A rule for encoding Unicode characters as a variable-length byte sequence. Example: a network fragment may cut in the middle of the bytes of one Chinese character.

BPE的合并次序，决定后面还能合并什么.en: The merge order in BPE decides what can still be merged later

本例条件：</strong>独立教学编码器：初始符号为a、b、c；合并优先级固定.en: Conditions for this example: an independent teaching encoder: the initial symbols are a, b and c; the merge priority is fixed as ①(a,b)→ab and ②(ab,c)→abc; the vocabulary gives abc the ID 7. This is not an actual Chinese tokenizer.

编码时执行的既定规则顺序。.en: The fixed order of rules applied when encoding.

只有当前序列中紧挨着的两项才可合并。.en: Only two items immediately next to each other in the current sequence may be merged.

合并完成后查到的词表编号。.en: The vocabulary ID looked up once the merges are done.

放大图解：BPE的合并次序，决定后面还能合并什么.en: Enlarged figure: BPE's merge order decides what can still be merged later

本图仅使用当前算例声明的输入；具体公式、来源和边界见紧邻正文。.en: This figure uses only the input declared for the current worked example; the formulas, sources and limits are given in the adjacent text.

本图使用的数据与条件.en: The data and conditions used in this figure

①可用；②尚无ab.en: ① applies; there is no ab yet

编号不由字符代码相加而来.en: An ID does not come from adding up character codes

先看第三列：规则②在第一行无法执行，因为当时只有a和b，没有符号ab。第一步改变.en: Look at the third column first: rule ② cannot run on the first row, because at that point there were only a and b, and no symbol ab. The first step changed what the next step had to choose from.

输出[7]含一个Token，但原文字仍有三个字符。Token数和字符数因此不是同.en: The output [7] holds one token, but the original text still has three characters. Token count and character count are therefore not the same count.

训练分词器时才统计语料、学习规则；这次编码只执行规则，不因为新输入而临时重训练。.en: The corpus is counted and the rules learned only when the tokenizer is trained; this encoding merely applies the rules, and does not retrain on the fly because the input is new.

不要混淆：</strong>若改为只有(b,c)→bc，则同一abc得到[a,b.en: Do not conflate: if the only rule were (b,c)→bc, the same abc would give [a,bc]. That is a comparison with a different encoder, and must not be passed off as a later step of the previous one.

模板已经加了BOS，再分词一次为什么会悄悄改变任务？.en: The template has already added BOS — so why does tokenizing once more quietly change the task?

本地观察与复核入口.en: Local observation and re-checking entry points

以下为随包程序实际运行记录。数值算子、临时文件／数据库实验与教学逻辑模拟各自的范.en: What follows is the actual run record of the programs shipped with this book. The scope of the numeric operators, the temporary-file and database experiments, and the teaching logic simulations is noted item by item on the experiment pages; none of it supports a claim that a commercial model or a production environment has been tested.

实验记录：字段与原值.en: Experiment record: fields and original values

这里是实际实验记录，不用条长或箭头伪装成额外证据；完整日志与解释仍保留在本节。.en: These are actual experiment records; bar length and arrows are not used to pass themselves off as extra evidence, and the full log and explanation stay in this section.

本图整理的是本小节已有的局部实验记录，不把通过局部测试扩展为产品在所有环境下可靠.en: This figure collects the local experiment records already present in this subsection; it does not extend passing a local test into a claim that the product is reliable in every environment. The original test environment, inputs and complete output remain as recorded in this section.

本条全部结果、验证范围与完整代码 →.en: All results for this item, the scope of verification, and the full code →

事实、推导与实验的边界.en: The boundary between fact, derivation and experiment

计算查询与可读候选的匹配份额，再加权组合内容。 例：先计算分数和权重，再用权重混.en: Compute the matching shares between the query and the readable candidates, then combine the content by those weights. Example: compute the scores and the weights first, then mix V with the weights.

在授权场景，OAuth使应用能按授权取得访问凭据；scope声明一类访问范围，资.en: In an authorization setting, OAuth lets an application obtain access credentials according to what was granted; a scope declares one class of access range, and the resource service should still check the specific permission. In a memory or task setting, scope can instead mean only the range over which something applies, and must not be conflated with a login credential.<span class="concept-micro">Being granted "read the calendar" is not being granted the deletion of every event; a successful connection is no proof that an operation was approved.

授权协议与获准操作的范围。 例：获准读日历，不等于获准删除事件。.en: The authorization agreement and the range of operations it grants. Example: permission to read the calendar is not permission to delete events.

指令优先级与执行权限是两道独立的门.en: Instruction priority and execution permission are two separate gates

根据任务与观察调用模型和工具、持续推进的执行系统。 例：不只是一次写得很长的Pr.en: An execution system that calls the model and tools according to the task and what it observes, and keeps the work moving. Example: not just one very long prompt.

规定哪些位置的预测误差计入训练目标。 例：用户文本可被读取，但可不直接计算该段输.en: Specifies which positions' prediction errors count towards the training objective. Example: the user's text can be read, yet the loss need not be computed on that stretch of output.

规定哪些位置间的读取被允许的约束。 例：接口可能用布尔值或加性负无穷，真假约定要.en: The constraint that states which positions may be read from which. Example: an interface may use booleans or an additive negative infinity, so the true/false convention has to be checked.

DPR常表示设备像素与CSS像素的比例；DPI表示每英寸的点数。截图像素、界面逻.en: DPR usually means the ratio of device pixels to CSS pixels; DPI means dots per inch. Screenshot pixels, the interface's logical coordinates and screen coordinates need not share a unit, and there may also be scaling, cropping and offsets.<span class="concept-micro">In an independent example where DPR=2 is stated and the other mappings agree, a CSS x-coordinate of 100 corresponds to 200 device pixels; this conditional relationship cannot be carried straight over to every screenshot.

某Token在对应词表中的整数地址。 例：[1,2,3]先是编号列表，不是三个语.en: A token's integer address in the matching vocabulary. Example: [1,2,3] is first of all a list of IDs, not three semantic strengths.

输出投影给各词表候选的未归一化分数。 例：可以是负数，还不是概率或Token编号.en: The unnormalized score the output projection gives each vocabulary candidate. Example: it can be negative, and it is not yet a probability or a token ID.

Wout、LM head：词表打分参数.en: Wout, LM head: the vocabulary scoring parameters

把最后隐藏表示转换为每个词表候选分数的参数层。输入宽度d，词表有Vocab项，右.en: The parameter layer that turns the final hidden representation into a score for every vocabulary candidate. The input width is d, the vocabulary has Vocab entries, and the right-multiplied parameter shape is [d,Vocab]. Producing probabilities means normalizing these scores as well.<span class="concept-micro">Attention's Wo outputs hidden features; Wout outputs scores over vocabulary candidates. Both names contain "output", but what they output is different.

将各分数取指数，再除以所有指数之和。 例：分数[2,1,0]经Softmax后约.en: Take the exponential of each score, then divide by the sum of all the exponentials. Example: the scores [2,1,0] after Softmax are about [0.6652,0.2447,0.0900].

四种“向量”，按坐标含义而不是外形区分.en: Four kinds of "vector", told apart by what the coordinates mean rather than by how they look

本例条件：</strong>沿用教学词表中的“爱”编号2：E[2]=[-0.3,.en: Conditions for this example: ID 2 for "love" in the teaching vocabulary is reused: E[2]=[-0.3,0.8,0.1,0.5]. The hidden state and output head below are independent small examples; it is not claimed that they are computed in full from this four-dimensional embedding.

一处位置的一排特征。.en: One row of features for one position.

每个词表候选的分数，坐标对应候选。.en: A score for every vocabulary candidate, with each coordinate corresponding to a candidate.

为了比较查询与资料而训练或聚合得到的表示。.en: A representation trained or aggregated in order to compare a query with material.

坐标到底指什么.en: What the coordinates actually refer to

整段资料的一份表示.en: One representation of a whole passage of material

第二行和第四行虽然都写成两个数，语义也不同：一个对应某个位置，一个对应整段材料。.en: Rows two and four are both written as two numbers, yet they mean different things: one belongs to a single position, the other to a whole passage of material. The same shape is no guarantee of interchangeability.

第三行把特征坐标换成候选坐标；softmax只能把这些候选分数变成下一项分布，不.en: The third row changes feature coordinates into candidate coordinates; softmax can only turn these candidate scores into a distribution over the next item, and cannot read an arbitrary intermediate vector directly as vocabulary probabilities.

检索是否有用要看训练目标及聚合方式，不能只因向量来自某个大模型就假定适合余弦检索.en: Whether retrieval is useful depends on the training objective and the aggregation method; a vector must not be assumed suitable for cosine retrieval merely because it comes from some large model.

不要混淆：</strong>把四维Embedding直接送到一个只接受二维向量的.en: Do not conflate: feeding a four-dimensional embedding straight into an index that only accepts two-dimensional vectors is a shape error; and even padded to the same dimension, the semantic spaces may still not match.

新增Token、绑定输出头与优化器：为什么“能查到”还不等于“能学会”？.en: Adding tokens, binding the output head and the optimiser: why does "it can be looked up" not yet mean "it can be learned"?

记录保存在本机浏览器。.en: Records are kept in this browser.

继续阅读与机制对应.en: Continue reading, matched to the mechanism

What does attention actually compute?Why we still cannot say "training is done" at this pointWhich steps mix positions and which only mix featuresThe whole chain seen from one positionGoing from one layer to many: what exactly is addedWhy training can compute five positions at onceChecking whether the forward pass is really understoodQ075｜Why divide by √d? Why softmax? Why must the maximum be subtracted for numerical stability?Q076｜Why does a layer need residuals, Norm and an FFN as well as attention?Not assembling different architectures into a "standard model" that does not existMultiple heads: what is split is not the sentence but the feature subspaceWhat GQA sharesRoPE: rotating inside Q/K, and why that can express relative positionSwiGLU: not just a new activation name for the FFNWhere changes to Norm, dropout, weight sharing and the like pull onFrom this page's explanation to an implementation you can check

Query、Key、Value：三种中间数值表示.en: Query, Key, Value: three intermediate numeric representations

q是接收信息的一行查询表示；k是可读位置提供的一行匹配表示；v是该位置供混合的一.en: q is one row of query representation for the position receiving information; k is one row of matching representation offered by a readable position; v is one row of content representation that position contributes to the mix. Capital Q/K/V collect several rows into tables. They are computed from the input and the parameters, and they carry the separate jobs of scoring and of supplying content.<span class="concept-micro">One q dotted with two k gives two scores; softmax turns them into two shares; those shares multiply the two rows of v, and the results are added. Nothing here generates a search term, and nothing here picks an answer directly.

SwiGLU、Wg/Wu/Wd：两路变换再合成.en: SwiGLU, Wg/Wu/Wd: two transformation paths, then combined

这是门控前馈结构。Wg生成要过SiLU的一路，Wu生成另一条内容路径，两路逐元素.en: This is a gated feed-forward structure. Wg produces the path that goes through SiLU, Wu produces the other content path, the two are multiplied element by element, and Wd maps the result back to the original width. These Ws are three sets of parameters, not three agents.<span class="concept-micro">To read (SiLU(XWg)⊙XWu)Wd, compute XWg and XWu first, then SiLU, then ⊙, and finally multiply by Wd. Every position uses the same set of parameters independently.

Norm、LayerNorm、RMSNorm：不是概率归一化.en: Norm, LayerNorm, RMSNorm: not a probability normalization

Norm在层公式中表示一个规范化函数。LayerNorm通常按一个Token的特.en: In a layer formula, Norm stands for a normalizing function. LayerNorm usually subtracts the mean over one token's features, divides by the standard deviation, then scales and shifts; RMSNorm usually does not subtract the mean and scales by the root mean square. Neither of them is softmax.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example, ignoring the small positive ε that stabilises the denominator and the learnable scaling: LayerNorm([1,3])=[-1,1]; RMSNorm([1,3])=[1/√5,3/√5].

pre-norm是先规范化再进入子层，残差从原输入直接相加；post-norm是.en: pre-norm normalizes first and then enters the sub-layer, with the residual added straight from the original input; post-norm adds the sub-layer result to the original input and normalizes after that. This describes the order of operations, not two phases before and after training.<span class="concept-micro">Independent structural comparison: x+F(Norm(x)) and Norm(x+F(x)) are not generally equal. F stands for the sub-layer function being wrapped here.

归一化放在子层变换之前或残差之后的结构安排。 例：不同结构的梯度与数值行为不能只.en: The structural arrangement that puts normalization before the sublayer transform or after the residual. Example: the gradient and numeric behavior of the two arrangements cannot be judged from the module name alone.

通过按位置旋转成对坐标来引入位置信息的方法。 例：二维90度旋转把[2,3]变为.en: A method that introduces positional information by rotating pairs of coordinates according to position. Example: a 90-degree rotation in two dimensions turns [2,3] into [-3,2].

以一个分支产生的值调节另一个分支输出的前馈结构。 例：不是“挑一个词通过”，而是.en: A feed-forward structure in which the values produced by one branch modulate the output of the other. Example: it does not "let one word through", it modulates value by value.

本章可以分成两种动作：同一位置内部改变特征，与不同位置之间混合信息。X乘参数表属.en: This chapter can be divided into two kinds of action: changing features inside one position, and mixing information between different positions. X times a parameter table belongs to the first; attention shares times V belong to the second. Point out "input data", "parameters" and "this step's result" in the figure below before reading the multi-layer formulas, so that W and Q/K/V are not taken for the same kind of thing.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F11.html\">Q/.en: Related step-by-step process: Q/K/V: first compute where to read from, then how much to read in. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F07.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 42 · Matrix multiplication is like filling in a recipe result cell by cellLesson 49 · A Transformer layer is not attention aloneLesson 57 · How one input connects to prediction, all the way to the end

MHA、MQA、GQA：头怎样共享.en: MHA, MQA, GQA: how heads are shared

一个注意力头是一套匹配并聚合内容的路径。MHA常让每个Query头有自己的K/V.en: An attention head is one path that matches and then aggregates content. MHA usually gives every query head its own K/V head; MQA has several query heads share one group of K/V; GQA sits between them, sharing by group. These are structural choices, not a switch to be flipped at run time.<span class="concept-micro">Independent shape example: 8 query heads and 2 K/V heads, grouped evenly, means every 4 query heads share 1 group of K/V; the cache is accounted for by the number of K/V heads.

每个可读位置将被加权汇集的内容表示。 例：这里V不是词表大小。.en: The content representation at each readable position that will be pooled by weight. Example: V here is not the vocabulary size.

不同查询头与K/V头共享方式的注意力结构。 例：共享更多K/V可减少缓存，但不保.en: Attention structures that differ in how query heads and K/V heads are shared. Example: sharing more K/V can reduce the cache, but it does not guarantee identical quality.

通常在每个位置应用的前馈子网络。 例：常把宽度先扩展再缩回，带非线性或门控。.en: A feed-forward sub-network usually applied at every position. Example: it often widens first and then narrows back, with a nonlinearity or a gate.

一次前向中，哪些步骤混合位置，哪些只混合特征.en: In one forward pass, which steps mix positions and which mix only features

本例条件：</strong>本图只追踪单样本、3个Token、每位置4个特征的形.en: Conditions for this example: this figure tracks only the shapes for a single sample, 3 tokens and 4 features per position. It uses one teaching Pre-Norm layer and omits bias and dropout; this is not the fixed arrangement of every Transformer.

有几处Token。.en: How many token positions there are.

每处有几个数。.en: How many numbers there are at each position.

把同形状分支结果加回主路。.en: Adds the branch result, of the same shape, back onto the main path.

只重组同一行特征.en: Only recombines the features within the same row

每格=一个查询对一个Key.en: Each cell = one query against one key

沿可见位置混合信息.en: Mixes information across the visible positions

回到主路宽度.en: Back to the width of the main path

各位置使用同一组参数.en: Every position uses the same set of parameters

沿着表第二列检查相邻操作能否相乘，再读第三列：很多投影都没有跨Token交换信息.en: Go down the table's second column to check whether adjacent operations can be multiplied, then read the third: many projections exchange no information across tokens.

真正把其他位置的信息搬进来的是权重乘V；矩阵乘法只是统一的计算工具，不同轴上的相.en: What actually brings in information from other positions is the weights times V; matrix multiplication is only a uniform computational tool, and multiplying along different axes means different things.

残差相加要求两边形状一致。扩宽到8是FFN的中间宽度，不能直接和4维主路相加。.en: Adding a residual requires the shapes on both sides to match. Widening to 8 is the FFN's intermediate width and cannot be added straight onto the 4-dimensional main path.

不要混淆：</strong>若把[3,3]权重误当3个词表候选，程序也许仍可做s.en: Do not conflate: if a [3,3] weight matrix is mistaken for 3 vocabulary candidates, the program may still run softmax, but the reading is already wrong: the columns here are input positions, not the output vocabulary.

一个两位置单层Decoder，从输入一直算到词表概率.en: A single-layer, two-position decoder, computed from the input all the way to vocabulary probabilities

输入与条件。</strong>采用教学pre-norm Decoder：X=.en: Input and conditions.A teaching pre-norm decoder is used: X=

；LayerNorm的ε=1e−5，γ=1、β=0；Wq=Wk=Wv=Wo=I；.en: ; LayerNorm has ε=1e−5, γ=1 and β=0; Wq=Wk=Wv=Wo=I; causal attention; FFN(z)=0.5×ReLU(z); then LayerNorm once more, multiplied by the vocabulary head

。不使用RoPE和bias。.en: . No RoPE and no bias are used.

逐行Norm，不跨位置.en: Norm row by row, never across positions

本例投影是单位矩阵.en: The projection in this example is the identity matrix

三者都等于归一化输入；这是为方便计算而选的特例。.en: All three equal the normalized input; this is a special case chosen to keep the arithmetic easy.

第1位置只能看自己，第2位置可看两处.en: Position 1 can only see itself; position 2 can see both

第2行权重约.en: The weights in row 2 are about

，加权输出约.en: , and the weighted output is about

把注意力输出加回原X.en: Add the attention output back onto the original X

ReLU与0.5缩放后约.en: after ReLU and the 0.5 scaling, about

最后Norm后乘词表头.en: After the final Norm, multiply by the vocabulary head

把过程连起来。</strong>模型内部每一个“层名”都对应一份实际新数组。词表.en: Join the steps up. Every "layer name" inside the model corresponds to an actual new array. The vocabulary probabilities appear after the final projection; attention weights do not turn into words directly.

边界与反例。</strong>全部数值来自随包程序同一条前向链，展示值经舍入；这.en: Limits and counterexamples. Every number comes from one and the same forward chain in the programs shipped with this book, and the displayed values are rounded; this is an untrained tiny structure, not the architecture or the output of any commercial model.

查看本例程序结果.en: See the program result for this example

Concat、split与chunk：拼接与拆分.en: Concat, split and chunk: joining and splitting

Concat把多份数组沿指定轴连接起来，不把元素相加；split或chunk按规.en: Concat joins several arrays along a chosen axis; it does not add their elements. split or chunk groups them at specified boundaries. Every axis that is not being joined has to be compatible. chunk here means a block of an array, whereas a chunk in networking is a slice of bytes.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: two heads of [2,3] each, joined along the feature axis, give [2,6]; joined along the position axis they would give [4,3], which already means something different.

展示值经过舍入；后续运算使用未舍入值。.en: Displayed values are rounded; later computation uses the unrounded values.

对应参数、前向及梯度记录.en: Matching parameters, forward pass and gradient records

本步实际变化.en: What actually changes at this step

从同一份X算三条支路，再得到一个具体输出.en: Compute three branches from the same X, then arrive at one concrete output

本例条件：</strong>独立两位置算例：X=[[1,0],[0,1]]；Wq.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-position calculation: X=[[1,0],[0,1]]; Wq=[[1,0],[1,1]], Wk is the identity matrix, Wv=[[2,0],[0,4]]. Only the causal attention at position 1 is computed, both positions are visible, and d_k=2.

固定的乘法系数表，本次前向不更新。.en: A fixed table of multiplication coefficients; it is not updated in this forward pass.

位置1从Wq支路得到的一排数。.en: The row of numbers position 1 gets from the Wq branch.

本次输入动态算出的值，不是参数表。.en: A value computed dynamically from this input, not a parameter table.

放大图解：从同一份X算三条支路，再得到一个具体输出.en: Enlarged figure: three branches computed from one X, then one concrete output

独立二维算例：同一个X的三次投影，与最后一行的混合.en: An independent two-dimensional calculation: three projections of the same X, and the mixing in the last row

两行数据或当前行.en: two rows of data, or the current row

下一步用途.en: What it is used for next

逐行与q₁点积.en: Dot product of each row with q₁

提供待混合的内容.en: Supplies the content to be mixed

仍是数值表示，不是文字.en: Still a numeric representation, not text

X第二行是[0,1]，所以乘Wq等于取Wq第二行[1,1]。这一步把“参数表”和.en: The second row of X is [0,1], so multiplying by Wq amounts to taking Wq's second row, [1,1]. This step links the "parameter table" to the "q computed this time".

q₁与两行K的点积都为1，缩放后仍相等，所以各占一半。并不是因为我们事先规定“各.en: The dot product of q₁ with both rows of K is 1, and scaling leaves them equal, so each takes half. It is not because we laid it down in advance that it should "read half from each".

份额决定怎么读，V决定读进来什么。只把Wv第二行改成[0,8]，Q/K和份额不变.en: The shares decide how to read; V decides what is read in. Change only the second row of Wv to [0,8] — Q/K and the shares stay the same, yet the output becomes [1,4].

不要混淆：</strong>这个单头微型例没有完整模型的多层、位置旋转与输出头；.en: Do not conflate: this single-head miniature example has none of a full model's many layers, positional rotation or output head; it demonstrates the division of labour and the arithmetic, not that the model understood what the sentence means.

局部核对例：以下输入以本例列出的条件为准，不能把它的中间值接到贯通模型的计算记录.en: Local check example: the input below follows the conditions listed for this example, and its intermediate values cannot be joined to the calculation record of the worked model.

投影两次、缩放两次、eval仍随机：同名Attention接口的三种陷阱.en: Projected twice, scaled twice, still random under eval: three traps in same-named Attention interfaces

数据/调用方向以图中连线为准；参数与激活、训练与推理分别标注。.en: The direction of data and calls is as drawn by the lines in the figure; parameters and activations, and training and inference, are labeled separately.

Mermaid源文件</a>。图的排布只表达数据／调用顺序，不代表计算耗时。.en: Mermaid source file. The layout of the figure expresses the order of data and calls only; it does not represent computation time.

Σ：按下标逐项求和.en: Σ: sum term by term over the subscript

Σ是加法的简写。下标指出哪项在变化；没有被求和的下标保持不变。它不是一个额外参数.en: Σ is shorthand for addition. The subscript says which term varies; a subscript that is not summed over stays fixed. It is not an extra parameter, and it does not mean concatenating arrays.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: Σᵢ xᵢyᵢ with x=[1,2] and y=[3,4] is just 1×3+2×4=11.

E、Π、∼、∝：概率式的常用记号.en: E, Π, ∼, ∝: common notation in probability expressions

x∼p表示按分布p抽样，E表示依指定分布求期望，Π表示把指定项连乘，∝表示相差一.en: x∼p means sampling from the distribution p, E means taking the expectation under the stated distribution, Π means multiplying the stated terms together, and ∝ means the two sides differ by a common factor rather than being equal already. Here E is not the embedding parameter table. <span class="concept-micro">Independent example: pᵢ∝exp(zᵢ) still has to be divided by the sum of the exponentials over all candidates; where ∝ is written, an unnormalised value must not be read straight off as a probability.

减最大值只换计算尺度，不改候选之间的概率.en: Subtracting the maximum only changes the scale of the computation, not the probabilities between the candidates

本例条件：</strong>沿用F09的候选A/B/C与分数[2,1,0]；不换.en: Conditions for this example: the candidates A/B/C and the scores [2,1,0] from F09 are reused; the input is unchanged, no temperature is applied and no candidate is truncated. Below, the direct computation and the stable computation are lined up term by term.

把分数转为正数的指数函数。.en: The exponential function that turns a score into a positive number.

当前全部候选的指数之和。.en: The sum of the exponentials of all the current candidates.

所有分数减去同一个常数。.en: The same constant is subtracted from every score.

放大图解：减最大值只换计算尺度，不改候选之间的概率.en: Enlarged figure: subtracting the maximum only changes the computational scale, not the probabilities among the candidates

同一组分数 [2,1,0]，从计算到抽样.en: One set of scores [2,1,0], from computation to sampling

除√d_k改变相对差值.en: Dividing by √d_k changes the relative differences

通常会改变概率，不能混称稳定平移.en: Usually changes the probabilities; it must not be lumped in as a stable shift

直接路线与稳定路线的每个指数都相差同一倍exp(2)，分母也相差同一倍，所以分子.en: Every exponential on the direct route differs from the one on the stable route by the same factor exp(2), and the denominator differs by that same factor, so numerator and denominator cancel together.

除√d_k不是给全部分数加减常数。它会缩小分数差，通常使分布不那么尖锐；这是另一.en: Dividing by √d_k is not adding or subtracting a constant across all the scores. It shrinks the differences between scores and usually makes the distribution less peaked; that is a different matter.

数值稳定仍有前提：一行若全是−∞，减最大值会出现−∞−(−∞)。应先处理“无可见.en: Numeric stability still has a precondition: if a whole row is −∞, subtracting the maximum produces −∞−(−∞). The case of "no visible Key" has to be handled first, rather than trusting that subtracting the maximum fixes everything.

不要混淆：</strong>直接用[2,1,0]/3得到[2/3,1/3,0]不.en: Do not conflate: taking [2,1,0]/3 to get [2/3,1/3,0] is not softmax; with negative scores it would also produce illegal negative probabilities.

给短序列增加占位项，使指定组织方式可用。 例：[4,2]右补齐为[4,2,0]。.en: Adds placeholder items to a short sequence so that the chosen arrangement can be used. Example: [4,2] right-padded becomes [4,2,0].

一整行都被遮住时，减最大值为什么仍救不了softmax？.en: When a whole row is masked out, why does subtracting the maximum still not save softmax?

∂L/∂w询问保持其他独立变量不变时，w小幅改变会让损失L怎样变化。多个参数的这.en: ∂L/∂w asks how the loss L changes when w changes a little while the other independent variables are held fixed. These rates of change across many parameters make up the gradient ∇L. They are derivative notation, not two ordinary numbers divided by each other.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: for L=w², the gradient at w=3 is 6. In the simplest update w←w−η×6, η is the learning rate.

Jacobian：多输出的导数表.en: Jacobian: the table of derivatives for several outputs

当函数有多个输入和输出，Jacobian用一张表记录每个输出对每个输入的偏导。J.en: When a function has several inputs and outputs, the Jacobian records in one table the partial derivative of every output with respect to every input. J_F denotes that table for the function F; it is not a new matrix in the training data.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: F([x₁,x₂])=[2x₁,3x₂], J_F=[[2,0],[0,3]]. The derivative table of the residual x+F(x) is I+J_F.

BatchNorm：跨样本统计不同于LayerNorm.en: BatchNorm: statistics across samples, unlike LayerNorm

BatchNorm常对同一特征/通道，沿批次和适用空间轴计算统计量；LayerN.en: BatchNorm usually computes its statistics for one feature or channel along the batch axis and the applicable spatial axes; LayerNorm computes along the feature dimensions designated inside one sample. BatchNorm may use statistics from different sources in training and in evaluation, and the details still depend on the configuration. <span class="concept-micro">The word Norm alone is no reason to mix up the statistics axes of different normalization layers; nor should two independent users come to share one session context because of it.

通常对每位置的特征计算均值方差并标准化，再用可学习尺度偏移。 例：[1,3]忽略.en: Usually the mean and variance of each position's features are computed and the features standardised, then a learnable scale and shift are applied. Example: ignoring epsilon, [1,3] standardises to [-1,1].

一起组织计算的一组输入。 例：普通样本batch不让不同用户相互读取内容。.en: A group of inputs organized for computation together. Example: an ordinary sample batch does not let different users read each other's content.

逐元素乘把形状对齐后的同位置数相乘，不沿某个维度再求和。公式的并排矩阵或@通常表.en: Elementwise multiplication multiplies the numbers at the same position once the shapes are aligned; it does not then sum along any dimension. Matrices written side by side in a formula, or @, usually mean matrix multiplication, and the two are not interchangeable.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: [1,2]⊙[3,4]=[3,8], whereas the dot product is 11. The ⊙ in a gated feed-forward network modulates one path with the other, feature by feature.

SiLU：输入乘一份门控系数.en: SiLU: the input times a gating coefficient

SiLU(x)=x×sigmoid(x)。先把x映射到0与1之间，再乘回x本身，.en: SiLU(x)=x×sigmoid(x). The input is first mapped to between 0 and 1, then multiplied back by x itself, which makes it nonlinear. Negative numbers do not all become 0 as they do with ReLU.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: SiLU(0)=0; SiLU(1) is about 0.731059; SiLU(-1) is about -0.268941.

σ：看清函数符号与统计量.en: σ: tell the function symbol from the statistic

在σ(XW+b)中，σ常泛指这一层选定的非线性函数；具体可以是ReLU等，不能仅.en: In σ(XW+b), σ usually stands for whatever nonlinear function this layer has chosen; it may be ReLU or another, and σ alone does not make it a sigmoid. In statistical formulas σ usually means the standard deviation and σ² the variance. They are not the same object.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: if σ is specified as ReLU, σ(-1)=0; if it is specified as sigmoid, the value is about 0.268941. The function has to be defined before any result can be computed.

MoE是包含多套子网络的模型结构；路由器为当前Token表示选择或加权少数专家。.en: MoE is a model structure that contains several sub-networks; the router selects or weights a few experts for the current token's representation. An expert is usually a numeric sub-network, not a chat agent given a prompt such as "maths teacher".<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: with 4 experts and 2 chosen per token, one pass activates only 2 of the expert paths; the parameters and routing state that the model design requires still have to be stored.

根据输入选择部分专家子网络参与计算的架构。 例：总参数与本次激活参数分开统计。.en: An architecture that selects part of its expert sub-networks to take part in the computation, according to the input. Example: total parameters and the parameters activated this time are counted separately.

残差、归一化和FFN，不是重复做一次Attention.en: The residual, normalization and the FFN are not attention done over again

各个轴分别有多长，不是数据内容。 例：内容[[1,2],[3,4]]的形状是[2.en: How long each axis is, not what the data contains. Example: the content [[1,2],[3,4]] has shape [2,2].

连续数值案例：<a href=\"../worked-model.html\">.en: Continuous numeric case: Take the same two sentences all the way from embedding to output probabilities, then verify the KV cache. Best read after finishing lessons 35—58.

适用边界：贯通模型只执行随包配置中的结构；本节对后训练或现代结构的说明依据<a.en: Limits of use: the worked model only runs the structure in the configuration shipped with this book. What this section says about post-training or modern structures rests on the corresponding original papers and official interface material, and does not mean the local training has already implemented those extensions.

从本页解释到可检查的实现.en: From the explanation on this page to an implementation you can inspect

固定的一层四维教学模型；不是任何商业模型的完整实现。.en: A fixed one-layer, four-dimensional teaching model; not a complete implementation of any commercial model.

使用同一已保存权重，不使用PyTorch；用于复算而非另行训练。.en: Uses the same saved weights and no PyTorch; it is for recomputing, not for training again.

错误是否能被发现.en: Whether the error can be caught

因果性、梯度、标签移位、缓存位置均有正向检查和反例。.en: Causality, gradients, label shift and cache position each have a positive check and a counterexample.

所有参数均可查看；初值不等于训练后的参数。.en: Every parameter can be inspected; the initial values are not the parameters after training.

仅来自本地CPU微型实验；不能推出商业能力或GPU性能。.en: From a tiny local CPU experiment only; no conclusion about commercial capability or GPU performance follows from it.

run.json 对应的数值记录.en: The matching numeric record in run.json

先在可见性表里选一个查询行，决定哪些Key位置允许参与；再看如何缩放和混合。多头.en: First pick one query row in the visibility table to decide which key positions may take part, then look at how things are scaled and mixed. Multiple heads change how the representation is grouped, position rotation changes how Q and K compare, and backpropagation computes the effect of the parameters; the three are not the same step.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F12.html\">Ma.en: Related step-by-step process: A mask is a visibility table, not extra meaning. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

缓存解码的掩码要按绝对位置填，不能照抄小三角.en: The mask for cached decoding has to be filled in by absolute position; the small triangle cannot simply be copied

本例条件：</strong>独立缓存例：旧位置0、1、2已处理，新Query位于.en: Conditions for this example: an independent cache example: old positions 0, 1 and 2 have been processed and the new queries are at 3 and 4; the keys cover 0—4. The "readable=1" in the figure below only states the logically permitted relation, which is then converted for the target API.

正在算哪个位置的新表示。.en: Which position's new representation is being computed.

可以向哪个历史位置取信息。.en: Which past positions it may take information from.

在完整序列中的序号，而非本次小批里的行号。.en: The index within the complete sequence, not the row number in this mini-batch.

放大图解：缓存解码的掩码要按绝对位置填，不能照抄小三角.en: Enlarged figure: the mask for cached decoding has to be filled in by absolute position; the little triangle cannot just be copied

有3个历史位置、2个新Query时，因果关系取决于绝对位置.en: With 3 past positions and 2 new queries, the causal relation depends on the absolute position

读历史与自己，不读未来4.en: Reads the history and itself, not the future position 4

最后一行可以读全前缀.en: The last row can read the whole prefix

把局部行号0/1误当绝对位置.en: Mistaking the local row numbers 0/1 for absolute positions

先在纸上写出每个Query的真实位置，再逐列判断key_pos≤query_po.en: Write out each Query's real position on paper first, then check key_pos≤query_pos column by column. All that is needed here is comparing two integers; there is no need to memorise framework parameter names first.

有PAD时还要同时满足Key是真实内容；因果约束与padding约束是逻辑“并且.en: When PAD is present, the key must also be real content; the causal constraint and the padding constraint are a logical "and", not a choice between the two.

PyTorch SDPA布尔True表示参与，部分MHA掩码True表示屏蔽。图.en: In PyTorch SDPA a boolean True means take part, while in some MHA masks True means blocked. The 1 in the figure is not a notation that carries across interfaces, and has to be converted before the call.

不要混淆：</strong>张量[2,5]形状完全正确，错误小三角仍会悄悄漏读历.en: Do not conflate: a tensor of shape [2,5] can be entirely correct while a wrong triangle quietly drops part of the history. Besides shape, the allow table and the output have to be tested.

BOS通常表示序列起始，EOS表示结束的特殊Token；具体模型和消息模板可能使.en: BOS is usually the special token for the start of a sequence and EOS the one for the end; a particular model or message template may use different names, counts and end markers. They are symbols in the input/output protocol, not proof of semantic correctness.<span class="concept-micro">Meeting an EOS does not automatically cut attention between two training samples; isolating the reads still needs a mask, or a sample boundary the implementation supports.

模型约定的一种结束序列Token。 例：与最大输出长度、用户取消是不同结束原因。.en: A kind of end-of-sequence token agreed with the model. Example: it is a different reason for ending than the maximum output length or a cancellation by the user.

Dropout：训练中的随机置零规则.en: Dropout: the rule that randomly zeroes values during training

常用倒置Dropout在训练时按丢弃概率p随机将元素置零，保留项除以1-p以保持.en: The common inverted dropout zeroes elements at random during training with drop probability p, and divides the kept ones by 1-p so that the expected scale is preserved. Evaluation mode usually turns this random operation off; the underlying function may require the caller to pass p=0 explicitly.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: with p=0.5, a value of 2 comes out as 4 if it is kept in a given mask and as 0 if it is dropped. This is not training permanently deleting the corresponding model parameter.

布尔mask语义相反，加缓存后is_causal还可能对齐错边.en: A boolean mask has the opposite meaning, and once a cache is added is_causal can also align to the wrong edge

第58课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 58. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

规定每个元素如何存储与运算。 例：整数编号与浮点表示通常不是同一dtype。.en: It states how each element is stored and computed. Example: integer IDs and floating-point representations are usually not the same dtype.

RoPE保留的是相对角度，不是每轮重新开始的位置.en: What RoPE keeps is the relative angle, not a position that starts over each turn

本例条件：</strong>独立二维旋转例：原始q=k=[1,0]；为便于手算，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-dimensional rotation example: the original q=k=[1,0]; to keep the arithmetic easy by hand, each additional position rotates by 90°. Real RoPE uses several groups of frequencies; this example only explains the position difference.

改变方向但保留该二维向量长度。.en: Changes the direction but keeps the length of that two-dimensional vector.

这次Token在完整上下文中的位置。.en: Where this token sits in the full context.

查询位置减去Key位置。.en: The query position minus the key position.

放大图解：RoPE保留的是相对角度，不是每轮重新开始的位置.en: Enlarged figure: what RoPE preserves is the relative angle, not a position that starts over each turn

q位置1，k位置0.en: q at position 1, k at position 0

q位置2=[-1,0]；k位置1=[0,1].en: q at position 2 = [-1,0]; k at position 1 = [0,1]

错误：新q重置为位置0.en: Wrong: the new q is reset to position 0

q=[1,0]；旧k仍[1,0].en: q=[1,0]; the old k is still [1,0]

前两行把双方同时移动一格，夹角没变，所以点积没变。这就是相对位置进入匹配的一种直.en: The first two rows move both sides one step at once; the angle between them does not change, so the dot product does not change either. This is one intuitive sign of relative position entering the matching.

缓存中的旧K已经带着它原来的位置。新Token若重置成0，就不是“只是重新编号”.en: The old keys in the cache already carry their original positions. If a new token is reset to 0, that is not "merely renumbering": it changes the relative angle between the old and the new vectors.

真实实现还要区分position_ids、cache_position与物理槽位.en: A real implementation also has to distinguish position_ids, cache_position and the physical slot; a sliding cache moves storage slots, which does not mean the semantic positions are reset as well.

不要混淆：</strong>本例90°频率是教学设定，不是现实模型第一个频率的数.en: Do not conflate: the 90° frequency in this example is a teaching setting, not the value of a real model's first frequency; the period of 4 in the figure must not be taken for a real context length.

位置编号、缓存槽位和RoPE：同叫position却不是同一个数.en: Position IDs, cache slots and RoPE: all called position, and not the same number

d_k、d_v、Dh：每行表示的宽度.en: d_k, d_v, Dh: the width of each row of representation

d_k表示一个Query/Key向量有多少个分量；d_v表示一个Value向量有.en: d_k is how many components one Query/Key vector has; d_v is how many components one Value vector has. Dh, or d_h, is the single-head width in some chapters. They are size integers, not the k-th Key or some Value number.<span class="concept-micro">Shape micro-example: with Q[2,3], K[5,3] and V[5,4], the scores are [2,5] and the output [2,4]. A pairing width of 3 for Q/K with a Value width of 4 is still legitimate.

Wq / W_Q：查询投影参数.en: Wq / W_Q: the query projection parameters

这是把输入表示变为Query的参数矩阵，不是Query本身。按本书右乘约定，输入.en: This is the parameter matrix that turns the input representation into the query, not the query itself. Under this book's right-multiplication convention, each input row has d numbers and Wq has d rows and d_k columns, so after Q=XWq each row has d_k numbers. The subscript q marks what it is for; it does not mean multiplying by another q.<span class="concept-micro">One Wq can handle many positions; each position gets its own q. F11 gives X, Wq and every multiply-add result.

Wk / W_K：键投影参数.en: Wk / W_K: the key projection parameters

这是生成Key表示的模型参数表。K=XWk中的X来自当前注意力输入，K是这次算出.en: This is the model parameter table that produces the key representation. The X in K=XWk comes from the current attention input, and K is the result computed this time; Wk is not a table that stores document keywords or secret keys. Q and K have to have the same row width for a dot product to be possible.<span class="concept-micro">In F11, x₁=[1,-1] times Wk gives k₁=[0,1]. The original token IDs are not taken as keys.

Wv / W_V：值投影参数.en: Wv / W_V: the value projection parameters

这是从输入生成Value内容向量的模型参数表。V=XWv之后，Attention.en: This is the model parameter table that produces the value content vectors from the input. After V=XWv, attention mixes the rows of V by the share in which each is read. The value width d_v may differ from the query/key width d_k; it is not the final answer over the vocabulary.<span class="concept-micro">In F11 the same x₁=[1,-1] times Wv gives v₁=[0,20], which then takes part in the weighted sum.

GQA保留多个Query，只让它们共享较少的K/V.en: GQA keeps several queries, and only has them share fewer K/V

本例条件：</strong>独立配置：4个Query头、2个KV头，每头宽度2，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent configuration: 4 query heads, 2 KV heads, width 2 per head, and 3 history positions; the mapping is Q0/Q1→KV0 and Q2/Q3→KV1.

并行的一条注意力计算路径。.en: One attention computation path running in parallel.

两个不同Query读取同一组Key/Value。.en: Two different queries read the same set of keys and values.

仍有4条Query结果，不会自动变成2。.en: There are still 4 Query results; they do not automatically become 2.

放大图解：GQA保留多个Query，只让它们共享较少的K/V.en: Enlarged figure: GQA keeps several Queries and only has them share fewer K/V

有自己的Q与份额.en: It has its own Q and its own shares

与Q0不同的Q，可产生不同份额.en: A Q different from Q0 can produce different shares

同样独立计算.en: Computed independently in the same way

K和V：2×2头×3位置×2数=24数.en: K and V: 2×2 heads × 3 positions × 2 numbers = 24 numbers

MHA四KV头则需48数.en: With MHA's four KV heads, 48 numbers are needed

共享的是被读取的表示，不是直接复制输出。即便两个Query面对同一组Key，它们.en: What is shared is the representation being read, not a copy of the output. Even when two Queries face the same set of Keys, they ask in different directions, so their softmax can differ too.

缓存只保存K/V，所以减少KV头能省缓存；Query投影和四条Query对历史的.en: The cache holds only K/V, so fewer KV heads do save cache; the query projection and the matching of all four queries against the history remain.

这是结构约束，不能简单把训练好的任意MHA运行时删掉一半KV头而宣称完全等价。.en: This is a structural constraint; you cannot simply delete half the KV heads of any trained MHA at run time and claim exact equivalence.

不要混淆：</strong>把repeat后的逻辑张量当成真实物理占用，会夸大缓.en: Do not conflate: treating the logical tensor after a repeat as real physical occupancy overstates the cache; conversely, an implementation that really copies the KV may cancel out the saving expected.

checkpoint：必须看保存的对象.en: checkpoint: you must look at the object that was saved

模型检查点保存权重或训练状态；激活检查点保存少量中间节点以便反向时重算；Agen.en: A model checkpoint saves weights or training state; activation checkpointing saves a few intermediate nodes so they can be recomputed on the backward pass; an agent task checkpoint saves how far execution has got. The three share a name, but what they restore is entirely different.<span class="concept-micro">When you see "checkpoint", first ask whether it restores parameters, recomputes activations, or continues a task. An agent saving a summary does not update model weights.

G、dQ、dW：反传里的中间梯度.en: G, dQ, dW: the intermediate gradients in backpropagation

G=∂L/∂O通常是后续运算传回的损失对当前输出O的梯度。反传伪代码把∂L/∂Q.en: G=∂L/∂O is usually the gradient of the loss with respect to the current output O, passed back from the computation that follows. The backward pseudocode writes ∂L/∂Q as dQ and ∂L/∂W as dW; their shapes match the objects being differentiated, and are not the feature dimension d times Q. <span class="concept-micro">Only after the forward pass O=AV, and once G has arrived, can dV=AᵀG and dA=GVᵀ be computed; dA changes the share path, dV the content path.

反向不是把前向箭头倒放，而是把“影响”按依赖分配.en: The backward pass is not the forward arrows played in reverse; it distributes "influence" along the dependencies

本例条件：</strong>独立单行算例：读取份额P=[0.25,0.75]，V.en: Conditions for this example: an independent single-row calculation: the read shares are P=[0.25,0.75], with V0=[2,0] and V1=[0,4]; the output is O=[0.5,3], and the loss is defined as the sum of O's two cells, so the upstream gradient is dO=[1,1].

损失对输出每格的变化率。.en: The rate of change of the loss with respect to each cell of the output.

内容变化怎样影响损失。.en: How a change in content affects the loss.

softmax之前分数的梯度。.en: The gradient of the scores before softmax.

放大图解：反向不是把前向箭头倒放，而是把“影响”按依赖分配.en: Enlarged figure: the backward pass does not play the forward arrows in reverse; it distributes "influence" along the dependencies

最后一行一负一正：提高第二个分数会给总值更大的V1更多份额，同时挤走V0的份额，.en: The last row has one negative and one positive entry: raising the second score gives more share to V1, whose total is larger, and squeezes out V0's share, so the two changes are coupled.

不能把softmax导数只写成p(1−p)而忽略其他候选；上面的减去加权基线正是.en: The softmax derivative must not be written as just p(1−p), ignoring the other candidates; subtracting the weighted baseline above is exactly what brings the coupling in.

自动求导能正确求“你写的程序”的梯度，但若前向把未来位置放进来，它也只会忠实地对.en: Automatic differentiation correctly takes the gradient of "the program you wrote", but if the forward pass lets future positions in, it will faithfully differentiate that wrong forward pass too.

不要混淆：</strong>有限差分检查通过只说明梯度跟当前前向一致；还需独立检.en: Do not conflate: a finite-difference check passing says only that the gradient agrees with the current forward pass; the mask, the target and the model's semantics still have to be checked independently.

04｜训练机制：损失、完整反向传播与参数更新.en: 04｜Training mechanics: loss, the full backward pass and parameter updates

系统机制中的训练：从损失追到每一组参数</a><a href=\"#topic-.en: Training in the system mechanisms: from the loss down to every group of parametersFollow this chapter through its objects and statesTraining: give every position a "what comes next" questionQ080｜What does next-token training actually predict? How do the labels shift, and which positions is the loss computed on?Why two contributions appear here on the backward passCompute the contributions of ten positions with the actual output head U[0,3]Q082｜Once the loss is computed, how are the parameters updated? And why is AdamW not just the gradient times the learning rate?Which set of numbers this lesson carries on fromStep one: in the RMSNorm backward pass, do not forget that the denominator depends on the inputStep two: propagating back through the FFN and the residualStep three: compute attention's content path and share path separatelyStep four: why a term is subtracted in the softmax backward passStep five: the dot product, the scaling and the three projection parameter tablesStep six: embedding gradients accumulate by address; they are not derivatives with respect to an IDHow this experiment is checked, rather than only listing formulasQ083｜What happens to pre-training data before it reaches the model? And why does data quality become a systems problem?Q084｜Why does training use more VRAM than inference? What do gradient accumulation, checkpointing and sharding each save?From the explanation on this page to an implementation you can check

优化器把梯度转换为参数更新。Adam还保存每个参数的梯度滑动平均m和平方梯度滑动.en: An optimizer turns gradients into parameter updates. Adam also keeps, for every parameter, a moving average m of the gradient and a moving average v of the squared gradient; these are training state, not attention values. AdamW decouples weight decay from the adaptive gradient update.<span class="concept-micro">Independent first-step example: with g=2, old m=0 and β₁=0.9, the new m is 0.2, and after bias correction m_hat=2. The 0.2 cannot be taken as the full size of the update.

训练的一批数据里，输入和正确后继已经给定，因此可以对多个位置一起计算预测误差，但.en: In a training batch the input and the correct continuation are already given, so the prediction error can be computed for many positions together, while the causal mask still forbids peeking at the future. When reading a training formula, first separate the forward pass, the loss, the backward pass and the update; backward does not mean the parameters have already changed.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F18.html\">训练.en: Related step-by-step process: Training: give every position a "what comes next" question. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F17.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 52 · A gradient is like a slope; the learning rate is like step sizeO09 · Activation checkpointing: store less, recompute on the backward pass

RLHF、奖励模型与策略.en: RLHF, the reward model and the policy

RLHF泛指利用人类反馈训练行为的流程。奖励模型是对回答等行为打分的模型；策略是.en: RLHF refers broadly to processes that train behavior using human feedback. A reward model scores behavior such as an answer; the policy is the probability model that actually produces actions. Their jobs differ, and a high reward is not automatically factual correctness.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: if the reward model prefers long answers, the policy may learn to write at length without being more accurate; the reward criterion therefore needs to be validated.

用指定目标回答做监督微调。 例：属于参数训练，和会话中加载Skill不同。.en: Supervised fine-tuning on specified target answers. Example: this is parameter training, unlike loading a skill within a session.

训练标签右移一格，代表每个位置要回答下一项.en: Shifting the training labels one slot to the right means every position answers for the next item

本例条件：</strong>教学完整序列为[我,爱,学习,EOS]。只展示三处监.en: Conditions for this example: the complete teaching sequence is [I, love, studying, EOS]. Only three supervised positions are shown, and no padding is included; if PAD were added as well, it should not enter the loss denominator automatically.

模型当前位置可见的前缀末尾。.en: The end of the prefix visible at the model's current position.

该位置希望预测出的下一Token。.en: The next token this position is meant to predict.

实际参加损失的预测目标数量。.en: The number of prediction targets that actually take part in the loss.

放大图解：训练标签右移一格，代表每个位置要回答下一项.en: Enlarged figure: shifting the training labels one cell right means every position answers the next item

应预测的标签.en: The label that should be predicted

第二行不是训练模型“看到爱就说爱”，而是看到前缀“我爱”后提高“学习”的概率。输.en: The second row does not train the model to "say love whenever it sees love"; it raises the probability of "learning" after the prefix "I love". Input and labels have the same shape, which does not mean their contents must match cell by cell.

全部训练文本预先给定，因此三处可以在一次前向中同时算，但掩码仍不让较早位置偷看后.en: The whole training text is given in advance, so all three places can be computed together in one forward pass, yet the mask still keeps the earlier positions from peeking at the answer that comes later.

若各有效位置损失为1、2、3，平均损失是6/3=2；再加一个被忽略的PAD不能把.en: If the losses at the valid positions are 1, 2 and 3, the average loss is 6/3=2; adding one ignored PAD cannot turn that into 6/4.

不要混淆：</strong>分批累积时有效目标数不同，直接平均每批均值会改变权重.en: Do not conflate: when accumulating over batches the number of valid targets differs, so averaging the per-batch means changes the weighting. Normalize by the total loss and the total number of valid targets.

利用梯度一阶与二阶统计的优化器；AdamW独立处理权重衰减。 例：恢复训练时应考.en: An optimiser that uses first- and second-order statistics of the gradient; AdamW handles weight decay separately. Example: when resuming training, its state has to be taken into account, not only the model weights.

混合精度、loss scaling与主权重.en: Mixed precision, loss scaling and master weights

混合精度在不同计算或状态中采用不同数值格式。主权重可用较高精度保存更新基准；lo.en: Mixed precision uses different numeric formats for different computations or states. A master copy of the weights can be kept at higher precision as the baseline for updates; loss scaling enlarges the loss before the backward pass and then scales the gradients back down, lowering the risk of underflow at some low precisions.<span class="concept-micro">This is not multiplying the learning rate up at will. Whether master weights or loss scaling are actually needed depends on the precision format, the optimiser and the implementation.

AdamW的“历史状态”，与本次梯度分开记账.en: AdamW's "historical state" is accounted for separately from this step's gradient

本例条件：</strong>独立标量演示：初始w=1，梯度g=2，m=v=0；β.en: Conditions for this example: an independent scalar demonstration: initially w=1, the gradient g=2, and m=v=0; β1=0.9, β2=0.999, learning rate 0.1, decay 0.01; the tiny effect of ε is ignored.

一阶动量，平滑历史梯度。.en: The first moment, smoothing the past gradients.

二阶动量，平滑梯度平方。.en: Second moment, smoothing the squared gradient.

补偿从零初始化造成的早期缩小。.en: Compensates for the early shrinkage caused by initialising from zero.

还不是最终更新幅度.en: Not the final size of the update yet

与梯度路径分开.en: kept apart from the gradient path

不要因为m是0.2，就把参数更新直接写成0.1×0.2。偏差修正和按平方尺度归一.en: Do not write the parameter update as 0.1×0.2 just because m is 0.2. The bias correction and the normalization by the squared scale have not been done yet.

m与v属于优化器状态，不是神经网络前向激活。恢复训练只加载w而不加载这些状态，会.en: m and v are optimiser state, not forward activations of the network. Resuming training with only w loaded, and not these states, changes the trajectory that follows.

混合精度中若放大过loss，裁剪梯度前需先还原尺度；否则裁剪的是放大后的数，不是.en: If the loss has been scaled up under mixed precision, the scale must be undone before the gradients are clipped; otherwise what is clipped is the scaled-up number, not the gradient that was meant to be limited.

不要混淆：</strong>上图是第一步、无ε近似；不能把每一步都简化成g/|g.en: Do not conflate: the figure above is the first step, with ε left out; not every step reduces to g/|g|. Later on, m and v carry history with them.

混合精度与重计算：顺序错误会让优化器悄悄走错一步.en: Mixed precision and recomputation: the wrong order makes the optimiser quietly take a wrong step

第62课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 62. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

模型训练与推理中间值播放器.en: Player for the intermediate values of model training and inference

回到本组第一步.en: Back to the first step of this group

默认暂停，最后一步自动停止。图上显示舍入值，记录保留完整精度。图形窄屏可在自身区.en: Paused by default; playback stops automatically at the last step. The figure shows rounded values, while the records keep full precision. On a narrow screen the figure can scroll within its own area; every number is also given in a full accessible table.

一条训练样本怎样带着来源与标签进入计算.en: How one training sample enters the computation carrying its source and its label

本例条件：</strong>独立数据管线：两份抓取文本其实来自同一文档修订；一个.en: Conditions for this example: an independent data pipeline: two crawled texts in fact come from the same document revision; one training sample accidentally mixes the complete answer into the user field. The figure tracks auditable data transformations and reports no model scores.

区分独立文档与重复转载。.en: Separates an independent document from a repeated reprint.

决定哪些片段组成一次训练输入。.en: Decides which segments make up one training input.

评测答案或未来信息进入训练可见范围。.en: Evaluation answers or information from the future end up within what training can see.

需要留存的证据.en: The evidence that has to be kept

docA/v1与转载A → 一份内容.en: docA/v1 and the reposted copy A → one piece of content

长样本分成序列窗口.en: A long sample is split into sequence windows

只对期望目标计损失.en: Compute the loss on the intended target only

同源文档不跨集合泄漏.en: Documents from the same source do not leak across the two sets

分组键而非随机行号.en: By a grouping key, not a random row number

“洗数据”不是一句抽象建议：每个节点都会改变模型能看到的对象。去重错了，会把一个.en: "Cleaning the data" is not an abstract piece of advice: every node changes what the model can see. Get the deduplication wrong and one source is weighted again and again.

评测划分按行随机并不总是独立：同文档的相邻片段可能一部分训练、一部分测试，让测试.en: Splitting an evaluation set at random by row is not always independent: neighboring fragments of the same document may end up partly in training and partly in test, which makes the test look unusually easy.

要记录原文ID、处理版本和样本ID的对应关系；否则发现坏样本后无法撤销它的派生块.en: The correspondence between the source document ID, the processing version and the sample ID has to be recorded; otherwise, once a bad sample is found, the chunks derived from it cannot be withdrawn.

不要混淆：</strong>更长的语料列表不等于更多独立信息；语料质量和评测独立.en: Do not conflate: a longer list of corpora is not more independent information; corpus quality and the independence of the evaluation have to be verified separately.

不同的32位或16位浮点格式，范围与精度不一样。 例：FP16和BF16都通常占.en: Different 32-bit or 16-bit floating-point formats differ in range and precision. Example: FP16 and BF16 usually both take 2 bytes, but they must not be treated as the same numeric format.

DP、TP、PP、ZeRO与FSDP.en: DP, TP, PP, ZeRO and FSDP

数据并行让多份模型处理不同样本并同步梯度；张量并行拆分一次算子的参数/计算；流水.en: Data parallelism lets several copies of the model process different samples and synchronize their gradients; tensor parallelism splits the parameters and the computation of a single operator; pipeline parallelism puts different layers on different devices. ZeRO/FSDP-style techniques also shard parameters, gradients or optimizer state.<span class="concept-micro">What they split differs: dividing one layer's matrix in two is not the same as giving two independent user tasks to two agents.

机器学习程序中用于存放规则排列数值的数据对象。 例：[2,3,4]可读成两张三行.en: A data object in a machine-learning program that holds numbers in a regular arrangement. Example: [2,3,4] can be read as two tables of three rows and four columns.

训练显存不是“参数量乘两字节”这一笔账.en: Training VRAM is not the single sum "parameter count times two bytes"

本例条件：</strong>独立预算例：1000个参数。假定低精度权重与梯度各2.en: Conditions for this example: an independent budget example: 1000 parameters. Assume 2 bytes each for the low-precision weights and gradients, 4 bytes for the FP32 master copy, and 4 bytes for each of Adam's first- and second-moment states. This estimates the state for one implementation only and does not represent every framework.

跨训练步骤保留的权重与优化器数据。.en: The weights and optimiser data kept across training steps.

反向可能需要的前向中间结果。.en: The intermediate forward results the backward pass may need.

少存部分激活，反向时再次计算。.en: Stores only some of the activations and computes them again on the backward pass.

放大图解：训练显存不是“参数量乘两字节”这一笔账.en: Enlarged figure: training VRAM is not the single sum "parameter count times two bytes"

16000 B；尚未含激活/临时缓冲.en: 16000 B; activations and temporary buffers not yet included

推理只算权重存储时得到2000B，训练本例的持久状态已是16000B。激活、通信.en: Counting only weight storage, inference comes to 2000B, while the persistent state for training in this example is already 16000B. Activations, communication buffers and allocation fragmentation are not yet included.

梯度累积把大batch分成几个小batch执行，主要控制峰值激活；它不会让全部参.en: Gradient accumulation splits a large batch into several small ones to run, which mainly controls peak activation; it does not make all the parameters disappear.

激活检查点减少保存的中间量，但需要重算；ZeRO类分片把不同状态分摊到设备上，又.en: Activation checkpointing stores fewer intermediate values but requires recomputation; ZeRO-style sharding spreads the different states across devices but introduces communication. Which account is being saved on has to be stated clearly.

不要混淆：</strong>精确字节数依dtype、主副本、优化器实现和分片策略.en: Do not conflate: the exact byte count varies with the dtype, the master copy, the optimiser implementation and the sharding strategy; 16B is not a fixed constant for every training job.

LoRA用两个较小矩阵的乘积表示一部分权重增量，而不是重新训练整个大矩阵。r是中.en: LoRA represents part of a weight increment as the product of two smaller matrices instead of retraining the whole large matrix. r is the inner dimension, and it bounds the maximum rank of that product. Where sources use a row-vector or a column-vector convention, the left-right order of A and B can differ.<span class="concept-micro">Micro-example in the right-multiplication convention: with W[4,6], the increment A[4,2]B[2,6] is still [4,6]; r=2. A here is not the table of attention shares.

在量化基础模型上训练低秩适配参数的一类方法。 例：不意味着所有计算都在4位整数中.en: A family of methods that trains low-rank adapter parameters on a quantized base model. Example: it does not mean that every computation is carried out in 4-bit integers.

通过分散保存训练状态减少跨设备重复的一类方法。 例：不等于把模型训练目标改变。.en: A family of methods that cut duplication across devices by spreading the training state out. Example: it does not change the model's training objective.

梯度累积的隐蔽偏差：平均的是批次，还是有效Token？.en: The hidden bias in gradient accumulation: is the average taken over batches, or over valid tokens?

第05课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 05. Reading order: confirm the runtime contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

Transformers PR #34191 与合并后的损失实现.en: Transformers PR #34191 and the merged loss implementation

05｜后训练与模型定制：目标、结构和参数适配.en: 05｜Post-training and model customization: objectives, structure and parameter adaptation

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">省参数、.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesFewer parameters, fewer bits and fewer activations are not the same optimizationQ085｜How do SFT, RLHF and DPO each change the model? What does the DPO formula compare?Q086｜Why do reasoning models often use reinforcement learning? How do PPO, GRPO and process supervision differ?Q087｜Why does MoE have so many total parameters yet activate only some of them? What does the router actually do?Q088｜How do you choose between LoRA, QLoRA, quantization and distillation? What do they actually change?Pressing further: why can it still talk nonsense after training is finished?From this page's explanation to an implementation you can check

先回答每种方法改变什么：后训练改变模型行为分布，LoRA限制可训练增量，量化改变.en: Answer first what each method changes: post-training changes the model's distribution of behavior, LoRA restricts the trainable increment, quantization changes the numeric representation, and MoE changes which sub-network is activated. They are not one and the same "make it smaller" button, so the gain cannot be measured by total parameter count alone.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F20.html\">省参.en: Related step-by-step process: Fewer parameters, fewer bits and fewer activations are not the same optimization. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F19.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 54 · Post-training changes behavior; a reward is not an arbiter of factO02 · Quantization: saves storage, and introduces approximationO03 · LoRA: freeze the large table, learn a small incrementO08 · MoE: each token takes part of the compute path

sigmoid：把单个数映射到0与1之间.en: sigmoid: maps a single number into the range between 0 and 1

函数规则是sigmoid(x)=1/(1+exp(-x))。它逐个数计算，不要求.en: The function rule is sigmoid(x)=1/(1+exp(-x)). It computes number by number and does not require one row of results to sum to 1, so it cannot stand in directly for a softmax over several candidates.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: sigmoid(0)=0.5; computing two zeros separately gives [0.5,0.5], which is only a coincidence — for the input [1,1] the two terms already sum to more than 1.

π、π_ref与β：偏好目标的符号.en: π, π_ref and β: the symbols of a preference objective

在策略与偏好优化中，π表示条件概率策略，π_ref表示固定参考策略；β是控制目标.en: In policy and preference optimization, π denotes a conditional-probability policy and π_ref a fixed reference policy; β is a coefficient that sets the scale of the objective or the strength of the constraint. The probability of a complete answer is built from the conditional probability of each token.<span class="concept-micro">π here is not the circle constant, and β is not the LayerNorm offset parameter. The w/l in the DPO expression mark the preferred and the non-preferred answer, not a weight w and a layer count L.

DPO比较的是“相对参考模型的偏好提升”.en: What DPO compares is the "preference gain relative to the reference model"

本例条件：</strong>独立一对回答：好回答y+与差回答y−针对同一问题。参.en: Conditions for this example: an independent pair of answers: the good answer y+ and the poor answer y− are for the same question. The reference model gives the two sequences probabilities 0.2 and 0.1, the current model 0.3 and 0.1; β=1. These probabilities are a teaching setting, chosen to make the formula clear.

整段目标在同一条件下的概率，实际通常用对数累计。.en: The probability of the whole target under the same condition; in practice it is usually accumulated in logs.

提供相对变化的基线。.en: Provides the baseline for the relative change.

好回答的相对提升减去差回答的相对提升。.en: The relative gain on the good answer minus the relative gain on the bad answer.

好回答的相对变化.en: Relative change for the good answer

差回答的相对变化.en: Relative change for the bad answer

不能只比较当前模型0.3和0.1的大小。公式还问：相对参考模型，两者分别变了多少.en: It is not enough to compare the current model's 0.3 with its 0.1. The formula also asks how much each has changed relative to the reference model.

若好坏回答都相对参考模型乘同一倍数，两项对数提升相同，边际相减为0，不会凭共同提.en: If both the better and the worse answer are multiplied by the same factor relative to the reference model, the two log gains are equal, the margin between them is 0, and a shared increase brings no extra preference advantage.

偏好标签表达选择倾向，并不自动证明答案真实正确。数据收集与评测仍需要事实依据。.en: A preference label expresses which choice is favoured; it does not automatically prove that the answer is factually correct. Data collection and evaluation still need a factual basis.

不要混淆：</strong>教学序列概率只为展示比值；真实训练要处理长度、有效T.en: Do not conflate: the teaching sequence probabilities are there to show a ratio; real training has to deal with length, valid tokens, numerical stability and the reference distribution, and cannot just multiply many small probabilities together.

DPO真正比较的不是“好答案概率”，而是相对参考策略的改变量.en: What DPO really compares is not the "probability of the good answer" but how much each has changed relative to the reference policy

这些是策略优化相关概念。PPO常用新旧动作概率比和裁剪来限制更新；GRPO类方法.en: These are concepts from policy optimization. PPO commonly limits the update with a ratio of new to old action probabilities, plus clipping; GRPO-style methods build the advantage by comparing rewards within a group. An advantage is performance relative to a baseline, not the probability that an answer is correct.<span class="concept-micro">Independent raw-difference example: rewards [0,1,1] minus the group mean of 2/3 give [-2/3,1/3,1/3]. An algorithm may normalize them again, so the two forms must not be mixed.

不同策略优化方法，使用概率比及估计信号等控制更新。 例：先懂策略、奖励、基线和相.en: Different policy-optimization methods, which control the update with things like probability ratios and estimated signals. Example: understand policy, reward, baseline and relative change before reading the formulas themselves.

组内奖励只是相对比较，不是绝对正确证明.en: A within-group reward is only a relative comparison, not proof of absolute correctness

本例条件：</strong>独立GRPO直觉例：同一题生成3个候选，验证器奖励为.en: Conditions for this example: an independent GRPO intuition example: 3 candidates are generated for the same question and the verifier rewards are [0,1,1]. Only the mean-centred relative reward is computed; it is not treated as a complete GRPO implementation.

同一道题的多个候选，而非任意不同题混一起。.en: Several candidates for the same question, rather than different questions mixed together.

验证器产生的训练信号。.en: The training signal a verifier produces.

相对基线更好还是更差的方向信号。.en: A directional signal for whether it is better or worse than the baseline.

奖励为1只说明通过了当前验证器定义的条件。验证器若漏测边界，两个高奖励候选仍可能.en: A reward of 1 only says that the conditions defined by the current verifier were met. If the verifier misses a boundary, two high-reward candidates can still share the same defect.

完整算法还可能有尺度标准化、概率比裁剪和KL等项；这里把减基线单独拿出来，是为了.en: The complete algorithm may also have scale normalization, probability-ratio clipping, a KL term and more; subtracting the baseline is pulled out on its own here in order to understand the direction first, not to pretend that training has been reproduced.

全相同奖励组不能凭空产生区分候选的相对信号；采样多样性、验证质量和任务难度都会影.en: A group whose rewards are all the same cannot produce, out of nothing, a relative signal that distinguishes the candidates; sampling diversity, verification quality and task difficulty all affect the training.

不要混淆：</strong>把过程监督、结果奖励和推理时搜索混成一个流程，会把“.en: Do not conflate: blending process supervision, outcome reward and search at inference time into one pipeline confuses "training changes the parameters" with "inference tries more answers".

FLOPs与FLOP/s：数量与速率.en: FLOPs and FLOP/s: a count and a rate

FLOPs通常表示浮点运算数量；FLOP/s表示每秒的运算速率。论文或厂商对乘加.en: FLOPs usually means a number of floating-point operations; FLOP/s means a rate of operations per second. Papers and vendors may count a multiply-add as one operation or two, so the basis has to be fixed.<span class="concept-micro">Dividing total operations by the theoretical peak is no promise of real elapsed time: movement, queueing, communication and actual utilization cost something too.

MoE的路由结果，要跟着每个Token逐个看.en: MoE routing results have to be followed token by token

本例条件：</strong>独立4专家例：每个Token选2个专家。Token.en: Conditions for this example: an independent 4-expert example: each token selects 2 experts. Token A has routing probabilities [0.6,0.3,0.1,0] and token B has [0.1,0.1,0.2,0.6]; after selection this figure renormalises over the terms that are kept.

一组子网络参数，不是人类专业身份。.en: A set of sub-network parameters, not a human professional identity.

每个Token选路由得分最高的两个。.en: Each token selects the two experts with the highest routing scores.

某专家此次接到多少Token。.en: How many tokens an expert received this time.

放大图解：MoE的路由结果，要跟着每个Token逐个看.en: Enlarged figure: MoE's routing result has to be followed token by token

选中专家与组合权重.en: Experts selected and their combination weights

E2、E3不做此Token专家计算.en: E2 and E3 do no expert computation for this token

不是复制A的路由.en: not a copy of A's routing

四组专家都可能被访问.en: All four groups of experts may be visited

“每Token激活少”不等于只需存两组参数.en: "Fewer activations per token" does not mean only two sets of parameters have to be stored

先按每一行选专家，再汇总各专家的负载。平均每个Token只走两条路，不保证每个设.en: Pick the experts row by row first, then add up the load on each expert. Each token taking only two paths on average does not guarantee an even load on every device.

组合的是专家产生的向量，不是把它们生成的中文回答投票。专家并不天然有“数学”“情.en: What is combined is the vectors the experts produce, not a vote over the Chinese answers they generated. Experts do not naturally carry readable labels such as "mathematics" or "emotion".

更多总参数可提高容量，但权重存储、路由通信与负载不均都可能成为新成本。.en: More total parameters can raise capacity, but weight storage, routing communication and load imbalance can all become new costs.

不要混淆：</strong>top-k后是否重新归一化、容量限制与丢弃策略依具体.en: Do not conflate: whether the scores are renormalised after top-k, and the capacity limit and drop policy, depend on the implementation; this figure fixes one rule and does not generalize to every MoE.

LoRA、量化和蒸馏，分别改变不同对象.en: LoRA, quantization and distillation each change a different object

本例条件：</strong>独立尺寸例：原矩阵W为8×8，共64个数；LoRA秩.en: Conditions for this example: an independent size example: the original matrix W is 8×8, 64 numbers in all; the LoRA rank is r=2, with increment A of 8×2 and B of 2×8; the quantization demonstration goes from 32bit to 8bit and counts the bare data only.

训练时不更新这一参数对象。.en: This parameter object is not updated during training.

用AB产生一份受约束的修改量。.en: Use A and B to produce a constrained increment.

用更少位数近似保存数值。.en: Store values approximately with fewer bits.

训练A与B共16+16=32个数.en: Train A and B: 16+16=32 numbers in all

原W的64个数仍在.en: The 64 numbers of the original W are still there

裸W从256B到64B.en: Bare W goes from 256 B to 64 B

还需尺度、元数据与算子支持.en: Scale, metadata and operator support are still needed

激活和训练计算不全是低位数.en: The activations and the training computation are not all low-bit

用教师信号训练另一学生模型.en: Train a separate student model with the teacher's signal

需要新训练和独立质量验证.en: Needs new training and independent quality verification

这些措施可以组合，因为作用对象不同。不能把“少训练32个参数”和“少存192字节.en: These measures can be combined, because they act on different objects. You cannot simply add "32 fewer parameters trained" and "192 fewer bytes stored" into one percentage.

LoRA低秩只约束修改量，不要求原W本身低秩；把W直接替成AB会丢掉基座。.en: LoRA's low rank constrains only the size of the change; it does not require the original W itself to be low rank. Replacing W outright with AB throws the base model away.

量化节省存储不保证任意硬件都更快；若需要频繁解量化且缺少高效核，端到端延迟可能没.en: The storage quantization saves is no guarantee of being faster on any given hardware; if dequantisation is needed often and efficient kernels are missing, end-to-end latency may not improve at all.

不要混淆：</strong>这里忽略量化尺度和偏置等开销，因此4倍是裸权重字节对.en: Do not conflate: the overhead of quantization scales, biases and the like is left out here, so the factor of 4 is a comparison of bare weight bytes, not of a complete service's VRAM or its speed.

组织模型输入、工具、状态、权限和反馈的外围程序。 例：模型提出读文件，Harne.en: The surrounding program that organizes the model's input, tools, state, permissions and feedback. Example: the model proposes reading a file; the harness runs it and fills the result back in.

LoRA第一步A梯度为零，可能是设计正常，不是反传断了.en: A zero gradient on A at LoRA's first step can be the design working normally, not a broken backward pass
