继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F09.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 44 · Softmax does not simply divide the scores by their sumLesson 58 · KV cache: keep what was computed, without skipping what must be readO07 · Speculative decoding: the draft may be fast, but it must be verified correctly

处理当前已经知道的一段输入前缀。 例：得到各层表示及可复用的K/V。.en: Processing the stretch of input prefix that is already known. Example: it yields the representations at each layer and reusable K/V.

刚选出的Token，还没进入自己的那一轮计算.en: The token just selected has not yet entered the turn of computation that is its own

本例条件：</strong>教学序列先输入[我,爱]，随后人为规定解码器依次选择.en: Conditions for this example: the teaching sequence takes [I, love] as input first, after which the decoder is told, by construction, to select [studying, !, EOS] in turn. The figure only checks the timing and the cache length; it does not pass this chosen sequence off as a training result.

这个Token已通过Embedding与全部层。.en: This token has already passed through the embedding and every layer.

从上一轮分布选中，但未必做过自己的前向。.en: Selected from the previous turn's distribution, but it has not necessarily had a forward pass of its own.

已经处理的历史位置数。.en: The number of past positions already processed.

放大图解：刚选出的Token，还没进入自己的那一轮计算.en: Enlarged figure: the token just selected has not yet entered its own round of computation

本次送入模型.en: Sent to the model this time

前向结束后的状态.en: The state after the forward pass finishes

EOS不再送入模型.en: EOS is not fed into the model again

缓存保持4；终止续写.en: Cache stays at 4; the continuation stops

第一行结束时界面可能已经显示“学习”，但缓存仍只有“我、爱”。选择与处理发生在相.en: By the end of the first row the interface may already be showing "learning", but the cache still holds only "I, love". Selection and processing happen between two neighboring rounds.

下一轮只送“学习”时，旧信息从各层KV中来；并不是模型只看这一个Token就猜下.en: When only "学习" is sent on the next turn, the old information comes from the KV in each layer; it is not that the model guesses the next token from this one token alone.

EOS被选中后通常直接停止，本例没有再把EOS处理一轮。输出数量、可见文字数量和.en: Once EOS has been selected, generation usually stops right there; this example does not put EOS through another round. The number of outputs, the amount of visible text and the cache length can therefore all differ.

不要混淆：</strong>把新Token计入缓存后又把它当新输入送一次，会重复.en: Do not conflate: counting a new token into the cache and then sending it in again as new input appends it twice; go by the actual processing log, not by where the character count on screen updates.

标签是要比较的正确目标；下一Token训练让输入位置对准后一Token。Teac.en: A label is the correct target to compare against; next-token training lines each input position up with the token after it. Teacher forcing computes with the real prefix from the data rather than replacing it with what was just sampled.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: for the full sequence [a,b,c,d] the input [a,b,c] can be paired with the labels [b,c,d]. When the interface already shifts them, do not shift them a second time outside it.

给了attention_mask，为什么右补齐生成仍可能读错logits？.en: With attention_mask supplied, why can right-padded generation still read the wrong logits?

第57课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 57. Reading order: confirm the runtime contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

Top-k保留概率最高的k项；Top-p按概率降序保留累计概率达到阈值的候选前缀.en: Top-k keeps the k items with the highest probability; Top-p sorts by descending probability and keeps the leading candidates until the cumulative probability reaches a threshold. When used for sampling, the kept candidates have to be renormalized over the remaining total mass.<span class="concept-micro">Here k is a number of candidates and p a cumulative-probability threshold; k is not the attention Key table K, nor the representation width d_k.

分别按候选个数或累计概率保留候选的策略。 例：筛选后通常还要重新归一化。.en: Strategies that keep candidates by their number or by cumulative probability. Example: after the filtering, the result usually has to be renormalized.

同一分数，不同采样处理顺序会给出不同候选集合.en: With the same scores, handling the sampling steps in a different order gives a different set of candidates

温度、Top-p、禁词：为什么“参数都一样”也可能不是同一采样算法？.en: Temperature, top-p and banned words: why may "the parameters are all the same" still not be the same sampling algorithm?

这些是不同层对象的标识：工具调用、输出项、请求或响应。用来把增量和结果配回正确对.en: These are identifiers for objects at different layers: a tool call, an output item, a request or a response. They match increments and results back to the right object; they are not the token IDs of the model input, and they are not business idempotency keys by nature.<span class="concept-micro">Two read_file calls can carry c1 and c2; when the results come back in the reverse order they are still paired by call identifier, not guessed by tool name.

“输出停止”与“任务成功”要画在不同状态线上.en: "Output stopped" and "task succeeded" have to be drawn on different state lines

本例条件：</strong>独立工具任务：模型先要求写入文件，再需要测试验证。下.en: Conditions for this example: an independent tool task: the model first asks to write a file, then needs a test to verify it. Several stop events are listed below; they are not consecutive steps on one timeline.

本次模型输出不再继续到来。.en: No more of this model output is arriving.

获准动作已产生可核验结果。.en: The granted action has produced a result that can be verified.

用户要求的验收条件已成立。.en: The acceptance conditions the user asked for now hold.

你不能据此确认.en: What you cannot confirm from it

本次序列选择了终止标记.en: This sequence selected the end marker

文件一定已正确修改.en: The file must already have been modified correctly

生成预算用完.en: The generation budget is used up

JSON完整、答案正确.en: The JSON is complete and the answer correct

工具参数生成完.en: The tool arguments are fully generated

可以尝试解析/校验.en: Parsing and validation can be attempted

测试通过并绑定当前版本.en: The test passed and is bound to the current version

本组检查对当前工件有效.en: This set of checks is valid for the current artifact

没覆盖的需求也自动满足.en: Requirements that are not covered are met automatically too

把“模型结束、工具结束、任务完成”设成不同字段，才能避免结束标记触发假成功。.en: Only by making "model finished", "tool finished" and "task complete" separate fields can an end marker be kept from triggering a false success.

长度限制可能把JSON截在半个字段，应该记录不完整而不是把收到的文本强行当合法调.en: A length limit can cut the JSON off in the middle of a field; record it as incomplete instead of forcing the text received to count as a valid call.

工具调用响应结束后，外层Agent仍可能要执行、回填、再次调用模型。内外两种循环.en: After the response carrying the tool call ends, the outer agent may still have to execute, fill the result back in and call the model again. The stopping conditions of the inner and the outer loop are different.

不要混淆：</strong>取消请求不证明远端副作用已取消；取消后仍应核对在途操.en: Do not conflate: canceling a request does not prove the remote side effect was canceled; after canceling, the state of the operations in flight still has to be checked.

独立结构对照：另一台七词表微型模型.en: An independent structural comparison: a second miniature model with a seven-item vocabulary

本节主线使用F16训练保存的八词表模型：输入[6,1,2]，结束编号为7。下面的.en: The main thread of this section uses the eight-item-vocabulary model saved by the F16 training run: the input is [6,1,2] and the end ID is 7. The independent structural demonstration below uses a second model with a seven-item vocabulary, EOS ID 6 and a different forward structure; it serves only as a comparison for generation timing, and its probabilities, IDs and cache lengths must not be joined onto the training record above. On a first reading you can skip this comparison.

FlashAttention：改变中间数据存取方式.en: FlashAttention: changing how intermediate data is stored and read

通过分块和在线归一化等方式，避免把完整注意力分数/权重矩阵长期写到较慢显存；目标.en: By means such as tiling and online normalization, it avoids keeping the full attention score/weight matrix in slower VRAM for long; the target is still the same attention computation, and floating-point rounding can vary with the order of operations.<span class="concept-micro">It does not compress tokens permanently, and it does not skip any Key. Keep "not writing the whole table to VRAM" apart from "not doing this arithmetic at all".

PagedAttention：分页管理K/V存储.en: PagedAttention: managing K/V storage in pages

把逻辑连续的K/V序列存到多个物理块，通过块表定位。它主要改变存储管理与共享方式.en: Store a logically contiguous K/V sequence in several physical blocks, located through a block table. It mainly changes how the storage is managed and shared; it does not replace the attention formula with an algorithm that means something else.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: logical positions 0—3 are in physical block 7 and 4—7 in block 2; logical position 4 need not physically follow position 3.

这里有三个不同的存储问题：KV缓存跨轮保留历史；FlashAttention安排.en: There are three different storage problems here: the KV cache keeps history across turns; FlashAttention arranges the intermediate reads and writes of one attention computation; PagedAttention manages physical cache blocks. The animation gives concrete numbers for each, so that the three kinds of saving are not mistaken for reductions in the same computation.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/O04.html\">Fl.en: Related step-by-step process: FlashAttention: accumulate while reading, without materialising the whole table. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F16.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 58 · KV cache: keep what was computed, without skipping what must be readO01 · GQA/MQA: what is reduced is the number of K/V groupsO05 · PagedAttention: logically contiguous, physically chunked

Wo / W_O：注意力输出投影.en: Wo / W_O: the attention output projection

把各注意力头输出拼接后，再转换成主网络需要宽度的参数矩阵。它仍是一张系数表，不是.en: The parameter matrix that concatenates the attention heads' outputs and then converts them to the width the main network needs. It is still a table of coefficients: not the shares from softmax, and not the vocabulary output head Wout.<span class="concept-micro">If two heads each output 2 numbers, the concatenation is 4 wide; multiplying on the right by Wo of shape [4,6] gives 6 numbers, matching the residual width. This is an independent example about shapes.

旧K/V为什么能复用：新Token不能反向改变旧前缀.en: Why old K/V can be reused: a new token cannot reach back and change the old prefix

本例条件：</strong>独立两层、严格因果、推理模式例：先处理a,b,c，再.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-layer, strictly causal, inference-mode example: a,b,c are processed first, then d is input. The parameters, the old prefix and the position rules are unchanged; each layer's cache holds its own K/V.

位置c的计算只能依赖a,b,c。.en: The computation at position c may depend only on a,b,c.

第一层和第二层保存的不是同一组数。.en: The first layer and the second layer do not store the same set of numbers.

只负责本轮新位置的读取。.en: Responsible only for reading at this turn's new position.

放大图解：旧K/V为什么能复用：新Token不能反向改变旧前缀.en: Enlarged figure: why the old K/V can be reused — a new token cannot reach back and change the old prefix

由第1层新d得到本层Q/K/V(d).en: This layer's Q/K/V(d), obtained from the new d out of layer 1

两层历史各增长到4位置.en: the history in both layers grows to 4 positions

仅用最新末位置预测下一项.en: Predict the next item from the newest final position only

a之前可保留的范围另行核对.en: the range that can be kept before a has to be checked separately

b及受其影响的后缀需重算.en: b and the suffix it affects have to be recomputed

证明从第一层向后做：旧位置看不到新d，因此第一层旧表示不变；第二层的旧输入也就不.en: The proof runs forward from the first layer: the old positions cannot see the new d, so the old representations in the first layer are unchanged; the old inputs to the second layer are therefore unchanged too, and so it holds layer by layer.

旧Q主要用于计算旧位置的输出。当前只要求d的新输出，不需要再用旧Q发起读取，所以.en: The old Q was mainly used to compute the output at the old positions. Only the new output for d is required now, and no read needs to be issued with the old Q again, which is why K/V is usually cached and Q is not.

模型参数、模板或旧位置改变会破坏复用前提。“同一个会话”不是缓存有效性的数学条件.en: Changing the model parameters, the template or the old positions breaks the premise for reuse. "The same session" is not a mathematical condition for cache validity.

不要混淆：</strong>双向注意力中旧位置可能看见新增内容，不能无条件套用这.en: Do not conflate: with bidirectional attention an old position may see newly added content, so this causal-cache argument cannot be applied unconditionally.

缓存共享的两个危险：身份不完整与可变对象别名.en: Two dangers in sharing a cache: an incomplete identity, and aliasing of mutable objects

第26课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 26. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

O(·)：随规模增长的数量级.en: O(·): the order of growth with size

缓存用字节计数，计算节省另算一笔.en: A cache is counted in bytes; the compute it saves is a separate account

通过分块和更有效内存访问计算注意力的一类实现。 例：不是稀疏注意力，也不是把旧历.en: A family of implementations that compute attention by tiling and more efficient memory access. Example: it is not sparse attention, and it does not summarize old history away.

不存完整softmax表，也能把前后块合成同一答案.en: The earlier and later blocks can be combined into the same answer without storing the full softmax table

本例条件：</strong>独立标量Value例：分数s=[0,ln2]，值v=.en: Conditions for this example: an independent scalar-value example: the scores are s=[0,ln2] and the values v=[10,20]. One term is handled at a time; the running maximum m, the sum of exponentials l and the weighted sum o are kept, and o/l is output at the end.

当前已看部分的最大分数。.en: The largest score in the part seen so far.

以当前m为基准的指数和。.en: The sum of the exponentials taken against the current m.

同一基准下指数乘Value的和。.en: The sum of the exponentials times Value, on the same basis.

加入块2，m变ln2.en: Add block 2 and m becomes ln2

旧l缩半=0.5；旧o缩半=5.en: Old l halved = 0.5; old o halved = 5

换基准时两份统计一起缩放.en: When the reference changes, both running statistics are rescaled together

最容易漏的是第二行：最大值变了，旧指数统计也必须改到同一基准。只加新项而不缩放旧.en: The second row is the easiest to miss: once the maximum changes, the old exponential statistics must be moved to the same basis as well. Adding the new term without rescaling the old one does not end up as the same softmax.

l只要一个标量，o按Value宽度保存一排数，不必把每个位置的完整概率都写到外部.en: l needs only one scalar, and o keeps a row of numbers as wide as the value, so the full probabilities for every position need not be written out to external VRAM.

FlashAttention利用分块和在线归一化减少IO；这不表示少看几个Tok.en: FlashAttention cuts IO with tiling and online normalization; that does not mean it looks at fewer tokens, and it is not the same as approximate sparse attention.

不要混淆：</strong>本例证明合并恒等式，不是GPU性能测量；实际速度取决.en: Do not conflate: this example proves the merge identity, it is not a GPU performance measurement; the actual speed depends on the kernel implementation, the shapes, the dtype and the hardware.

在线softmax为什么必须重标定旧累积量，而不是平均各块答案？.en: Why must online softmax rescale the old running totals instead of averaging each block's answer?

分页改变物理存放，不改变Token的逻辑次序.en: Paging changes physical placement, not the logical order of the tokens

本例条件：</strong>独立KV分配例：每块容纳2个位置，序列有5个位置；逻.en: Conditions for this example: an independent KV allocation example: each block holds 2 positions and the sequence has 5 positions; logical blocks 0/1/2 map to physical blocks 6/1/9 respectively.

Token在这条序列里的顺序。.en: The token's order within this sequence.

显存里实际可分配的存储单元。.en: The unit of storage that can actually be allocated in VRAM.

一个Token在当前块的第几格。.en: Which slot in the current block a token sits in.

放大图解：分页改变物理存放，不改变Token的逻辑次序.en: Enlarged figure: paging changes the physical placement, not the logical order of the tokens

逻辑块 + 块内偏移.en: Logical block + offset inside the block

物理块9，第0格；另一格闲置.en: Physical block 9, cell 0; the other cell is idle

按位置2读取时，先算整除2得到逻辑块1，再查映射得到物理块1。物理编号小并不表示.en: To read position 2, first divide by 2 as integers to get logical block 1, then look the mapping up to get physical block 1. A low physical number does not mean it came earlier.

这条序列不需要占一整段连续大空间；结束后可以按块释放。共享前缀还需要引用计数和写.en: This sequence does not need one large contiguous stretch of space; once it ends, it can be released block by block. A shared prefix also needs semantics such as reference counting and copy-on-write.

分页主要改内存管理。位置规则、可见范围和Key/Value内容仍必须对应原序列，.en: Paging mainly changes memory management. The position rules, the visible range and the Key/Value contents must still match the original sequence; tokens must not be reordered because the storage is scattered.

不要混淆：</strong>最后一块只用了半块，仍有内部碎片。分页不是零浪费，也.en: Do not conflate: the last block is only half used, so there is still internal fragmentation. Paging is not zero waste, and it is not ordinary disk swap standing in for VRAM.

08｜推理服务：调度、吞吐、延迟和并行.en: 08｜Inference serving: scheduling, throughput, latency and parallelism

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">连续组批.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesContinuous batching: when a seat frees up, take the next oneQ097｜How does continuous batching differ from ordinary batching? Why does prefill interfere with decode?Keep the four accounts separate firstKV cache: trading memory for repeated computation of the historyFlashAttention: the objective is unchanged; what changes is the intermediate accessPagedAttention and continuous batching: managing storage and schedulingQuantization: an approximation needs measurable errorActivation checkpointing: exactly the opposite direction from a KV cacheSpeculative decoding: the draft must be verified to keep the target distributionWhich performance conclusions this book does not drawQ098｜How are TTFT, TPOT and end-to-end latency broken down? How is a roofline used to locate the bottleneck?Q099｜Why can speculative decoding be faster and still keep the target distribution?Q100｜What does each of DP, TP, PP, ZeRO and prefill/decode separation actually split?First ask which boundary the error happens atCommon symptoms and minimal counterexamplesWhy "the gradient is not 0" is nowhere near enoughWhy a negative control is neededHow to choose the numerical toleranceHow to read the results shipped with the bookPressing further: which changes may be claimed to keep the same computational objective?The full acceptance questionsFrom this page's explanation to an implementation you can check

先把单个请求的等待时间和整个服务的吞吐分开。下图用相同服务槽位、相同请求长度比较.en: Separate one request's waiting time from the throughput of the whole service first. The figure below compares static batching with continuous batching using the same service slots and the same request length; the time per step is explicitly idealised, and real scheduling later still has to bring in prefill, queues and device measurements.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/O06.html\">连续.en: Related step-by-step process: Continuous batching: when a seat frees up, take the next one. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F21.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 62 · Slow computation may mean things are being moved slowlyO05 · PagedAttention: logically contiguous, physically chunkedO12 · Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task

连续组批把空出来的槽给新请求，但调度步不等于等长时间.en: Continuous batching gives a freed slot to a new request, but a scheduling step is not an equal length of time

本例条件：</strong>独立离散调度例：两个decode槽；A还需1个Tok.en: Conditions for this example: an independent discrete scheduling example: two decode slots; A still needs 1 token, B still needs 3 tokens, and C is ready and needs 2 tokens. This figure compares by scheduling step only and does not simulate prefill time.

某次调度可一起处理的一条序列位置。.en: One sequence position that a single scheduling step can process together with the others.

满足这条请求的停止条件。.en: This request's stopping condition is satisfied.

不必等待同批所有请求都结束。.en: There is no need to wait for every request in the batch to finish.

放大图解：连续组批把空出来的槽给新请求，但调度步不等于等长时间.en: Enlarged figure: continuous batching gives a freed slot to a new request, but a scheduling step is not an equal span of time

A生成最后一项，结束.en: A generates its last item and finishes

固定整批策略在A结束后可能让槽0等B；连续组批让C利用这个空档，提高设备利用率。.en: With a fixed whole-batch policy, slot 0 may wait for B after A finishes; continuous batching lets C use that gap, which raises device utilization.

这里故意把C设为已经完成prefill，否则加入C还要处理长输入，可能挤占正在d.en: C is deliberately set here to have finished prefill; otherwise admitting C would also mean handling a long input, which could crowd out B while it is decoding. Real scheduling has to deal with that interference.

比较性能要同时看吞吐、首Token等待与每Token间隔；总体多做了任务，某个短.en: Comparing performance means looking at throughput, the wait for the first token and the interval per token together; more tasks may be done overall while one short request is still slowed by queueing.

不要混淆：</strong>图中三步等高是示意，不表示每步毫秒数相同，更不是产品.en: Do not conflate: the three steps being drawn the same height is schematic; it does not mean each step takes the same number of milliseconds, still less that this is a measured speed-up of a product.

TTFT是请求到首个输出Token的延迟；TPOT描述后续每Token时间的统计.en: TTFT is the latency from the request to the first output token; TPOT describes the statistics of the time per token after that; p95 is the quantile that about 95% of observations in a given window do not exceed; throughput is the amount completed per unit of time. Say where the timing starts and stops.<span class="concept-micro">A fast first character does not mean a fast task: tool execution may still take a long time. Nor does theoretical peak throughput equal the latency one user sees.

首个Token延迟，以及95%样本不超过的分位数等运行指标。 例：平均值正常仍可.en: Runtime metrics such as time to first token and the percentile that 95% of samples stay under. Example: a healthy average can still sit alongside a very bad tail latency.

吞吐下降但GPU很忙：可能是KV抢占重算，而不是算力不够.en: Throughput falls while the GPU is busy: it may be KV preemption and recomputation, not a shortage of compute

第33课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 33. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then the counterexamples and the fix, and test the limits last.

HBM在此指GPU较大容量的高带宽显存；SRAM相关片上存储通常更小、访问更近。.en: HBM here means the larger high-bandwidth memory on a GPU; the related on-chip SRAM is usually smaller and closer to the computation. Bandwidth is how many bytes can be moved in a given time; arithmetic intensity is the ratio of computation to data moved. <span class="concept-micro">Independent accounting: 100 operations against 10 bytes moved is about 10 operations per byte. It is not a measurement of real hardware performance.

先拆等待、首项、后续项，再问为什么慢.en: Separate the wait, the first item and the later items before asking why it is slow

一次任务的执行轨迹与其中有开始结束的操作跨度。 例：并行跨度的耗时不能直接全加成.en: The execution trace of one task, and the operation spans inside it that have a start and an end. Example: the durations of parallel spans cannot all be added up into wall-clock time.

拒绝草稿时的补偿，才保证目标分布不被带偏.en: It is the compensation when a draft is rejected that keeps the target distribution from being skewed

本例条件：</strong>独立两候选分布：草稿q=[0.8,0.2]，目标p=.en: Conditions for this example: two independent candidate distributions: draft q=[0.8,0.2], target p=[0.5,0.5]. One candidate is proposed from q and then accepted with min(1,p/q); on rejection, a replacement is sampled from the normalized max(p−q,0).

提出概率乘接受概率。.en: The proposal probability times the acceptance probability.

目标比草稿缺少的概率质量。.en: The probability mass the target has and the draft lacks.

最终分布相同，不承诺同一随机种子逐Token一致。.en: The final distribution is the same; it does not promise that the same random seed matches token by token.

放大图解：拒绝草稿时的补偿，才保证目标分布不被带偏.en: Enlarged figure: it is the correction on rejecting a draft that keeps the target distribution from being pulled off course

拒绝补偿后的总质量.en: Total mass after the rejection correction

归一化后只能选B.en: After normalization only B can be chosen

只看接受步骤，B还只有0.2，距离目标0.5差0.3。拒绝补偿正好把草稿过度给A.en: Looking at the accepted steps alone, B still has only 0.2, 0.3 short of the target 0.5. The rejection compensation moves exactly the part the draft over-gave to A back to the B that was short.

若拒绝后直接按原目标p再抽，会错误地又给A一部分概率，因此不是同一保证。.en: Resampling from the original target p after a rejection would wrongly give A some probability again, so that is not the same guarantee.

真实推测解码把多个候选交给目标模型批量验证；收益还依赖接受率与验证成本。这里只核.en: Real speculative decoding hands several candidates to the target model for batch verification; the gain also depends on the acceptance rate and the cost of verification. Here we only check that the probabilities of a single step are preserved.

不要混淆：</strong>省去修正采样可能更简单，却会改变生成分布；不能同时声.en: Do not conflate: leaving the correction out of the sampling may be simpler, but it changes the generated distribution; one cannot claim both "rejections handled however you like" and "the target distribution strictly preserved".

推测采样拒绝草稿后，为什么不能直接按目标分布再抽一次？.en: After speculative sampling has rejected a draft, why can it not simply draw again from the target distribution?

分布式的“切开”，要先指明切的是样本、矩阵还是状态.en: The "splitting" in distributed training: say first whether what is split is the samples, the matrices or the state

本例条件：</strong>独立两设备示意。网络含层L0—L3，一个矩阵W可按列.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-device sketch. The network contains layers L0—L3, and one matrix W can be split by columns into W-left/W-right; everything in the figure is a logical responsibility, and no speed-up factor is given without hardware measurement.

数据并行：不同设备处理不同样本。.en: Data parallelism: different devices process different samples.

张量并行：同一次算子的矩阵分片。.en: Tensor parallelism: matrix sharding within a single operator.

流水并行：不同设备承担不同层。.en: Pipeline parallelism: different devices take different layers.

完整模型+样本A / 完整模型+样本B.en: Full model + sample A / full model + sample B

拼接或规约中间结果.en: Concatenate or reduce the intermediate results

传激活；可能出现等待空泡.en: Passes activations; waiting bubbles can appear

持有一部分参数/梯度/优化器状态.en: Holds part of the parameters / gradients / optimiser state

长输入处理 / 后续逐步生成.en: Handling the long input / generating step by step afterwards

传递KV状态并管理排队.en: Passes the KV state on and manages queuing

DP不一定让单条请求的同一步更快，它更自然地增加独立样本处理能力。TP才拆同一次.en: DP does not necessarily make the same step of a single request faster; what it adds more naturally is capacity for independent samples. It is TP that splits one operator, at the cost of extra communication.

PP让设备分别放不同层，可分担容量；单一微批仍要先过前层再过后层，多微批才有流水.en: PP puts different layers on different devices, which shares out the capacity; a single micro-batch still has to pass through the earlier layers before the later ones, and only with several micro-batches is there pipeline overlap.

同一系统可以组合这些策略，但每加一层划分都要追踪数据移动和同步。只有矩阵尺寸没有.en: One system can combine these strategies, but every further layer of partitioning means tracking data movement and synchronisation. With the matrix sizes but no network bandwidth, the net gain is hard to judge.

不要混淆：</strong>“两张卡”不能直接推断“两倍速度”；如果新增通信超过.en: Do not conflate: "two cards" does not give "twice the speed"; if the added communication outweighs the computation saved, it can even be slower.

09｜Agent一次任务的完整循环：谁在思考，谁在执行.en: 09｜One full agent task loop: who is thinking and who is executing

把模型、宿主、工具画成不同泳道后，问“谁真正改变了文件”就有明确答案。跟踪每条返.en: Once the model, the host and the tools are drawn as separate swim lanes, the question "who actually changed the file" has a definite answer. Follow every returned message, then decide whether the model has to be called again, a tool has to run, or it is over; do not take the model saying it is done as the environment being done.

一次任务里的两轮模型调用，各自多知道了什么.en: Two model calls in one task, and what each of them knows in addition

本例条件：</strong>独立只读任务：问config.txt的timeout.en: Conditions for this example: an independent read-only task: ask for the timeout in config.txt. The content on disk is timeout=30, version r7. The file tool changes nothing, and a model request does not read the disk by itself.

组织请求、执行获准工具的程序。.en: The program that assembles the request and runs the tools that were granted.

把工具结果绑定到对应调用。.en: Bind the tool result to the call it belongs to.

真正执行得到的新证据。.en: The new evidence obtained by actually executing.

放大图解：一次任务里的两轮模型调用，各自多知道了什么.en: Enlarged figure: the two model calls within one task, and what each of them has come to know

任务已知，内容未知.en: The task is known, the content is not

问题 + read_file工具说明.en: The question + the read_file tool description

模型有可用能力描述.en: The model has a description of an available capability

只有提议，尚未取证.en: Only a proposal; no evidence gathered yet

下一轮新增了文件事实.en: The next turn adds the file fact

回答草稿：timeout为30，依据r7.en: Draft answer: the timeout is 30, based on r7

第二轮模型输出已结束.en: The second model output has ended

显示已核对的只读结果.en: Shows the read-only result that was checked

任务完成；没有发生文件修改.en: Task complete; no file was modified

沿着call c1追踪：模型产生调用项时磁盘没有因此改变，宿主必须再做执行动作。.en: Follow call c1: nothing on disk changes when the model produces the call item; the harness still has to take the executing action.

下一轮不是只发“30”这个孤立数字；要保留它回答哪次调用、来自哪个文件版本，避免.en: The next turn does not send the isolated number "30" on its own; it has to keep which call that number answers and which file version it came from, so that another tool's result is not spliced in.

这里实际需要两轮模型请求；如果宿主预先读取了文件，可能一轮就够。轮数取决于信息何.en: Two model requests are actually needed here; if the host had read the file in advance, one might be enough. The number of turns depends on when the information arrives, not on some fixed constant of the agent.

不要混淆：</strong>结果回填丢失时，模型可能再次要求读取。应先查消息装配.en: Do not conflate: when the result is not filled back in, the model may ask to read it again. Check message assembly first, instead of putting every repeated call down to the model not being clever.

一个修复任务，为什么产生三次模型调用.en: Why one repair task produces three model calls

输入与条件。</strong>任务是把.en: Input and conditions.The task is to change

的超时从3改成5，工具有read、write、test。下面是确定的教学轨迹，.en: timeout from 3 to 5, with the tools read, write and test. What follows is a fixed teaching trace, not a real model running on its own.

用户任务＋可用工具说明.en: The user task + the descriptions of the available tools

模型提出read，尚未承诺文件已修改。.en: The model proposes read; it has not committed to the file having been changed.

结果连同调用ID进入历史。.en: The result enters the history together with the call ID.

任务＋read调用＋结果.en: The task + the read call + the result

模型提出在v7基础上写timeout=5。.en: The model proposes writing timeout=5 on top of v7.

宿主仍未证明功能测试通过。.en: The host still has no proof that the functional test passed.

新版本和测试返回pass.en: The new version, and the test returning pass

模型归纳变更与验证；如果模型还需自行提出test，则还要增加一轮。.en: The model sums up the change and the verification; if it also has to propose the test itself, that adds another turn.

后端可能有多次模型请求和多次工具操作。.en: The back end may make several model requests and several tool operations.

把过程连起来。</strong>一轮模型调用的输出不是任务的全部生命周期；哪些工.en: Join the steps up. The output of one model call is not the whole life cycle of the task; which tools the model decides on and which the host triggers automatically has to be stated clearly.

边界与反例。</strong>本例test由宿主固定触发，因此三次调用成立；不要.en: Limits and counterexamples. In this example the test is triggered by the harness on a fixed rule, which is why there are three calls; do not count it together with a configuration in which "every tool step needs another model proposal".

由程序预先安排主要步骤和分支的流程。 例：不等于每一步都必须由模型临时决策。.en: A process whose main steps and branches are arranged in advance by the program. Example: this does not mean every step must be decided ad hoc by the model.

一次回答结束，为什么任务仍未完成？.en: One answer has finished — so why is the task still not done?

四种完成不互相替代。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型实.en: Four kinds of completion do not substitute for one another. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

。源码限提交 86e17e98c7f9 和已读取路径；文章经验、公开文档与原创教.en: . The source is limited to commit 86e17e98c7f9 and the paths actually read; article experience, public documentation and original teaching experiments are labeled separately.<a href="../engineering/agent-evidence.html#acquisition">See how it was obtained, what was read, and the limits

Thread、Turn、Session：运行层次.en: Thread, turn, session: the levels of a run

这些通常是宿主对会话和工作轮次的划分，不是神经网络的层。Thread可指一条会话.en: These are usually the host's divisions of a conversation and of units of work, not layers of a neural network. A thread can mean one conversation, and a turn can contain the several model and tool cycles needed to answer one user task; where the boundaries fall depends on the product.<span class="concept-micro">"This turn is done" cannot be equated with "every external tool has finished"; that takes looking at the actual events and results.

模型说“写好了”，任务记录和磁盘可能各是另一回事.en: The model says "it is written", while the task record and the disk may each say something else

有状态与无状态接口，区别在于谁保存前一轮对象.en: Stateful and stateless interfaces differ in who keeps the objects from the previous turn

本例条件：</strong>独立两轮协议示意：第一轮输出工具调用c1，结果为“3.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-turn protocol sketch: the first turn outputs tool call c1, whose result is "30". On the left the client replays everything in full; on the right it is linked through the server-side response ID. The exact fields vary with the API.

宿主显式保留并提交的消息序列。.en: The message sequence the host explicitly keeps and submits.

由响应ID等引用的已存对象。.en: An already stored object referenced by a response ID or similar.

工具、规则等是否继承要查具体接口约定。.en: Whether tools, rules and the like are inherited has to be read off the specific interface agreement.

显式提交原任务+c1.en: Submit the original task plus c1 explicitly

不能只凭r1推定所有配置自动继承.en: r1 alone is no ground for assuming that every setting is inherited automatically

需单独保存/检索.en: Has to be saved and retrieved separately

会话关联本身不提供事实更新与遗忘.en: Session association by itself supplies neither fact updates nor forgetting

两条路线都要让模型知道结果对应c1。不同的是旧记录通过实际内容还是引用传递。.en: Both routes have to let the model know that the result belongs to c1. What differs is whether the old record is passed on as actual content or as a reference.

一个字符串session_id只是一把查状态的钥匙；服务是否存了什么、保留多久、.en: A session_id string is only a key for looking state up; whether the service stored anything, how long it keeps it and which settings apply this turn are for the contract to decide.

迁移到别的模型时，普通文本证据可能可重组，不透明压缩块则不能假定可跨提供方解释。.en: When moving to another model, ordinary text evidence can probably be reassembled, but an opaque compressed block cannot be assumed to be interpretable across providers.

不要混淆：</strong>链路连续不等于状态无限、完整或永不失效。故障时检查实.en: Do not conflate: an unbroken connection does not mean the state is unlimited, complete or never invalidated. When something fails, check the actual request and the state of the service rather than just confirming that the ID has not changed.

有previous_response_id，为什么仍可能丢失规则或工具上下文？.en: With previous_response_id, why can the rules or the tool context still be lost?

第11课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 11. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

为什么每次模型调用都需要一致的上下文快照？.en: Why does every model call need a consistent context snapshot?

不能偷偷换成R4解释旧提议.en: No quietly switching to R4 to interpret the old proposal

检测是否已变r8.en: Detect whether it has already become r8

若撤销则拒绝执行.en: If it has been revoked, refuse to execute

同一请求绑定解释对象，执行时仍检查授权。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是.en: One request binds the objects it is interpreted against, and authorization is still checked at execution time. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

无法确认外部动作是否已经完成的状态。 例：超时可能发生在成功执行之后。.en: A state in which it cannot be confirmed whether an external action has completed. Example: a timeout can happen after a successful execution.

结束判定要看证据增量，而不是循环次数本身.en: Deciding to stop should depend on added evidence, not on the number of loops in itself

模型结束、工具结束、任务完成：三种“完成”不能用同一布尔值.en: The model finishing, the tool finishing and the task completing: three kinds of "done" cannot share one boolean

10｜模型输出怎样变成真实工具调用：协议与执行边界.en: 10｜How model output becomes a real tool call: protocol and execution boundary

先区分收到一段网络字节、拼成一个SSE事件、得到完整JSON以及确认工具调用完成.en: Start by separating receiving a stretch of network bytes, assembling one SSE event, obtaining complete JSON, and confirming that a tool call is finished. Execution is considered only after the last of these conforms to the protocol in structure and passes the permission check. If the four layers are run together, half an argument can be taken for a real command.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F23.html\">字符.en: Related step-by-step process: Complete characters, complete events and complete tool arguments are three separate gates. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

第07课 · API与流式协议</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocolsLesson 08 · Tools and MCP

函数调用的JSON是订单，执行器才是履行订单的人.en: The JSON of a function call is the order; the executor is the one who fills it

前置检查、后置检查为什么不能互相替代？.en: Why can a pre-check and a post-check not replace each other?

后置拒收不回滚已完成动作。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业.en: A rejection after the fact does not roll back an action that has already completed. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

SSE、chunk、delta：不同的分片层.en: SSE, chunk, delta: different layers of fragmentation

SSE是服务端发送事件的文本协议；网络chunk是这次收到的一段字节；delta.en: SSE is the text protocol for server-sent events; a network chunk is the stretch of bytes received this time; a delta is the incremental content of one output item. Their boundaries are not guaranteed to coincide. One complete event does not necessarily mean complete tool arguments either.<span class="concept-micro">The arguments may arrive first as {"path":"a and then as .py"}; they have to be assembled and the protocol's completion condition awaited — seeing a fragment is no reason to execute.

LF是换行字符，CRLF是回车再换行的组合。SSE规定事件行与空行的解释；Eve.en: LF is the line-feed character, and CRLF is a carriage return followed by a line feed. SSE lays down how event lines and blank lines are interpreted; EventSource is the browser's interface for receiving SSE. Teaching code that parses only one kind of separator is not a complete protocol implementation.<span class="concept-micro">Real network fragments may happen to deliver CR and LF separately, so a parser should assemble them by the protocol rules it implements and must not take every network fragment for one event.

字节、事件、参数三种完整性，分别用不同缓冲区处理.en: Byte completeness, event completeness and argument completeness are handled by different buffers

本例条件：</strong>独立示例：UTF-8汉字“爱”占E7 88 B1三个.en: Conditions for this example: an independent example: in UTF-8 the Chinese character for "love" takes the three bytes E7 88 B1; the network may split them into E7 88 and B1. SSE then organises the data by event boundaries, so tool arguments may span several events.

为完整字符保留未解码后缀。.en: The undecoded tail is kept so that characters stay whole.

按SSE边界组装一条事件。.en: Assembles one event along the SSE boundaries.

按调用ID累计arguments片段。.en: Accumulates the arguments fragments by call ID.

放大图解：字节、事件、参数三种完整性，分别用不同缓冲区处理.en: Enlarged figure: completeness of bytes, of events and of arguments are three things, each handled by a different buffer

此刻完整到哪层.en: Which level is complete at this moment

允许做什么.en: What it is allowed to do

汉字尚不完整.en: The Chinese character is not complete yet

继续缓存，不强行替换成乱码.en: Keep buffering; do not force it into garbled text

SSE data行尚无事件边界.en: the SSE data line has no event boundary yet

文字完整，事件未结束.en: The text is complete, the event is not finished

事件可完整，JSON还不完整.en: the event can be complete while the JSON is not

累计到对应调用.en: Accumulate it under the matching call

JSON可以尝试解析.en: parsing the JSON can be attempted

校验与授权后再执行.en: Execute only after validation and authorization

一个网络chunk可能包含半个字符、多个事件或半段JSON。因此不能用chunk.en: One network chunk may contain half a character, several events or half a stretch of JSON. The arrival of a chunk therefore cannot be treated as an action boundary.

三个缓冲器的键也不同：字节流按连接，事件按协议，参数按调用ID。把所有片段拼到一.en: The three buffers are keyed differently too: the byte stream by connection, the events by protocol, the arguments by call ID. Joining every fragment into one string lets parallel calls bleed into each other.

断流时保留“不完整”状态；修补括号使它能解析，可能改变模型原本想提交的参数。.en: When the stream breaks, keep the "incomplete" state; patching the brackets so that it parses may change the arguments the model meant to submit.

不要混淆：</strong>示意列出核心边界；完整SSE还要处理CRLF、多da.en: Do not conflate: the sketch lists the core boundaries; a complete SSE implementation also has to handle standard details such as CRLF and multiple data lines, so five lines of pseudocode are no complete parser.

流式工具调用：UTF-8完整、JSON完整、调用完整是三件事.en: Streaming tool calls: complete UTF-8, complete JSON and a complete call are three different things

流式返回：什么时候参数真的可以执行？.en: Streaming back: when can the arguments really be executed?

不能互相拼接.en: Cannot be concatenated with each other

参数增量按调用ID组装。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模.en: Argument deltas are assembled by call ID. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

第07课 · API与流式协议</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocolsLesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactions

结果先回来，不代表它属于第一个调用.en: A result arriving first does not mean it belongs to the first call

Schema通过后，还有业务合法性与授权两层检查.en: Once the schema passes, two layers of checking remain: business validity and authorization

本例条件：</strong>独立工具delete_file要求path为字符串、.en: Conditions for this example: an independent tool delete_file requires path to be a string and recursive to be a boolean. The input {"path":"secrets/key","recursive":false} matches those types, but is not thereby authorized to delete anything.

字段与类型满足Schema。.en: The fields and types satisfy the Schema.

目标存在、适用且在授权范围。.en: The target exists, applies, and is within what is authorized.

严格结构输出主要约束模型生成的形状，不知道你的运行目录、用户身份或对象是否已过期.en: Strict structured output mainly constrains the shape of what the model generates; it knows nothing about your working directory, the user's identity, or whether an object has expired.

拒绝、截断与响应不完整也应单独处理；不要在没有完整工具项时硬取arguments.en: Refusal, truncation and an incomplete response should each be handled separately; do not force the arguments out while the tool item is still incomplete.

让程序承担已知的确定性校验，模型负责在合法操作范围内决策，二者职责更清楚。.en: Let the program carry the known deterministic checks and let the model decide within the range of legal operations; the division of responsibility is then clearer.

不要混淆：</strong>给Schema增加“请不要删敏感文件”的descri.en: Do not conflate: adding a description of "please do not delete sensitive files" to the schema is only a behavioral hint, not a runtime permission check.

严格JSON为什么仍不能直接驱动数据库写入？.en: Why can strict JSON still not drive a database write directly?

第29课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 29. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then the counterexamples and the fix, and test the limits last.

11｜工具设计与MCP：从连接到可控执行.en: 11｜Tool design and MCP: from connection to controlled execution

宿主与外部工具或资源服务器交互的一套协议。 例：不是Agent间全部通信的总称。.en: A protocol by which a host interacts with an external tool or resource server. Example: it is not a blanket term for all communication between agents.

SQL、SQLite与事务对象.en: SQL, SQLite and the transaction object

SQL是操作关系数据的语言；SQLite是可嵌入应用的数据库引擎。将操作状态写入.en: SQL is the language for working with relational data; SQLite is a database engine that embeds into an application. Writing operational state into a database is a persistence action by the host program; it does not modify the model's neural network parameters.<span class="concept-micro">One transaction can save the business row in this database together with a pending-send record, but that does not let you infer that the mail service committed atomically along with it.

工具粒度要按常见工作单元，而非函数越少越好.en: Tool granularity should follow the common unit of work, rather than the idea that fewer functions is better

供Agent按需使用的专业指导及关联资源。 例：不同于模型新增了一组权重。.en: Expert guidance, and the resources that go with it, for an agent to use when needed. Example: not the same as the model gaining a new set of weights.

工具存在、模型看见、能调用、获授权：四层检查.en: The tool exists, the model sees it, it can be called, it is authorized: four layers of checking

MCP中的应用宿主、协议客户端与提供能力的服务器角色。 例：一个宿主可通过多个客.en: The roles in MCP: the application host, the protocol client and the server that provides capabilities. Example: one host can connect to different servers through several clients.

JSON-RPC约定怎样用JSON表示方法、参数、标识和结果；stdio使用进程.en: JSON-RPC lays down how a method, its arguments, an identifier and a result are represented in JSON; stdio communicates over a process's standard input and output; HTTP is a network request protocol at another layer. The name of a protocol carries no permission with it.<span class="concept-micro">When stdout carries protocol messages, ordinary debug logs should be kept out of that stream and usually go to stderr; otherwise even legitimate logs can break message parsing.

MCP先协商能力，再发现工具，最后才尝试调用.en: MCP negotiates capabilities first, then discovers tools, and only then attempts a call

MCP能连接却少了工具：初始化、分页和错误层级怎样逐项查？.en: MCP connects but the tools are missing: how are initialization, pagination and the error levels checked one by one?

资源、提示、工具和Skill，用同一任务看分工.en: Resources, prompts, tools and skills: their division of labour seen on one task

第08课 · 工具与MCP</a><a class=\"pill\" href=.en: Lesson 08 · Tools and MCPLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactionsLesson 29 · Security basics

错误发生在哪一层，决定该修参数还是修连接.en: Which layer the error happens in decides whether to fix the parameters or fix the connection

令牌受众、权限范围与会话ID：三种“凭证”不能互相替代.en: Token audience, permission scope and session ID: three kinds of "credential" that cannot stand in for one another

12｜Codex、Claude Code、Copilot：从公开事实到可诊断运行.en: 12｜Codex, Claude Code, Copilot: from public fact to a diagnosable execution chain

比较编码产品时，先使用同一条公开的可诊断链：上下文组成、模型提议、宿主执行、结果.en: When comparing coding products, start from the same public, diagnosable chain: how the context is composed, what the model proposes, how the harness executes, how the result is filled back in, how state is recovered. Whatever a closed-source product has not published about its internals stays unknown; the teaching swimlanes are not a joint claim about the line-by-line source of all three products.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F26.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 11 · Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundaryLesson 22 · Compaction must keep the facts an action depends onLesson 13 · A skill exists — so why can it still be of no use at all?

这些是所引用Codex源码快照中的程序类型名。ResponseItem表示一项模.en: These are program type names from the cited snapshot of the Codex source. ResponseItem stands for one model response; ToolCall stands for the data of a call waiting to be made; ToolInvocation combines the call with execution context such as the session and cancellation; ToolRouter is responsible for the relevant tool path. <span class="concept-micro">These objects are constructed and dispatched by the program; they are not tensors of the kind the model uses internally for Q/K/V. Field and permission handling must follow the pinned source cited, not be inferred from the names.

退避让重试间隔增加；jitter加入随机扰动避免请求同时重试。取消信号是请求停止.en: Backoff makes the interval between retries grow; jitter adds a random perturbation so that requests do not all retry at the same moment. A cancellation signal is notice that a stop has been requested; it does not withdraw external side effects already committed. <span class="concept-micro">A read-only request whose connection fails temporarily can be retried; when the result of a write request is unknown, verify first. "Retry for longer" is no substitute for permission or idempotence design.

读源码时，把“注册、暴露、构造调用、分派”拆开.en: When reading the source, take "register, expose, construct the call, dispatch" apart

本例条件：</strong>本图是对本书已注明固定提交的Codex代码阅读方法，.en: Conditions for this example: this figure covers the method of reading the Codex code at the commit this book has pinned; it does not claim that the internals of every current version are the same. The tool name read_file is used as a teaching placeholder and is not claimed to be the specific native tool name in that snapshot.

宿主持有的运行时实现集合。.en: The set of runtime implementations the host holds.

本轮给模型看的能力说明。.en: The capability descriptions shown to the model this turn.

把已构造的调用交到对应执行实现。.en: Hands the call it has constructed to the matching execution implementation.

不能越级推出什么.en: What it cannot be stretched to conclude

registry存在实现.en: an implementation exists in the registry

不代表本轮可见.en: does not mean it is visible this turn

本轮specs包含名字或可延迟发现.en: This turn's specs contain the name, or discovery can be deferred

不代表模型已调用.en: does not mean the model has called it

不代表已经授权成功.en: does not mean authorization has succeeded

不代表handler执行完成.en: does not mean the handler finished running

还需判断用户任务是否满足.en: Whether the user's task is satisfied still has to be judged

沿着一个调用ID或工具身份穿过各阶段，比只搜索一次“工具名存在”更能定位缺失环节.en: Following one call ID or tool identity through the stages locates the missing link better than a single search for "the tool name exists".

阅读函数名应配合调用方、参数和测试；单个router片段不能证明所有沙箱和权限路.en: Reading a function name should go together with its callers, its parameters and its tests; one router fragment is no proof of every sandbox and permission path.

压缩替换历史是另一条链，需单独看快照、候选摘要、提交与并发新事件，不能因为有co.en: Replacing the history by compaction is a separate chain: the snapshot, the candidate summary, the commit and concurrent new events have to be looked at on their own; the presence of a compact function does not let you infer that nothing is lost.

不要混淆：</strong>厂商未公开的系统Prompt、内部推理或后台调度，不.en: Do not conflate: a system prompt, internal reasoning or background scheduling that the vendor has not published should not be inferred into fact from the look of a log.

Codex源码追问：注册、可见、可达、获授权为什么要分四步？.en: Pressing the Codex source: why are registered, visible, reachable and authorized four separate steps?

第13课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 13. Reading order: confirm the runtime contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

开源Codex与Claude工程文章怎样对照，才不制造冲突？.en: How can the open-source Codex and the Claude engineering articles be read against each other without manufacturing a conflict?

子Agent继承什么，要逐字段检查而不是说“全继承”.en: What a sub-agent inherits has to be checked field by field, rather than declared to be "all of it"

本例条件：</strong>独立主子Agent实验：主任务有规则R、证据E、工具.en: Conditions for this example: an independent main/sub-agent experiment: the main task has rule R, evidence E, tool set T and credential P. Whether each is passed to the sub-task is decided by the real product configuration; the figure below is a checklist to verify, not an invented default behavior.

新上下文实际获得的内容与能力。.en: The content and the capability the new context actually receives.

有自己消息历史，不等于没有任何配置。.en: Having its own message history does not mean it has no configuration at all.

执行器给予的权限，不是任务文本。.en: The permissions the executor grants, not the text of the task.

是否自动载入项目说明.en: Whether the project instructions load automatically

子请求或可见配置.en: The sub-request or the visible configuration

主Agent读过的代码是否转交.en: Whether the code the main agent has read is handed over

是否有下游访问身份.en: Whether it has a downstream access identity

返回结论还是工件与证据.en: Returns a conclusion, or artifacts and evidence

主Agent说“去修同一个问题”只给了目标，可能没给根因证据；子Agent因此重.en: When the main agent says "go and fix the same problem" it has given only the goal, perhaps without the root-cause evidence; the sub-agent therefore searches again, which does not necessarily mean its capability got worse.

工具权限可以比父级更窄。不能靠在子任务文字里写“沿用全部权限”来扩大实际能力。.en: A tool's permissions can be narrower than the parent's. Writing "inherit all permissions" into the text of a sub-task does not widen what it can actually do.

用可复查探针确认每一列，结论标明产品入口与版本；不要把一次行为推广到所有版本。.en: Confirm every column with probes that can be re-checked, and state the product entry point and version in the conclusion; do not generalize one observed behavior to every version.

不要混淆：</strong>为了省Token只回传“已完成”，会丢掉文件版本、失.en: Do not conflate: reporting back only "done" to save tokens loses the file version, the failed items and the test evidence, and leaves the main agent unable to verify the result.

规则文件加载与子Agent继承，为什么不能只说“自动继承”？.en: Rule-file loading and subagent inheritance: why is "inherited automatically" not enough to say?

子Agent只收到摘要，为什么它不知道主Agent的限制.en: The subagent receives only the summary, so why does it not know the main agent's restrictions

输入与条件。</strong>主任务有约束“只读，不修改文件”。父Agent委派.en: Input and conditions.The main task carries the constraint "read only, do not modify files". The parent agent delegates "investigate the configuration problem", and the sub-agent has a context of its own.

用户原话明确禁止修改.en: The user's own words explicitly forbid modification

限制在父会话可见。.en: The restriction is visible in the parent session only.

不能假设子会话自动包含整段原历史。.en: One cannot assume that a sub-session automatically contains the whole original history.

追加只读范围、具体问题、仓库版本和证据路径.en: Add the read-only scope, the specific question, the repository version and the evidence paths

不必复制无关长对话。.en: There is no need to copy a long, unrelated conversation across.

宿主对子任务只提供只读能力.en: The host gives the subtask read-only capability only

自然语言要求与工具权限共同约束。.en: Constrained jointly by the natural-language requirement and the tool's permissions.

子Agent提供发现、证据和未解决问题.en: The subagent supplies findings, evidence and open questions

父Agent仍负责用户整体目标。.en: The parent agent remains responsible for the user's overall goal.

把过程连起来。</strong>独立上下文节省父上下文成本，同时也需要有意识地传.en: Join the steps up. A separate context saves cost in the parent context, and at the same time it requires the necessary constraints to be passed on deliberately.

边界与反例。</strong>这是独立子Agent模式的风险示例，不断言任何当前.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is a risk example for an independent sub-agent pattern; it asserts nothing about which fields any current product inherits by default. The configuration must be checked against the public documentation and the actual request.

同样叫子Agent，为什么Claude与Copilot的“继承”不能凭感觉？.en: Both are called a subagent, so why can "inheritance" in Claude and in Copilot not be taken on intuition?

IDE、CLI与云端任务的工作区不是天然同一份.en: The workspaces of the IDE, the CLI and a cloud task are not naturally one and the same

本例条件：</strong>独立产品比较方法：同一仓库commit=r7，但ID.en: Conditions for this example: an independent method for comparing products: the same repository commit=r7, but the file is unsaved in the IDE, the CLI sees the disk, and the cloud may have only the commits that were pushed. Only potential differences are listed here; in practice, check against the version and configuration you are using.

尚未落盘的文字。.en: Text not yet written to disk.

本地文件系统的当前状态。.en: The current state of the local file system.

运行环境取得的指定提交或工件。.en: The specified commit or artifact that the run environment obtained.

核对选区、缓冲区与附件.en: Check the selection, the buffer and the attachments

r7 + 已落盘修改w1.en: r7 + the change w1 already written to disk

读取工作树内容与diff.en: Read the working-tree content and the diff

已推送r7或指定快照.en: r7 or the specified snapshot has been pushed

核对checkout版本和依赖.en: Check the checkout version and the dependencies

“模型一样、问题一样”不代表输入一样。入口差异可能在模型调用之前就决定了它看见的.en: "Same model, same question" does not mean the same input. A difference at the entry point may have decided which version of the code it sees before the model was ever called.

先固定commit、工作树diff、环境与权限，再比较结果，否则把环境差异归因于.en: Pin the commit, the working-tree diff, the environment and the permissions before comparing results; otherwise a difference in environment is attributed to the model, which makes the experiment wrong.

云端测试通过后，还要确认结果对应最终下载或合并的工件，而不是另一个尚未同步版本。.en: After a cloud test passes, you still have to confirm that the result corresponds to the artifact finally downloaded or merged, and not to another version that has not been synchronised yet.

不要混淆：</strong>聊天里粘贴了新代码，不等于测试进程执行的文件已变成新.en: Do not conflate: new code pasted into the chat does not mean the file the test process runs has become the new code; the model's view and the execution environment have to be checked separately.

在指定执行节点运行的程序性操作。 例：适合必须执行的检查，但也会带来延迟与失败面.en: A programmatic operation that runs at a designated execution point. Example: suited to a check that must happen, but it also brings latency and a failure surface.

把“它不懂我项目”改成可以排除的四个假设.en: Turn "it does not understand my project" into four hypotheses you can rule out

本例条件：</strong>独立故障：Agent忽略“不要修改公共签名”。要判断.en: Conditions for this example: an independent failure: the agent ignores "do not change public signatures". What has to be judged is whether the rule was never supplied, was truncated, was misapplied, or was not blocked at execution time.

最终提交给模型的可见字段。.en: The visible fields finally submitted to the model.

上下文预算处理导致内容消失。.en: Handling of the context budget made the content disappear.

执行器实际接受的参数与修改。.en: The arguments and edits the executor actually accepts.

若发现为真.en: If it turns out to be true

最终请求搜索规则原句.en: Search the final request for the rule's original sentence

发出但行为违反.en: Sent, but the behavior breaks it

响应候选与规则对照.en: Compare the response candidate against the rule

调整模型/说明并评测.en: Adjust the model or the instructions, then evaluate

错误候选仍落地.en: The wrong candidate still takes effect

权限或契约检查记录.en: The permission or contract check record

每次先选择能区分假设的最小检查。只有最后行为不对，不能直接断言整个模型不懂业务。.en: Each time, pick the smallest check that can tell the hypotheses apart. A wrong final behavior alone does not license the claim that the whole model does not understand the business.

在发现规则根本没发出后，继续润色规则措辞没有因果作用，因为模型仍然看不到它。.en: Once it is found that the rule was never sent at all, polishing its wording further has no causal effect, because the model still cannot see it.

修复后用同类反例回归，确认问题消失而其他任务没有退化；诊断应回到可复现实验。.en: After the fix, run a regression with counterexamples of the same kind to confirm the problem is gone and that no other task has degraded; diagnosis should come back to a reproducible experiment.

不要混淆：</strong>一次偶然成功不足以证明根因已修复；必须记录相同输入条.en: Do not conflate: one chance success is not enough to prove the root cause has been fixed; the change under identical input conditions and the necessary repeat trials have to be recorded.

13｜每一轮Prompt怎样组装：上下文是一条数据管线.en: 13｜How each turn's prompt is assembled: context is a data pipeline

上下文不是把所有文字连接起来就完成。先选本轮必需对象，再检查来源和依赖，再为输出.en: Context is not finished by stringing all the text together. First pick the objects this turn needs, then check their provenance and dependencies, then leave budget for the output and for any tool results. The budget in the figure is a teaching round number, not a token count measured after an API call.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F26.html\">每轮.en: Related step-by-step process: Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundary. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F28.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 16 · Retrieval finds candidates first, then judges whether they can answerLesson 22 · Compaction must keep the facts an action depends onO10 · Compaction, retrieval and prompt cache: three different kinds of saving

上下文预算，先扣掉必须保留的空间再选资料.en: In a context budget, subtract the space that must be kept before selecting material

本例条件：</strong>独立教学窗口100个计量单位。这里单位是简化预算，不.en: Conditions for this example: an independent teaching window of 100 budget units. The unit here is a simplified budget, not a real token count for any model. Rules take 20, tools 10, the task 10, the output reserve 20 and the safety margin 5, leaving the rest for evidence.

本轮可提交内容的总上限。.en: The overall limit on what can be submitted this turn.

为本次生成留出的空间。.en: The space set aside for this generation.

选择内容时计入的成本；实际需用匹配Tokenizer。.en: The cost counted when content is chosen; in practice a matching tokenizer must be used.

放大图解：上下文预算，先扣掉必须保留的空间再选资料.en: Enlarged figure: the context budget — subtract the space that must be kept, then choose the material

可放A=20+B=15，不可再加C=10.en: A=20+B=15 fit; C=10 cannot be added as well

先扣输出和必要约束，再讨论该选哪些文件。如果先把所有证据塞满，最后就可能被迫截掉.en: Set aside the output and the necessary constraints first, and only then discuss which files to choose. If all the evidence is packed in first, you may end up having to cut the rules, or left with no room to generate.

证据A与B是否充分还要看内容依赖，35个单位不是越填满越好；无关材料会占预算而不.en: Whether evidence A and B are sufficient also depends on what the content relies on; the 35 units are not better the fuller they are, since irrelevant material takes up budget without making the question any more answerable.

实际窗口和推理Token规则依API与模型而变。本例只是预算算术，不能据此推断产.en: The real window and the rules for reasoning tokens vary with the API and the model. This example is only budget arithmetic; it supports no inference about product pricing or real capacity.

不要混淆：</strong>摘要只保留“错误发生在filter.py”，却去掉接.en: Do not conflate: a summary that keeps "the error happens in filter.py" but drops the interface constraint does fit the budget, yet the changes that follow may still drift off target.

1000 Token窗口不是1000 Token都能拿来放文档.en: A 1000-token window does not mean all 1000 tokens can hold documents

输入与条件。</strong>教学预算：总窗口1000，预留输出200和安全余量.en: Input and conditions.A teaching budget: a total window of 1000, with 200 reserved for output and 50 as a safety margin; instructions 150, tools 100, task state 150. The counts are given by the same teaching counter throughout.

三者共500，不能全放。.en: The three together come to 500, which will not all fit.

A/B直接支持当前决策，C仅背景.en: A and B support the current decision directly; C is background only

选A+B=300，输入总计700，保留50弹性。.en: Choose A+B=300; the input totals 700, leaving 50 of slack.

B若是工具结果.en: if B is a tool result

还要包含其必要调用身份与解释；不能切断协议依赖。.en: It must also carry the call identity and explanation it needs; the protocol dependency must not be cut.

若固定必要内容本身超过750.en: If the fixed, necessary content alone exceeds 750

需要减少暴露范围、换阶段或压缩，不能暗中丢用户约束。.en: The exposed scope has to be cut back, or a stage swapped, or something compacted; user constraints must not be dropped quietly.

把过程连起来。</strong>预算是在同一计数口径下做资源分配，而不是按“字符.en: Join the steps up. A budget allocates resources on one and the same counting basis; it does not truncate casually on "about the same number of characters".

边界与反例。</strong>真实推理Token与输入/输出占窗规则依模型和接口.en: Limits and counterexamples. How real reasoning tokens and input/output tokens take up the window depends on the model and the interface; the budget here is given explicitly and does not stand in for a vendor's billing rules.

上下文组装为什么不能只做“取前N条”？.en: Why can assembling context not just be "take the first N items"?

第08课 · 工具与MCP</a><a class=\"pill\" href=.en: Lesson 08 · Tools and MCPLesson 11 · Assembling contextLesson 13 · Skills, routing and multi-agent

Skill、JIT与触发描述.en: Skill, JIT and the trigger description

在能力加载场景，Skill是一组可复用指导与资源；JIT表示需要时再加载，不是必.en: In a capability-loading setting, a Skill is a reusable set of guidance and resources; JIT means loading only when needed, and does not necessarily mean a compiler's just-in-time compilation. A trigger description helps the model judge whether something applies; it does not grant tool permissions by itself.<span class="concept-micro">First judge whether the task needs a given skill, then read the details; a loaded skill is not the same as its requirements having actually been carried out.

只取命中的一行，可能把判断条件一起丢掉.en: Taking only the line that matched can throw away the condition for the judgment along with it

本例条件：</strong>独立源码证据：第18行return 10，只有读取第.en: Conditions for this example: independent source-code evidence: line 18 is return 10, and only by reading lines 15—17 can one know that it is controlled by a debug switch. The query hits line 18, but the current task concerns the production configuration.

为解释命中内容而必须带上的相关定义与条件。.en: The related definitions and conditions that have to come along if the hit is to be explained.

到需要时再读取，而非全部常驻上下文。.en: Read it when it is needed, instead of keeping all of it resident in the context.

信息少，但能支持当前判断。.en: Little information, but enough to support the judgment at hand.

能否回答生产超时.en: Can it answer the production timeout

不能，缺分支条件.en: No — the branch condition is missing

知道10仅用于debug.en: You learn that 10 is only used for debug

该分支生产不生效.en: That branch does not take effect in production

生产超时应查30.en: The production timeout should be read as 30

闭包不是把整个仓库都读完，而是补足当前结论真正依赖的条件。这里多读三行与一个配置.en: A closure is not reading the whole repository; it is filling in the conditions the current conclusion really depends on. Reading three more lines and one configuration here is worth more than reading ten more unrelated files.

JIT只决定何时取资料，不替代判断哪些资料是必需依赖。检索命中后仍需沿条件与引用.en: JIT only decides when material is fetched; it does not replace judging which material is a required dependency. After a retrieval hit, the conditions and the references still have to be followed outward.

扩展有停止标准：已经能解释当前现象、满足验收需要，再扩大范围应有新的疑问。.en: Expansion has a stopping rule: once the present phenomenon can be explained and acceptance is satisfied, widening the scope further should require a new question.

不要混淆：</strong>把“尽量少读”硬编码成每次只读一行，会系统性丢失函数.en: Do not conflate: hard-coding "read as little as possible" into reading one line at a time loses function contracts and branch conditions systematically.

上下文预算不只算已读文件：工具结果、生成与证据依赖还要预留.en: The context budget is not just the files already read: tool results, the generation and evidence dependencies all have to be reserved for as well

第17课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 17. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

I在矩阵公式里通常是单位矩阵：对角线为1，其他位置为0。尺寸合适时，向量或矩阵乘.en: In a matrix formula I is usually the identity matrix: 1 on the diagonal and 0 everywhere else. At a compatible size, multiplying a vector or a matrix by I leaves the numbers unchanged. Wq=Wk=I is a special case chosen deliberately; one cannot infer from it that the projections of a real model are all the same.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: I=[[1,0],[0,1]], and [3,-2]I=[3,-2]. I here is not the position subscript written as the letter i.

缓存前缀是在复用相同前段，不是复用“差不多的意思”.en: A cached prefix reuses an identical leading segment, not "roughly the same meaning"

本例条件：</strong>独立Token序列：请求A=[R1,R2,T1,U1.en: Conditions for this example: independent token sequences: request A=[R1,R2,T1,U1]; request B=[R1,R2,T1,U2]; request C=[R1,new,T1,U2]. Only whether the prefixes agree is compared; no particular service's retention time or billing is assumed.

从序列开头连续相同的部分。.en: The identical run from the start of the sequence.

尽量不随任务变化的规则和工具描述。.en: Rules and tool descriptions kept as free as possible of task-to-task variation.

改变输入内容，不是给缓存做同义改写。.en: Changes the input content; it is not a synonymous rewrite for the cache's benefit.

放大图解：缓存前缀是在复用相同前段，不是复用“差不多的意思”.en: Enlarged figure: a cached prefix reuses an identical opening stretch, not "roughly the same meaning"

之后是否还能直接续前缀.en: whether the prefix can still be continued directly afterwards

R1,R2,T1共3项.en: R1, R2, T1 — 3 items in all

最后用户项不同，前3项仍相同.en: The last user item differs; the first 3 items are still the same

中间new打断；后面T1相同也不续接.en: a new item in the middle breaks it; an identical T1 afterwards does not reconnect either

语义近似不能证明计算可复用.en: Similar meaning is no proof that the computation can be reused

前缀共享从左往右停止在第一处差异，不是把两串Token里所有相同片段找出来拼缓存.en: Prefix sharing runs from left to right and stops at the first difference; it does not find every identical fragment in the two token strings and stitch a cache out of them.

把时间戳等高频变化内容放在最前面，可能提前打断公共前缀。工程上可将稳定指令与变化.en: Putting frequently changing content such as a timestamp right at the front can break the common prefix early. In engineering terms, stable instructions and changing data can be partitioned, but not in a way that violates instruction order or security semantics.

压缩减少长度的收益，要与额外压缩调用、缓存重新建立及质量变化一起算。.en: The gain from the shorter length compaction brings has to be counted together with the extra compaction call, the cache being rebuilt, and the change in quality.

不要混淆：</strong>缓存命中率提高但关键约束失效，是错误优化；缓存身份还.en: Do not conflate: a higher cache hit rate with a key constraint broken is the wrong optimization; the cache identity also has to include the state conditions the model and the implementation require.

语义没变却缓存失效：精确前缀、工具规格与动态字段怎样相互影响？.en: The meaning has not changed and yet the cache misses: how an exact prefix, the tool specifications and dynamic fields affect one another

指令冲突与事实冲突，不能用同一“最新优先”解决.en: An instruction conflict and a fact conflict cannot both be settled by the same "latest wins"

本例条件：</strong>独立项目问答：项目规则要求不发送密钥；新抓网页要求上.en: Conditions for this example: an independent project question: the project rules require that no key be sent; a newly crawled web page asks for a key to be uploaded. There is also a configuration at the same permission level: the old default is 30, the new version's default is 10. The two kinds of conflict are looked at separately.

谁有权要求执行动作。.en: Who has the authority to require that an action be carried out.

事实对哪个项目、版本、时间有效。.en: Which project, version and time the fact is valid for.

记录或发布的时间，不自动等于生效时间。.en: The time of recording or publication is not automatically the time it takes effect.

项目禁止泄露 / 新网页要求上传.en: The project forbids disclosure / a new web page asks for an upload

网页不能提升为指令权威.en: A web page cannot be promoted to instruction authority

当前运行版本决定适用值.en: The running version decides which value applies

今天得知下周改为10.en: Learned today that it changes to 10 next week

新网页比项目规则晚出现，也不能因此改变安全边界。这里“最新”不是授权。.en: A new web page appearing later than the project rules still cannot change the security boundary. "Latest" here is not authorization.

同一权限的业务事实要核对版本和生效时间，不能只按消息排列决定哪个是真。.en: A business fact under the same permission has to be checked against the version and the time it takes effect; which one is true cannot be decided by the order of the messages alone.

把结论写成“v2自某日开始默认10”比孤立写“默认10”更容易在后续检索中保持正.en: Writing the conclusion as "from such a date, v2 defaults to 10" stays correct in later retrieval more easily than writing "the default is 10" on its own.

不要混淆：</strong>给所有来源一个综合相关性分数后直接选最高，会把权限、.en: Do not conflate: giving every source one combined relevance score and then taking the highest blends permission, freshness and semantic match into a ranking that cannot be audited.

14｜上下文压缩：到底压掉什么，丢失后又如何恢复.en: 14｜Context compaction: what is actually compacted, and how it is recovered once lost

压缩最危险的不是少一句背景，而是把“未执行”写成“已完成”，把“禁止”写成“准备.en: The most dangerous thing in compaction is not a missing line of background but writing "not executed" as "done", and "forbidden" as "about to be done". Check the propositions, versions, negations and open states against this figure first, and only then consider how many tokens to cut.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F27.html\">压缩.en: Related step-by-step process: Compaction must keep the facts an action depends on. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F24.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatO10 · Compaction, retrieval and prompt cache: three different kinds of saving

四种“节省上下文”操作，保留的东西完全不同.en: Four ways of "saving context" that keep completely different things

压缩结果为什么不能只留下那个“看起来最浓缩”的项目？.en: Why can the result of compaction not keep only the item that "looks most condensed"?

异步摘要生成期间又来了工具结果，怎样不丢数据？.en: A tool result arrives while the summary is being generated asynchronously — how is data kept from being lost?

S基于原前缀.en: S is based on the original prefix

不安装旧候选.en: The stale candidate is not installed

摘要生成与实时后缀的合并。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业.en: Merging the generated summary with the live suffix. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

压缩候选生成期间，新工具结果不能被旧快照覆盖.en: While a compaction candidate is being produced, a new tool result must not be overwritten by the old snapshot

本例条件：</strong>独立并发例：历史版本v8包含事件1—8；压缩器读取v.en: Conditions for this example: independent concurrency example: history version v8 contains events 1—8; after the compactor has read v8, a new tool result arrives as event 9. The candidate summary still covers only 1—8.

某一时刻固定的历史版本。.en: A history version fixed at one moment in time.

还没成为正式上下文的压缩结果。.en: A compaction result that has not yet become the official context.

提交时只在当前版本仍等于预期版本时写入。.en: At commit time, write only if the current version still equals the expected version.

工具结果9追加成v9.en: Tool result 9 is appended as v9

用摘要替换整个历史.en: Replaces the whole history with the summary

确认摘要只替换前缀1—8.en: Confirms that the summary replaces only the prefix 1—8

摘要 + 原样保留事件9.en: Summary + event 9 kept as it is

问题不是摘要写得差，而是它来自旧版本，却替换了更新后的对象。内容正确也可能因提交.en: The problem is not that the summary is badly written but that it comes from an old version and yet replaced an object that had been updated. Content can be correct and still lose data because of the order of commits.

暂停执行形成安全边界最容易解释，但会影响吞吐；并发压缩需显式前缀范围或版本条件更.en: Pausing execution to form a safety boundary is the easiest thing to explain, but it costs throughput; concurrent compaction needs an explicit prefix range or a version-conditional update.

工具调用及其结果要成对保留。不能只留“调用过c1”，却把刚到达的c1结果覆盖掉。.en: A tool call and its result have to be kept as a pair. You cannot keep only "c1 was called" while overwriting the c1 result that has just arrived.

不要混淆：</strong>先检查版本再不加锁地写入，检查与写之间仍可插入新事件.en: Do not conflate: checking the version first and then writing without a lock still leaves room for a new event between the check and the write; a conditional commit has to be atomic to match.

摘要生成期间又发生一个工具结果，怎样不丢掉它.en: Another tool result arrives while the summary is being generated: how is it kept from being lost

输入与条件。</strong>开始压缩时历史版本h=20；工具c7尚在运行。摘要.en: Input and conditions.When compaction starts the history version is h=20 and tool c7 is still running. While the summary for 1—20 is being generated, c7 finishes and event 21 is appended to the history.

记录压缩覆盖到事件20.en: Record that the compaction covers up to event 20

给候选摘要一个明确边界。.en: Give the candidate summary an explicit boundary.

它不可能凭空知道还没出现的21。.en: It has no way of knowing about 21, which has not appeared yet.

不能拿候选摘要直接覆盖全部历史。.en: A candidate summary must not simply overwrite the whole history.

摘要代表1—20，随后保留原事件21.en: The summary stands for 1—20, and the original event 21 is kept after it

维护call_id配对与顺序。.en: Maintain the pairing and the order of call_id.

若事件21改变了摘要中的关键状态.en: If event 21 changed a key state in the summary

重建当前状态或重新压缩，不能让succeeded同时仍标pending。.en: Rebuild the current state or compact again; succeeded must not still be marked pending at the same time.

新历史和其版本标识一起切换.en: The new history and its version marker switch over together

避免下一轮看见半旧半新的组合。.en: Keeps the next turn from seeing a half-old, half-new mixture.

把过程连起来。</strong>压缩是有并发写入风险的状态转换，不只是调用一次“.en: Join the steps up. Compaction is a state transition with a risk of concurrent writes, not just one call to a "summarize" model.

边界与反例。</strong>这是可选设计模式，不声称所有厂商实现相同；只对不可.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is an optional design pattern, and no claim is made that every vendor implements it the same way; the simple concatenation holds only for an immutable append-only history.

压缩期间工具结果刚好回来：一次历史替换如何丢掉真实进展？.en: A tool result arrives just as compaction runs: how does one history replacement lose real progress?

找回证据需要内容身份，而不只是一个文件名.en: Recovering evidence takes a content identity, not just a file name

本例条件：</strong>独立压缩记录：摘要说“filter.py的第18行导.en: Conditions for this example: an independent compaction record: the summary says "line 18 of filter.py causes the problem". The file was later changed to r8, and line 18 is now a different piece of code.

文件内容对应的提交、哈希或快照。.en: The commit, hash or snapshot the file content corresponds to.

原始证据在该版本的哪一段。.en: Which part of that version the original evidence sits in.

为压缩而重述的判断，仍需追溯。.en: A judgment restated for the sake of compaction still has to be traceable.

读当前第18行.en: Read line 18 as it stands now

读到r8新内容，不是原证据.en: You read the new content at r8, not the original evidence

取r7的指定范围.en: Take the specified range from r7

可复查原始结论.en: The original conclusion can be re-checked

发现错版本或被替换.en: Finds a wrong version, or a replacement

旧证据恢复后.en: After the old evidence is restored

比较当前r8差异.en: Compare the difference against the current r8

判断旧结论还是否适用.en: Judge whether the old conclusion still applies

文件路径指位置，版本指具体内容。两者都要有，才能区分“找得到文件”和“找回同一份.en: A file path points to a location, a version to specific content. Both are needed to tell "the file can be found" from "the same evidence has been retrieved".

旧版本能被准确恢复，只证明过去的判断有依据；当前文件已经变化，是否还适用是下一道.en: That the old version can be restored accurately only proves that the earlier judgment had a basis; the current file has already changed, and whether it still applies is the next check.

代码片段与运行日志一起保存时，也要标明各自环境，避免把不同版本拼成一条假因果链。.en: When a code snippet and a run log are kept together, label the environment of each, so that different versions are not stitched into a false causal chain.

不要混淆：</strong>把摘要当成原始事实，长期叠加再摘要，会让假设逐渐失去.en: Do not conflate: treating a summary as the original fact, and stacking summary upon summary over time, gradually strips an assumption of its source and lets it be misremembered as verified.

Git提交快照与当前工作目录的内容。 例：未提交修改意味着二者可能不同。.en: The snapshot of a Git commit, and the contents of the current working directory. Example: an uncommitted change means the two may differ.

先检索外部材料，再让模型依据材料生成的系统模式。 例：有引用或有检索不自动保证回.en: A system pattern that retrieves external material first and then has the model generate from that material. Example: having citations, or having retrieval, does not automatically make an answer supported by evidence.

保真检查要问“还能正确做什么”，不只看摘要像不像.en: A fidelity check has to ask "what can still be done correctly", not just whether the summary looks right

本例条件：</strong>独立任务约束：不能改公共API；补丁已生成但未应用；.en: Conditions for this example: an independent task constraint: the public API must not change; the patch has been generated but not applied; the test passed on the old version r7. Use three questions to check the state before and after compaction.

关键语义及否定没有丢。.en: The key meaning and the negation have not been lost.

已计划、已执行、已验证不混淆。.en: Planned, executed and verified are kept distinct.

继续执行评测.en: Go on to run the evaluation

看压缩后任务实际能否推进。.en: See whether the task can actually move forward after compaction.

危险摘要会给的答案.en: The answer a dangerous summary would give

可以改公共签名吗？.en: May the public signature be changed?

略去“不”后变成可以.en: With the "not" dropped it becomes a yes

补丁是否已落盘？.en: Has the patch reached the disk?

没有，只生成候选.en: No; it only generates a candidate

测试证明当前补丁吗？.en: Does the test prove the current patch?

不证明，测试属于r7.en: No proof: the test belongs to r7
