三条探针都很短，但比词面相似度更接近真实风险。摘要即便使用了同样词语，也可能把时.en: All three probes are short, yet they come closer to the real risk than surface word similarity does. Even when a summary uses the same words, it can reverse the direction of time and of negation.

探针集合应在真实任务前定义重要约束，不能看完摘要后专挑它保留的部分提问。.en: The set of probes should define the important constraints before the real task; you cannot read the summary first and then ask only about the parts it happened to keep.

最后还要让任务继续，检查是否重复动作、越权修改或引用错版本。问答通过只是局部信号.en: In the end the task also has to continue, with a check for repeated actions, changes beyond the permissions granted, or the wrong version being cited. Passing the questions is only a local signal.

不要混淆：</strong>模型给自己的摘要打高分不等于保真，尤其当评分者与生成.en: Do not conflate: a model scoring its own summary highly is not fidelity, especially when the grader and the generator share the same blind spot.

15｜检索离线链路：文档怎样变成可查询索引.en: 15｜The offline retrieval chain: how a document becomes a queryable index

BM25及N、df、k₁、b.en: BM25 and N, df, k₁, b

BM25是词项检索打分公式。常见记号N是文档总数，df是含该词的文档数，tf是当.en: BM25 is a scoring formula for term-based retrieval. In the usual notation N is the total number of documents, df the number of documents containing the term, tf the term frequency in the current document, |D| the length of the current document and avgdl the average length; k₁ and b are the settings for term-frequency saturation and length correction.<span class="concept-micro">k₁ is not the Key vector k₁, and b is not a neural network bias. The score only orders candidates; 8.2 cannot be read as 82% accuracy.

ANN与HNSW：近似检索结构.en: ANN and HNSW: approximate retrieval structures

ANN在这里指近似最近邻搜索，不是泛指人工神经网络。HNSW是一种用分层近邻图缩.en: ANN here means approximate nearest-neighbor search, not artificial neural networks in general. HNSW is a structure that narrows the search using a hierarchical graph of near neighbors; its parameters affect recall, speed and memory.<span class="concept-micro">Finding something quickly is no guarantee of finding the exact nearest neighbors; nor does ANN recall equal the correctness of the final answer.

分块时，表头与例外条款可能是答案的一部分.en: When chunking, the table header and the exception clause may be part of the answer

索引构建时，哪些元数据一旦丢失就很难补回来？.en: Which metadata, once lost while the index is built, is hard to recover?

第16课 · 检索入门</a><a class=\"pill\" href=\".en: Lesson 16 · Retrieval, to begin withLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answer

TF计某词在当前文档出现次数；DF计包含它的文档数；IDF根据全库统计降低常见词.en: TF counts how often a term occurs in the current document; DF counts how many documents contain it; IDF uses whole-corpus statistics to lower the contribution of common words and raise that of rarer, more discriminating ones. All three are statistics, not the model's learning rate.<span class="concept-micro">If only 2 of 10 documents contain a word, DF=2; if the word occurs 3 times in one of them, TF=3 for that document. The two numbers are not interchangeable.

基于词频、文档频率及长度校正的一类词项相关性评分。 例：不理解所有同义表达，也不.en: A family of term-relevance scores based on term frequency, document frequency and a length correction. Example: it does not understand every synonymous phrasing, nor does it check facts directly.

BM25把词频与长度放在同一个分母里比较.en: BM25 compares term frequency and length inside the same denominator

本例条件：</strong>独立单词项例：k1=1.2、b=0.75、平均长度1.en: Conditions for this example: an independent single-term example: k1=1.2, b=0.75, average length 100, IDF fixed at 1, comparing only the term-frequency/length factor. A has length 100 and term frequency 2; B has length 1000 and term frequency 4.

本词在一文档出现几次。.en: How many times this term occurs in one document.

抑制长文档自然多次命中的优势。.en: Suppresses the advantage a long document naturally gets from matching several times.

重复次数增加，收益通常逐渐变小。.en: As the number of repeats grows, the gain usually tapers off.

放大图解：BM25把词频与长度放在同一个分母里比较.en: Enlarged figure: BM25 compares term frequency and length in one and the same denominator

虽然B出现4次多于A的2次，但它也长10倍。归一化分母更大，最终得分反而更低。.en: B occurs 4 times against A's 2, but it is also 10 times as long. Its normalizing denominator is larger, so its final score comes out lower instead.

IDF衡量这个词在集合里是否常见；本图固定为1，只隔离词频与长度影响，不声称是完.en: IDF measures whether the term is common in the collection; this figure fixes it at 1 so as to isolate the effect of term frequency and length alone, and makes no claim to be a complete, real retrieval score.

BM25不理解“否定”“过期”或用户权限；高词项分数仍只是候选信号。.en: BM25 does not understand "negation", "expired" or user permissions; a high term score is still only a candidate signal.

不要混淆：</strong>不同实现的IDF变体和参数可能不同，复算必须固定公式.en: Do not conflate: implementations may differ in their IDF variant and parameters; a recomputation has to fix the formula, and must not mix the score scales of two systems.

对比学习通过目标函数让配对表示更易匹配、非配对表示相对区分。CLIP式训练学习图.en: Contrastive learning uses an objective that makes paired representations easier to match and keeps unpaired ones relatively distinct. CLIP-style training learns the association between image and text; it does not automatically provide full chat generation or reliable desktop operation.<span class="concept-micro">One image with its correct caption can serve as a positive pair and the other captions as the contrast; training for relevance does not mean every generated conclusion is factually correct.

当前位置用于与候选比较的一组数。 例：q=[1,0]不是用户原话，而是投影后的表.en: The set of numbers the current position uses to compare against the candidates. Example: q=[1,0] is not the user's own words but the representation after projection.

向量同维度，不代表能放在同一个相似度空间.en: Vectors with the same number of dimensions need not belong in the same similarity space

本例条件：</strong>独立二维示意：查询编码器q输出[1,0]，配套文档编.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-dimensional sketch: the query encoder q outputs [1,0], and with the matching document encoder the relevant document is [0.9,0.1]. Another model rotates every direction by 90°, leaving the dimension at 2.

查询与文档分别编码，用共同训练目标对齐。.en: Query and document are encoded separately and aligned by a shared training objective.

坐标所代表的关系来自训练，不是维度名称。.en: The relationships the coordinates stand for come from training, not from the names of the dimensions.

把长度标准化，常用于余弦或内积比较。.en: Standardize the length; commonly used before a cosine or inner-product comparison.

放大图解：向量同维度，不代表能放在同一个相似度空间.en: Enlarged figure: vectors of equal dimension do not belong in the same similarity space for that reason

同一训练对齐空间.en: The same space aligned by training

可按约定相似度排序.en: Can be ranked by the agreed similarity

维度相同，排名含义变了.en: The dimension is the same; what the ranking means has changed

重建文档索引并用新查询模型.en: rebuild the document index and use the new query model

还需重新评测相关性.en: relevance has to be evaluated again as well

数据库只会按数值算距离，不知道查询与文档是不是同一个训练空间。形状检查通过仍可能.en: The database only computes distances between numbers; it does not know whether the query and the document come from the same trained space. A passing shape check can still leave retrieval entirely distorted.

训练常用正确文档对与负例让相关项分数更高；这与“句子意思看起来近似”不是完全同一.en: Training usually uses correct document pairs and negative examples to push the relevant item's score higher; that is not quite the same objective as "the sentences look similar in meaning".

升级索引要记录编码器ID、归一化方法、维度与版本；否则同一索引里可能混入不同坐标.en: Upgrading an index means recording the encoder ID, the normalization method, the dimension and the version; otherwise different coordinate systems can end up mixed into one index.

不要混淆：</strong>向量相似度高不能替代条件核验，例如“允许”和“不允许.en: Do not conflate: high vector similarity is no substitute for checking the conditions — "allowed" and "not allowed" share many semantic features yet reach opposite conclusions.

向量维度相同，为什么查询和索引仍可能根本不在一个空间？.en: The vector dimensions are the same, so why can the query and the index still be in entirely different spaces?

近似最近邻搜索及其图索引方法之一。 例：加速候选查找可能牺牲部分召回。.en: Approximate nearest-neighbor search, and one of its graph index methods. Example: speeding up candidate lookup may cost some recall.

先检索少量候选再过滤，可能一个结果也剩不下.en: Retrieving a few candidates first and filtering afterwards can leave no result at all

向量查询带了WHERE，为什么仍可能返回不足k条？.en: The vector query carries a WHERE clause, so why can it still return fewer than k rows?

16｜检索在线链路：召回、融合、重排与证据充足性.en: 16｜The online retrieval chain: recall, fusion, reranking and evidence sufficiency

RRF对某文档在每条召回路径上的排名r贡献1/(c+r)，再相加。c是平滑常数，.en: For a document's rank r on each recall path, RRF contributes 1/(c+r), and these are added. c is a smoothing constant and r usually starts at 1; a candidate that did not appear on a path does not receive that path's contribution out of nowhere.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: with c=10 and a document ranked 1 and 3 on two paths, it gets 1/11+1/13, about 0.167832. This is not adding the raw BM25 and cosine scores together.

检索排名只说明候选顺序，不说明事实已经成立。下图固定两份候选排名逐项融合，再加入.en: A retrieval ranking says only what order the candidates are in, not that a fact has been established. The figure below fuses two fixed candidate rankings item by item, then adds judgments of version and evidence; if an answer needs two conditions, recalling only one of them is not enough.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F29.html\">从两.en: Related step-by-step process: From two candidate lists to usable evidence. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F28.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 16 · Retrieval finds candidates first, then judges whether they can answerLesson 05 · When reading a metric, first ask what its denominator isLesson 29 · Material can influence a model without thereby gaining permission

把各路排名的倒数形式相加来融合候选的一种方法。 例：按rank而非直接相加不同模.en: A method that fuses candidates by adding the reciprocal of their rank in each list. Example: it works on rank rather than adding different models' raw scores directly.

RRF融合的是排名，不是把BM25与余弦分数硬相加.en: What RRF fuses is ranks; it does not force the BM25 and cosine scores into a sum

本例条件：</strong>独立两路候选：词法A/B/C，向量B/C/A；排名从.en: Conditions for this example: two independent candidate routes: lexical A/B/C, vector B/C/A; ranks start at 1, k=60, and the two routes carry equal weight.

某项在一列表贡献1/(k+rank)。.en: An item contributes 1/(k+rank) from one list.

未召回则该列表没有贡献。.en: If it was not recalled, that list contributes nothing.

排序工具，不是概率。.en: A tool for ranking, not a probability.

放大图解：RRF融合的是排名，不是把BM25与余弦分数硬相加.en: Enlarged figure: RRF fuses ranks; it does not force BM25 and cosine scores together into a sum

两个排序列表怎样合并：排名贡献逐项相加.en: How two ranked lists are merged: the rank contributions are added item by item

B在两路都靠前.en: B is near the top on both paths

BM25可能几十，余弦可能小于1，直接相加会隐含任意尺度权重。RRF先只用相对名.en: BM25 may be in the tens while a cosine may be less than 1, so adding them directly hides an arbitrary weighting of the two scales. RRF uses only relative rank first, which avoids the mismatch of scales.

B不是某一路绝对分数最大才赢，而是两路综合名次较好。k越大，相邻名次的贡献差异通.en: B does not win by having the highest absolute score on one path, but by having the better combined rank across both. The larger k is, the smaller the difference in contribution between adjacent ranks usually becomes.

同一文档多个重复块若不合适地去重，可能被误当多份独立证据；融合分不直接代表事实被.en: If several near-duplicate chunks of one document are not deduplicated properly, they can be mistaken for several independent pieces of evidence; a fusion score does not in itself mean a fact was confirmed by several sources.

不要混淆：</strong>不同k、窗口和权重会改变结果。固定这些参数后再比较质.en: Do not conflate: a different k, window or weighting changes the result. Fix those parameters before comparing quality; two runs with different settings cannot be attributed to the retrieval model.

按总分降序.en: In descending order of total score

RRF不看原始分数，为什么重复来源仍会把排名带偏？.en: RRF ignores the raw scores, so why can duplicate sources still skew the ranking?

相关不等于可用：从召回到证据闭合.en: Relevant is not the same as usable: from recall to evidence closure

RRF按名次贡献，不加原始分数。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能.en: RRF contributes by rank and does not add raw scores. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

双编码器分别编码查询与文档，可以预存文档向量；交叉编码器共同处理一对查询与文档，.en: A bi-encoder encodes the query and the document separately, so document vectors can be stored in advance; a cross-encoder processes a query and a document together for a finer judgment, usually computing every pair. Reranking only orders candidates that have already been recalled.<span class="concept-micro">A correct document that was missed is not in the candidate set, and no reranker, however strong, can put it first; the recall has to be fixed first.

ColBERT类方法为查询和文档保留多个Token向量，再做后期交互。常见Max.en: ColBERT-style methods keep several token vectors for the query and for the document, then interact them late. The usual MaxSim takes, for each query token, the highest similarity with any document token, and then aggregates.<span class="concept-micro">It is not dual-encoder retrieval where "the whole document has only one vector", and it is not the self-attention output of each layer of a generative model.

Reranker更精细，是因为它有机会同时看查询与候选.en: A reranker is finer-grained because it gets to look at the query and the candidate together

ColBERT的“每个查询Token找最好匹配”怎样算.en: How ColBERT's "every query token finds its best match" is computed

输入与条件。</strong>两个查询向量q1=[1,0]、q2=[0,1]；文.en: Input and conditions.Two query vectors q1=[1,0] and q2=[0,1]; document A has d1=[0.8,0.6] and d2=[0,1], both of unit length.

两个查询位置的max相加.en: the maxima of the two query positions added together

得分约1.414214，A更高。.en: The score is about 1.414214, so A is higher.

把查询和文档联合送入模型.en: Feed the query and the document into the model together

不是固定做这个max规则，能建模更复杂的交互但通常更贵。.en: It does not apply this fixed max rule; it can model more complex interactions but usually costs more.

把过程连起来。</strong>单向量召回、多向量后交互和联合编码重排的计算路径.en: Join the steps up. Single-vector recall, multi-vector late interaction and joint-encoding reranking take different computation paths.

边界与反例。</strong>仅展示MaxSim数学核心，省略标记、投影、索引优.en: Limits and counterexamples. Only the mathematical core of MaxSim is shown; the markers, the projection and the index optimisations are left out. The dot-product conditions have been declared, and this cannot stand in for scoring by a real model.

一个结论需要哪些证据，逐句列出来才知道够不够.en: Which evidence a conclusion needs: only listing it sentence by sentence shows whether it is enough

本例条件：</strong>独立问题：“产品v2在生产环境的超时是否为10秒？”.en: Conditions for this example: an independent question: "is the timeout for product v2 in production 10 seconds?" The recall returned D1, which says 10 seconds for the test environment, D2, which says 30 seconds for production but for version v1, and D3, which says 10 seconds for v2 in production but takes effect tomorrow. The question is about today.

这段证据是否真正推出该结论。.en: Whether this piece of evidence really entails that conclusion.

版本、环境、时间等适用边界。.en: Limits of applicability such as version, environment and time.

还缺哪项关键条件。.en: Which key condition is still missing.

D3：v2生产=10，明天生效.en: D3: v2 production = 10, takes effect tomorrow

可写结论.en: What can be written as a conclusion

目前证据不足以确认今天为10.en: The evidence so far is not enough to confirm it is 10 today

应补查今天有效的v2规则.en: The v2 rule in force today should be looked up as well

三个看似相关的结果加在一起，也不自动得到一份适用于今天的完整证据。条件必须同时成.en: Adding three seemingly related results together does not automatically give one complete piece of evidence that applies today. The conditions have to hold at the same time.

答案可区分“明天起生效”和“今天未证实”，比只写最高相似度来源中的数值更可信。.en: An answer that distinguishes "takes effect tomorrow" from "not confirmed for today" is more trustworthy than one that merely states the number from the most similar source.

引用应贴在它支持的具体结论附近；一篇长文被引用，不表示其中所有陈述都获支持。.en: A citation should sit next to the specific conclusion it supports; citing a long document does not mean that every statement in it is supported.

不要混淆：</strong>引用数量多不能弥补逻辑缺口；同源转载十次也不是十份独.en: Do not conflate: a large number of citations does not fill a gap in the logic; the same source reposted ten times is not ten independent supports either.

相关、可引用、足以支持结论：证据要过三道不同的门.en: Relevant, citable, sufficient to support the conclusion: evidence must pass three different gates

第04课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 04. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

HyDE：假设文本只用于找材料.en: HyDE: the hypothetical text is only used to find material

用模型生成一份假设性的回答或文档，将其表示用于检索。这份生成文本是寻找证据的辅助.en: Have the model generate a hypothetical answer or document and use its representation for retrieval. That generated text is an aid to finding evidence, not a source of facts already found.<span class="concept-micro">The model guesses "it may be cache invalidation", which is reason enough to widen the search; before there is real evidence it must not be written up as "cache invalidation confirmed".

GraphRAG类方法利用实体关系及社区等组织信息；RAPTOR利用分层聚类与摘.en: GraphRAG-style methods use organizational information such as entity relationships and communities; RAPTOR uses hierarchical clustering and summaries to support retrieval. They introduce extra derived information, and with it problems of updating, provenance and error propagation.<span class="concept-micro">When the source document changes, an old summary or a relationship in the graph may be out of date. Changing the original text is no proof that every derived index has been updated with it.

利用图关系或分层摘要组织检索的不同方法。 例：结构可帮助跨文档问题，也会产生构建.en: Different ways of organising retrieval with graph relations or hierarchical summaries. Example: structure can help with questions that span documents, and it also brings a cost to build and maintain.

先定位检索失败类型，再决定是否增加高级RAG组件.en: Locate the type of retrieval failure first, then decide whether to add advanced RAG components

本例条件：</strong>独立四种问题，各自隔离一个缺口。图不给统一胜者，也不.en: Conditions for this example: four independent questions, each isolating one gap. The figure names no overall winner and does not claim to reproduce the paper's scores.

查询表达缺口.en: A gap in how the query is expressed

用户问法与资料表述差距大。.en: The way the user asks is far from how the material words it.

答案分散在多个层级或文档。.en: The answer is spread across several levels or documents.

当前召回内容不够或不可信。.en: What has been recalled is not enough or not trustworthy.

查询太短，词汇不对齐.en: The query is too short and its vocabulary does not line up

HyDE生成假设描述辅助检索.en: HyDE generates a hypothetical description to help retrieval

假设文本不能当事实.en: A hypothetical text cannot be taken for a fact

长文需要局部与摘要切换.en: A long document needs switching between the local text and a summary

摘要丢细节或版本过期.en: The summary loses detail, or its version is out of date

跨实体/社区做全局归纳.en: Generalising globally across entities or communities

建图维护与错误边传播.en: Graph maintenance and the propagation of wrong edges

需判断何时检索/纠正.en: When to retrieve or correct still has to be judged

Self-RAG、CRAG等研究.en: Research such as Self-RAG and CRAG

训练或流程成本与判断误差.en: The cost of training or of the pipeline, plus errors of judgment

同一关键词“RAG增强”背后可能改查询、改索引、改选择策略或改训练，不能当成一个.en: Behind the one keyword "enhanced RAG" there may be a change to the query, to the index, to the selection strategy or to the training; it cannot be treated as a single switch.

先用最小基线记录失败在哪一步，再挑对应方法。若问题是权限过滤错误，换更复杂的图索.en: Use the smallest baseline to record which step fails, then pick the matching method. If the problem is a permission-filter error, moving to a more elaborate graph index need not help at all.

评测时同时看正确率、证据可追溯、时效、成本和维护负担，而不只挑论文中的平均得分。.en: When evaluating, look at accuracy, traceability of evidence, timeliness, cost and maintenance burden together, rather than picking out the average score from a paper.

不要混淆：</strong>把论文机制简化成多写一句Prompt，不能声称已经实.en: Do not conflate: reducing a paper's mechanism to one extra line of prompt is no ground for claiming that the paper's system has been implemented.

17｜代码智能：从文本搜索到符号、版本与运行证据.en: 17｜Code intelligence: from text search to symbols, versions and run evidence

grep、AST、LSP、运行日志分别回答不同层的问题.en: grep, AST, LSP and run logs each answer questions at a different layer

本例条件：</strong>独立代码例：两个模块都定义parse；某处调用obj.en: Conditions for this example: an independent code example: two modules both define parse; somewhere obj.parse() is called. Finding the string parse alone cannot settle which implementation is called at run time.

解析后的语法结构树。.en: The syntax tree obtained after parsing.

编辑器与语言服务沟通定义、引用等能力的协议。.en: The protocol by which an editor talks to a language service about definitions, references and similar capabilities.

实际接收者类型可能在运行时才确定。.en: The actual receiver type may only be fixed at run time.

哪些是注释，哪些是调用.en: Which are comments and which are calls

在当前项目配置下推断定义与引用.en: Infer definitions and references under the current project configuration

反射、运行时注入的所有路径.en: Every path through reflection and runtime injection

其他输入是否也走同一路径.en: Whether other inputs take the same path too

每一层都不是上一层的万能替代。grep适合快速缩小范围，AST排除文本噪声，语言.en: No layer is a universal replacement for the one before it. grep is good for narrowing the range quickly, an AST rules out textual noise, a language service adds static semantics, and run evidence checks the actual path.

运行一次确定了一条路径，不等于证明所有输入都只走这条路径。诊断报告应注明样例输入.en: One run establishes one path; that is not proof that every input takes only this path. A diagnostic report should state the sample input and the environment.

某层失败后要识别原因：解析失败可能是语法版本，跳转错误可能是项目配置，不必直接归.en: When a layer fails, identify why: a parse failure may be a grammar version and a wrong jump may be the project configuration, so neither has to be attributed to the model.

不要混淆：</strong>LSP返回的字符位置也有编码约定，UTF-16偏移不.en: Do not conflate: the character positions LSP returns follow an encoding convention of their own; a UTF-16 offset cannot be taken as a Python character index without conversion.

代码位置的单位错一个，编辑就可能改错字符：UTF-8、UTF-16与版本号.en: Get the unit of a code position wrong by one and an edit can change the wrong characters: UTF-8, UTF-16 and version numbers

代码证据为什么需要工作树版本，而不只是commit？.en: Why does code evidence need the work-tree version, and not just the commit?

文件已被改成r8.en: The file has already been changed to r8

源码与证据版本链。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型实测.en: The source and the version chain of evidence. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering quality

HEAD、工作树、ETag与内容指纹.en: HEAD, working tree, ETag and content fingerprint

Git的HEAD标识当前检出的提交或分支位置；工作树还可能有未提交修改。ETag.en: Git's HEAD marks the commit or branch currently checked out; the working tree may still hold uncommitted changes. An ETag is a validator for an HTTP representation, and what it guarantees depends on the service. A content fingerprint is computed over the bytes; these kinds of version identity are not interchangeable. <span class="concept-micro">When the index comes from commit v7 but the file has been modified locally, the same file name does not mean the same content. Applying a patch or citing evidence should be checked against the version actually present.

同一路径，commit、工作树、编辑器可以有三份内容.en: For one path, the commit, the work tree and the editor can hold three different contents

本例条件：</strong>独立文件filter.py：仓库r7返回False，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent file filter.py: the repository at r7 returns False, the uncommitted file on disk has been changed to True, and the editor has added a further condition that is not saved. The index was built from r7.

版本库中的固定快照。.en: A fixed snapshot in the repository.

编辑器尚未保存的内容。.en: Content the editor has not saved yet.

解释已经过期.en: The explanation is out of date

测试对象与索引不同.en: The object under test is not the same as the index

还不是磁盘测试对象.en: not yet the object the on-disk test reads

读取当前内容并核对hash.en: Read the current content and check the hash

不把r7旧行号直接应用.en: Do not apply r7's old line numbers directly

这里不是时间越新越好这么简单，而是先确定“我们要修改和验证的工件到底是哪一个”。.en: It is not as simple as newer always being better; first settle "which artifact is the one we are going to change and verify".

每份证据携带版本；应用补丁前再次核对当前内容，避免基于旧索引覆盖用户的新修改。.en: Every piece of evidence carries a version; check the current content again before applying a patch, so that an old index does not overwrite the user's new change.

索引更新可以增量化，但删除、重命名和配置变化也会使关联失效，不能只监听新增文件。.en: Index updates can be incremental, but deletions, renames and configuration changes also make the links stale, so watching for new files alone is not enough.

不要混淆：</strong>只记录分支名main不足以定位工件，因为分支会移动；.en: Do not conflate: recording only the branch name main is not enough to identify an artifact, because a branch moves; a commit or content fingerprint is needed, together with the necessary working-tree diff.

HEAD没变为什么证据已经过期？工作树、未保存buffer与索引快照.en: HEAD has not moved, so why is the evidence already stale? The working tree, the unsaved buffer and the index snapshot

定位Bug：用能区分假设的输入，而不是盲目多读文件.en: Locating a bug: use input that can tell the hypotheses apart, rather than blindly reading more files

本例条件：</strong>独立目录排除Bug：规则vendor/应排除vend.en: Conditions for this example: an independent directory-exclusion bug: the rule vendor/ should exclude vendor/a.py and should not exclude myvendor/a.py. The original implementation treated string containment as a directory prefix.

用来击穿错误实现的小输入。.en: A small input that breaks a wrong implementation.

对错误原因的可验证解释。.en: A verifiable explanation of the cause of the error.

两种实现输出不同的位置。.en: The place where the two implementations output something different.

需先定义是根目录规则还是任意层目录.en: Whether the rule covers the root directory or a directory at any level has to be defined first

第一行通过不能证明算法正确，因为正确实现和错误实现都能过。第二行才区分了它们。.en: Passing the first row does not prove the algorithm correct, because a correct implementation and a wrong one both pass it. Only the second row tells them apart.

第三行提醒：有时不是代码错而是需求没定义。先固定规则语义，再写测试，否则Agen.en: The third row is a reminder: sometimes the code is not wrong, the requirement was never defined. Fix the meaning of the rule first, then write the test; otherwise the agent can only guess.

确认根因后做最小修改并回归相邻边界，比继续读更多无关文件更有效。.en: Once the root cause is confirmed, making the smallest change and running a regression on the adjacent boundaries is more effective than reading yet more unrelated files.

不要混淆：</strong>修改后若仅新增第一行测试，依然无法防止原来的错误实现.en: Do not conflate: if the change only adds the first line of test, it still does nothing to stop the original wrong implementation coming back.

业务规则要有可执行的例外，而不只是一句口号.en: A business rule needs an exception that can be executed, not just a slogan

本例条件：</strong>独立业务：退款通常不能超过已付款，但已退款金额也必须.en: Conditions for this example: an independent business case: a refund normally cannot exceed what has been paid, and the amount already refunded must also be deducted. The order was paid 100, 40 has been refunded, and 70 is requested this time. Amounts are in teaching points.

所有允许操作都应满足的约束。.en: A constraint every permitted operation should satisfy.

规则在这一笔操作前的真实数据。.en: The real data the rule sees before this particular operation.

具体输入与预期结果。.en: The concrete input and the expected result.

退款不超过付款.en: A refund does not exceed the payment

另一退款也可能改变已退.en: Another refund may change the amount already refunded as well

提交时需按当前状态原子校验.en: On submission it has to be validated atomically against the current state

懂业务不是把文档读得多，而是能把“约束、例外、状态、验证”连成明确判断。.en: Understanding the business is not reading a great many documents; it is being able to join "constraint, exception, state, verification" into an explicit judgment.

业务知识应放在可维护规则与测试中；Agent检索到规则后仍要读取当前订单状态。.en: Business knowledge belongs in maintainable rules and tests; after an agent retrieves a rule, it still has to read the current order state.

为了展示并发风险可以先用两次请求的时间线，不能把这条规则仅写成模型提示而没有执行.en: A timeline of two requests can serve to show the concurrency risk; this rule must not be written only as a hint to the model, with no protection at the execution end.

不要混淆：</strong>付款100不变不代表可退额不变；忽略已退和在途操作会.en: Do not conflate: a payment of 100 staying the same does not mean the refundable amount stays the same; ignoring refunds already made and operations in flight mistakes static knowledge for a live fact.

18｜长期记忆：写入、检索、冲突、失效与遗忘.en: 18｜Long-term memory: writing, retrieval, conflict, expiry and forgetting

记忆必须回答两个时间问题：事实什么时候生效，系统什么时候知道。下图用超时配置30.en: Memory has to answer two questions about time: when the fact took effect, and when the system knew it. The figure below follows the source, the valid time and the expiry of a timeout setting that goes from 30 seconds to 20, so that old knowledge is not simply repeated in a familiar tone.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F31.html\">长期.en: Related step-by-step process: Long-term memory is not a note that is always right. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F27.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 22 · Compaction must keep the facts an action depends onLesson 17 · From two candidate lists to usable evidence

四类记忆放在不同地方，才不会把临时假设当永久规则.en: Keep the four kinds of memory in different places and a temporary hypothesis will not be taken for a permanent rule

本例条件：</strong>独立仓库任务：正在定位Bug，曾经修过一次相似错误，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent repository task: a bug is being located, a similar error was fixed once before, the project forbids changing the API, and a set of reproduction steps exists.

当前任务暂时持有的状态。.en: State held temporarily by the current task.

某一次具体经历及其条件。.en: One specific episode and its conditions.

有来源和范围的事实或规则。.en: A fact or rule that has a source and a scope.

可复用的做事方法。.en: A reusable way of doing something.

当前怀疑是路径标准化.en: The present suspicion is path normalization

未验证，不升为项目事实.en: Not verified; not promoted to a project fact

上周r5修过大小写问题.en: r5 fixed a case-sensitivity problem last week

要核对是否同条件.en: Check whether the conditions were the same

公共API签名不改.en: The public API signature does not change

来源与有效版本可追溯.en: The source and the valid version are traceable

按任务风险适当简化.en: Simplified as far as the task's risk allows

“我记得上次这样修好了”只是一次经历，不能直接推出所有相似报错都有同一根因。.en: "I remember this fixed it last time" is one episode; it does not follow that every similar error message has the same root cause.

工作状态随任务完成失效，项目规则可能长期适用，保存期限与检索方式因此不同。.en: Working state goes stale once the task is done, while project rules may apply for a long time; their retention periods and retrieval methods therefore differ.

记忆系统不要求先建复杂图数据库；先把类型、来源、适用范围和撤销办法定义好。.en: A memory system does not require building a complex graph database first; define the type, the source, the scope of use and the way to withdraw an entry first.

不要混淆：</strong>把模型自我反思中的猜测写入永久语义库，会让后续任务反.en: Do not conflate: writing a guess from the model's own reflection into the permanent semantic store makes later tasks fetch the same error again and again.

TTL、有效时间与记录时间.en: TTL, valid time and record time

TTL是存储或缓存的到期设置；有效时间指事实何时适用；记录时间指系统何时知道。到.en: A TTL is an expiry setting on storage or a cache; valid time is when a fact applies; record time is when the system came to know it. An expiry policy cannot stand in for verifying the fact and its source.<span class="concept-micro">A rule that takes effect on October 1 is only read on October 10: the business valid time counts from the 1st, while the time the system knew about it counts from the 10th.

信息写入长期记忆前，要把观察、假设、规则分开.en: Before information is written to long-term memory, keep the observation, the hypothesis and the rule apart

本例条件：</strong>独立对话：用户说“这个项目暂时用Python 3.1.en: Conditions for this example: an independent conversation: the user says "this project uses Python 3.11 for now"; the model guesses "all projects use 3.11". What is written must correspond to the original fact that was authorized.

这条信息适用哪个项目/用户。.en: Which project/user this piece of information applies to.

谁明确说过或哪份文件证明。.en: Who explicitly said it, or which document proves it.

候选、确认、撤销等生命周期。.en: A lifecycle of candidate, confirmation, revocation and so on.

有用户来源，但有项目与时间范围.en: It comes from the user, but is scoped to a project and a time range

模型推广，无原始支持.en: The model generalised it; there is no support in the original

不写入确认事实.en: nothing is written in as a confirmed fact

后来用户改为3.12.en: The user later changed it to 3.12

更新生效区间并保留来源.en: Update the interval of validity and keep the provenance

提取器会生成看起来整齐的字段，但字段整齐不证明事实成立。范围不能比原话更宽。.en: An extractor will produce fields that look tidy, but tidy fields are no proof that the fact holds. The scope must not be wider than the original wording.

暂时性信息要有复核触发或过期策略，永久保存可能把临时试验变成长期约束。.en: Temporary information needs a re-check trigger or an expiry policy; keeping it for good can turn a short-lived experiment into a long-term constraint.

写入前检查是否重复、是否冲突、有无隐私限制；写入后还要能按证据撤回。.en: Before writing, check for duplication, for conflict and for privacy restrictions; after writing, it must still be possible to withdraw it on the evidence.

不要混淆：</strong>“模型总结过”不是独立来源。如果总结漏掉“本项目”和.en: Do not conflate: "the model summarized it" is not an independent source. If the summary drops "in this project" and "for now", later retrieval will widen the error.

记忆写入为什么是一条带租约与验收的流水线？.en: Why is writing memory a pipeline with leases and acceptance?

记忆流水线的发布条件。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型.en: The publishing conditions of the memory pipeline. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

事实适用的时间与系统记录或获知它的时间。 例：政策1日生效、5日才录入，两个时间.en: When a fact applies, and when the system recorded or learned it. Example: a policy takes effect on the 1st but is only entered on the 5th; the two times are not interchangeable.

有效时间与记录时间，是两个独立的问题.en: Valid time and record time are two separate questions

本例条件：</strong>独立教学日期：10月3日获知一项规则自10月1日起生.en: Conditions for this example: independent teaching dates: on 3 October it becomes known that a rule takes effect from 1 October; on 8 October it becomes known that it was in fact revoked from 5 October. These are not real user records.

规则在现实中从何时到何时适用。.en: From when to when the rule applies in the real world.

系统何时收到这条消息。.en: When the system received this message.

问当时实际状态，或问当时系统知道什么。.en: Ask what the actual state was then, or ask what the system knew then.

放大图解：有效时间与记录时间，是两个独立的问题.en: Enlarged figure: valid time and record time are two independent questions

有效时间与记录时间：系统何时知道，不等于事实何时生效.en: Valid time and recorded time: when the system knows is not when the fact takes effect

事实有效区间.en: The interval over which a fact is valid

系统知悉时间.en: The time the system learned of it

问10月6日实际是否有效.en: Ask whether it was actually in force on 6 October

按修正后应为无效.en: Invalid once the correction is applied

不等于6日系统已知道撤销.en: does not mean the system already knew about the revocation on the 6th

问6日系统当时会怎样答.en: Ask how the system would have answered on the 6th

当时只知道起始规则.en: At the time only the initial rule was known

可重建当时知识状态.en: The state of knowledge at the time can be rebuilt

横向看真实生效区间，纵向看系统何时知道。把两者合成一个updated_at会让“.en: Read across for the real interval of effect, and down for when the system knew. Collapsing the two into a single updated_at makes "looking back at a fact" and "replaying a decision" confuse each other.

迟到的修正不能粗暴把过去的系统日志改写成“当时就知道”，否则事故复盘会失真。.en: A late correction must not crudely rewrite past system logs into "we knew at the time"; otherwise the incident review comes out distorted.

未必所有项目都需要完整双时间数据库，但只要业务会出现追溯生效或迟到修正，就必须理.en: Not every project needs a full bi-temporal database, but as soon as the business has retroactive effect or late corrections, these two kinds of time have to be understood.

不要混淆：</strong>“最新记录”可能描述过去的事实；按录入时间直接决定今.en: Do not conflate: the "most recent record" may describe a past fact; deciding today's applicable value straight from the time of entry is not reliable.

“什么时候是真的”与“什么时候知道的”：记忆时间必须拆开.en: "When it was true" and "when it became known": the two times in memory have to be kept apart

记忆检索先过适用门，再比语义相似度.en: Memory retrieval passes the applicability gate first, and compares semantic similarity second

本例条件：</strong>独立问题：项目P1当前超时。候选M1为P2超时10，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent question: project P1 currently times out. Candidate M1 is a timeout of 10 for P2, M2 is 30 from an old version of P1, and M3 is 20 from the current version of P1. The numbers are a teaching construction.

排除不属于当前范围的记录。.en: Exclude records outside the current scope.

在允许候选中找更相关者。.en: Find the more relevant ones among the permitted candidates.

删除、失效或降低检索资格，不一定抹掉审计记录。.en: Deleting a record, letting it expire or lowering its eligibility for retrieval does not necessarily erase the audit record.

能否作为当前答案.en: Whether it can serve as the current answer

版本已过期.en: The version is out of date

仍需核对来源可靠性.en: The reliability of the source still has to be checked

语义分数最高的M1可能只是措辞最相近，却属于另一个项目。范围约束不能被相关性分数.en: M1, with the highest semantic score, may simply be the closest in wording while belonging to another project. A scope constraint cannot be canceled out by a relevance score.

过期内容可以保留在审计库，但默认检索当前事实时要排除或显著标明历史身份。.en: Expired content may stay in the audit store, but when retrieval asks for the current fact by default it has to be excluded or clearly marked as a historical identity.

撤销一条源事实还应处理它产生的摘要、向量块和缓存，否则用户仍可能从派生层读到旧结.en: Revoking a source fact also means dealing with the summaries, vector chunks and caches it produced; otherwise a user can still read the old conclusion out of the derived layer.

不要混淆：</strong>删除原文件后不重建或失效化派生索引，不等于已经忘记它.en: Do not conflate: deleting the original file without rebuilding or invalidating the derived index is not the same as having forgotten it.

删掉原文不等于遗忘：摘要、缓存与经验条目也有依赖.en: Deleting the original text is not forgetting: summaries, caches and experience entries depend on it too

19｜Skills与路由：怎样加载刚好需要的专业能力.en: 19｜Skills and routing: loading exactly the expertise needed

Skill有效应用是一条证据链，不是一个“loaded”日志.en: A skill applied effectively is a chain of evidence, not one "loaded" log line

本例条件：</strong>独立技能目录包含“目录规则审查”Skill，目标检查.en: Conditions for this example: an independent skill directory contains a "directory rule review" skill whose goal is to check the exclude boundary. Follow the metadata first, then the body and the actual tests.

宿主找到了名称与描述。.en: The host found the name and the description.

相关说明实际进入上下文。.en: The relevant instructions actually enter the context.

执行中出现该方法要求的操作或验证。.en: An operation or verification required by that method appears during execution.

宿主已经发现.en: The host has already discovered it

正文已经读取.en: The body has already been read

请求中含边界规则.en: The request contains the boundary rule

模型已经遵循.en: The model has already followed it

当前版本执行记录.en: An execution record for the current version

未覆盖的场景也正确.en: Scenarios that were not covered are correct too

逐层定位可以避免“技能文件写得很专业，却完全没有进入模型”的无效优化。.en: Locating it layer by layer avoids the empty optimization of "the skill file is expertly written but never reached the model".

反过来，加载了长篇说明但没有任何对应动作，也不算有效应用；要看任务行为与结果。.en: Conversely, loading a long set of instructions with no corresponding action is not effective application either; look at the task behavior and the result.

Skill的专业性应通过具体失败案例验证，而不是以篇幅或术语数量衡量。.en: A skill's expertise should be verified against concrete failure cases, not measured by its length or its number of technical terms.

不要混淆：</strong>模型回复“已使用某技能”只能当声明，不能替代加载轨迹.en: Do not conflate: the model replying "I used such-and-such skill" counts only as a claim; it is no substitute for a loading trace and evidence of execution.

Skill未生效时，为什么反复改description常常改错层？.en: When a skill has no effect, why does editing the description over and over so often change the wrong layer?

渐进加载的Skill怎样从“文件”变成实际能力？.en: How does a progressively loaded skill go from "a file" to actual capability?

路由描述的好坏，要看正例与近邻反例是否分得开.en: Whether a routing description is good depends on whether positive examples and near-miss negatives can be told apart

本例条件：</strong>独立两个任务：A修改SQL迁移脚本；B只给READM.en: Conditions for this example: two independent tasks: A changes an SQL migration script; B only fixes a typo in the README. The candidate skill is "database migration review"; not every task whose text mentions "database" needs it.

必须启用该技能的任务。.en: A task for which that skill must be enabled.

措辞相似但不该启用的任务。.en: A task worded similarly that should not enable it.

漏掉必需技能与加载无关技能的两种错误。.en: The two errors: missing a required skill, and loading an irrelevant one.

涉及迁移与兼容风险.en: It involves migration and compatibility risk

B：README提到数据库的错字.en: B: the typo in the README's mention of the database

C：修改ORM字段映射.en: C: change the ORM field mapping

可能影响schema，先小范围取证.en: May affect the schema; gather evidence on a small scope first

把description写成“所有数据库相关任务都用”会提高表面覆盖，却让B也走.en: Writing the description as "use for every database-related task" raises apparent coverage but sends B through the heavy process as well.

C是边界任务，合理做法不是凭一句描述强判，而是读取少量关键证据后决定是否扩展。.en: C is a borderline task; the sensible move is not to force a judgment from one line of description, but to read a little key evidence and then decide whether to widen the scope.

评测要同时包含正例、反例和边界例；只用正例测试会鼓励越来越宽泛的描述。.en: An evaluation must include positive cases, counterexamples and boundary cases together; testing with positive cases alone encourages ever vaguer descriptions.

不要混淆：</strong>误加载率下降但漏掉高风险任务，不是成功优化；要看各类.en: Do not conflate: a lower rate of wrong loading that misses the high-risk tasks is not a successful optimization; look at the cost of each kind of error and at the final code quality.

把需要确定执行的动作放在程序里，不只写进说明.en: Put the actions that must certainly be carried out in the program, not only in the instructions

本例条件：</strong>独立需求：提交前必须运行格式检查，复杂安全修改再请R.en: Conditions for this example: an independent requirement: a format check must be run before committing, and a complex security change also needs a reviewer. The responsibilities of an instruction, a skill, a hook, a tool and an agent are compared.

持续或当前任务的指导。.en: Guidance that is ongoing, or that belongs to the current task.

在明确事件触发的程序逻辑。.en: Program logic triggered by an explicit event.

模型可请求的动作。.en: The actions the model can request.

有自己上下文与执行循环的任务承担者。.en: A task-taker with its own context and execution loop.

更合适的承载方式.en: A more suitable place to carry it

特定迁移任务的检查方法.en: A checking method for a specific migration task

提交前确定跑格式检查.en: Make sure the format check runs before submitting

不依赖模型记得请求.en: does not rely on the model remembering the request

有独立任务与证据需求.en: Has an independent task and its own evidence needs

如果某操作是机械必做且容易确定触发，程序钩子通常比让模型每次记住它更可靠。.en: If an operation is mechanical, mandatory and easy to trigger reliably, a program hook is usually more dependable than having the model remember it every time.

Skill不是钩子的替代：它告诉“怎样做”，不自动保证事件发生时执行。.en: A skill is not a substitute for a hook: it says "how to do it", and does not guarantee by itself that anything runs when the event occurs.

多Agent也不是更高级的Tool，每个独立上下文会产生初始化、交接和合并成本。.en: Multi-agent is not a more advanced kind of Tool either; every separate context brings costs of initialization, handoff and merging.

不要混淆：</strong>所有任务固定经过多个Agent和重复Review，可.en: Do not conflate: routing every task through several agents and repeated review can add cost without addressing any new failure mode.

便宜模型先试的收益，要减掉返工与漏检.en: Whatever is gained by trying the cheap model first has to have rework and missed checks subtracted from it

本例条件：</strong>独立成本模型：直接强模型每任务10单位；先用小模型2.en: Conditions for this example: independent cost model: going straight to the strong model costs 10 units per task; using the small model first costs 2, and 30% of tasks escalate and spend another 10. Detection and rework are left out for now, so this is an idealized lower bound.

小模型阶段后需要强模型的比例。.en: The proportion that needs the strong model after the small-model stage.

判断是否升级的程序或模型。.en: The program or model that decides whether to escalate.

错误答案被当成成功而未升级。.en: A wrong answer is taken for a success and never escalated.

检测器能否抓住错误.en: Whether the detector catches the error

全部运行费用/成功任务数.en: Total run spend / number of successful tasks

漏检会降低最终质量.en: A missed detection lowers the final quality

升级率不是小模型失败率的自动同义词；只有失败能被检测器发现，才会进入升级路径。.en: Escalation rate is not an automatic synonym for the small model's failure rate; only a failure the detector can find enters the escalation path.

路由应考虑任务风险、工具能力、上下文长度与历史结果，而非单看Prompt字数。.en: Routing should take the task's risk, the tools' capability, the context length and past results into account, rather than only the prompt's word count.

用同一任务集比较端到端成功、费用和尾延迟。级联省调用钱却让低频严重错误增加，可能.en: Use the same task set to compare end-to-end success, cost and tail latency. A cascade saves money on calls but lets rare serious errors increase, which may be unacceptable.

不要混淆：</strong>用模型自报“我有95%把握”作唯一升级门槛，容易在最.en: Do not conflate: taking the model's own "I am 95% sure" as the only threshold for escalation tends to leave overconfident errors exactly where escalation is needed most.

小模型加回退真的省钱吗？关键在错误能否被发现.en: Does a small model plus a fallback really save money? What matters is whether the errors can be detected

20｜多Agent：并行的收益与交接的损失.en: 20｜Multi-agent: the gain from parallelism and the loss at handoff

并行只有在子任务相对独立、交接损失可控时才有收益。下图同时给出变快和变慢的条件；.en: Parallelism only pays when the subtasks are relatively independent and the loss at handoff stays manageable. The figure below gives the conditions for both speeding up and slowing down; later on, a DAG is not better for being split more finely, and a shared file or a shared assumption can serialize the task again.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/O11.html\">多A.en: Related step-by-step process: Multi-agent: work that can run in parallel matters more than the number of agents. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F24.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatLesson 26 · A timeout tells you nothing arrived, not that nothing happenedLesson 04 · A test looks for counterexamples; it does not stamp code green

交接包至少要让接手者知道证据和未完成动作.en: A handoff package must at least let whoever takes over know the evidence and the unfinished actions

本例条件：</strong>独立主Agent委派：子Agent验证exclude.en: Conditions for this example: an independent main-agent delegation: the sub-agent verifies the exclude patch and is not allowed to write files. The main agent has already changed filter.py to r8, and the tests have not been run yet.

子Agent这次要交付什么。.en: What the subagent is to deliver this time.

它应阅读的具体版本。.en: The specific version it should read.

不能被总结成完成的工作。.en: It cannot be summarized into work that is done.

缺失后的风险.en: The risk if it is missing

验证exclude边界，不重新设计.en: Verify the exclude boundary; do not redesign it

误改文件.en: A file is changed by mistake

补丁已应用，测试未跑.en: The patch is applied, the tests have not been run

回传要求.en: What the report back must contain

测试命令、版本、结果、失败项.en: The test command, the version, the result and the failing items

主Agent无法复核.en: the main agent cannot re-check it

子Agent不是天然拥有父Agent全部记忆。交接包要让它从明确状态开始，而不是.en: A subagent does not naturally hold all of the parent agent's memory. The handoff package has to let it start from an explicit state, not merely from "have a look".

可以保留短的摘要，再按引用读取原始证据；不必复制整个父级历史，但不能丢掉约束和版.en: A short summary can be kept and the original evidence read through a reference; the whole parent history need not be copied, but the constraints and the versions must not be lost.

回传既要有结论，也要有可验证产物。仅有“没问题”无法支持最终交付。.en: What is reported back needs both a conclusion and an artifact that can be verified. "No problems" on its own cannot support a final delivery.

不要混淆：</strong>为省Token删掉未完成项，可能让两个Agent都以.en: Do not conflate: deleting unfinished items to save tokens can leave two agents each believing the other has run the key test.

多Agent怎样并行，又怎样避免交接损失？.en: How do several agents run in parallel, and how is loss at handoff avoided?

并行收益可能被交接吃掉。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模.en: The gain from parallelism can be eaten up by the handoff. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

DAG、依赖与关键路径.en: DAG, dependencies and the critical path

DAG是有方向且没有环的任务依赖图。箭头A→B表示B依赖A完成；关键路径是在给定.en: A DAG is a task dependency graph that is directed and has no cycles. The arrow A→B means B depends on A finishing; the critical path is the longest dependency chain, the one that fixes the earliest finishing time given the task durations and dependencies.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: A takes 2 seconds, B and C depend on A, take 3 and 5 seconds and can run in parallel, so finishing both after A takes at least 7 seconds — not 2+3+5=10 read as wall-clock time.

DAG上的最长依赖路径，决定并行任务最早何时结束.en: The longest dependency path in a DAG decides the earliest that parallel tasks can finish

本例条件：</strong>独立任务图：A定位2分钟；A后B改实现4分钟与C补测.en: Conditions for this example: an independent task graph: A takes 2 minutes to locate; after A, B's implementation change (4 minutes) and C's added tests (3 minutes) can run in parallel; D's integration (1 minute) must wait for B and C. The times are a teaching setting.

没有循环依赖的有向任务图。.en: A directed task graph with no cyclic dependencies.

持续时间最长的依赖链。.en: The dependency chain that lasts longest.

各任务耗时求和，与墙钟不同。.en: The sum of the time the tasks take, which is not the wall clock.

放大图解：DAG上的最长依赖路径，决定并行任务最早何时结束.en: Enlarged figure: the longest dependency path in the DAG decides the earliest a parallel task can finish

B是这张图的较长分支。把C从3优化到1，D仍需等B到6，所以总时间仍是7。.en: B is the longer branch in this graph. Optimizing C from 3 down to 1 still leaves D waiting for B to reach 6, so the total is still 7.

真实委派还要加启动、取证、交接和冲突处理时间；图中的7是无额外开销的理想时间。.en: Real delegation also adds time for start-up, gathering evidence, handoff and conflict handling; the 7 in the figure is an ideal time with no extra overhead.

切更多节点可能增加并行机会，也可能增加边界沟通，不能仅按Agent个数推断加速。.en: Cutting the work into more nodes can create more opportunities for parallelism, and can also add communication across the boundaries; a speed-up cannot be inferred from the number of agents alone.

不要混淆：</strong>若B与C实际写同一文件就未必可安全并行；任务图必须反.en: Do not conflate: if B and C actually write the same file, they may not be safe to run in parallel; the task graph has to reflect resource conflicts, not just the business steps.

并行工具为什么可能先执行完、后显示结果？.en: Why can tools running in parallel finish earlier and show their results later?

等待A后回填B.en: Backfill B after waiting for A

执行时序与回填顺序不同。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模.en: The order of execution and the order of writing results back differ. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

WAL是先记录日志再按协议更新数据的思路；fsync请求同步文件相关数据到存储；.en: WAL is the idea of writing a log first and then updating the data by protocol; fsync asks for a file's data to be synchronized to storage; an atomic rename, where it is supported, keeps readers from seeing a half-finished replacement. Visibility and durability after a crash are not the same guarantee.<span class="concept-micro">One file renaming successfully does not mean several files and a database committed together; durability also has to be checked against the platform, the directory and the storage behavior.

不同文件无文本冲突，也可能产生语义冲突.en: Different files with no textual conflict can still produce a semantic conflict

本例条件：</strong>独立协作例：Agent A把函数返回值从int改为对.en: Conditions for this example: an independent collaboration example: agent A changes a function's return value from an int to an object; agent B adds a call in another file that still compares it as an int. Git can merge the two branches cleanly.

修改同一文本区域产生冲突。.en: Editing the same region of text produces a conflict.

接口与调用者假设不一致。.en: The interface and the caller's assumption do not agree.

针对合并后的组合状态运行检查。.en: Run the checks against the combined state after the merge.

基于旧接口测试通过.en: Passed the test against the old interface

运行时对象与整数比较失败.en: Comparing a runtime object with an integer fails

在合并工件r9上运行契约测试.en: Run the contract test on merged artifact r9

绑定最终组合版本.en: Bound to the final combined version

Git保证的是文本合并能力，不验证业务接口。两个“都通过”属于不同工件，不能相加.en: What Git guarantees is the ability to merge text; it does not verify a business interface. Two "both passed" results belong to different artifacts and cannot be added up into a pass after the merge.

共享接口改动宜先明确契约或分配所有权，让依赖方知道何时更新。.en: For a change to a shared interface it is better to settle the contract or assign ownership first, so that the dependants know when to update.

提交前检查最终diff、接口契约和受影响集成测试，比仅给每个Agent单独评分更.en: Checking the final diff, the interface contract and the affected integration tests before submitting comes closer to delivery quality than scoring each agent on its own.

不要混淆：</strong>用多工作树隔离写入能防覆盖，却不能免掉最终语义集成。.en: Do not conflate: isolating writes with several work trees does prevent overwriting, but it does not remove the final semantic integration.

两个人改不同文件，为什么合并后仍会坏？.en: Two people change different files — so why does it still break after the merge?

两个Reviewer同意，可能只是共享了同一个盲点.en: Two reviewers agreeing may only mean they share one blind spot

本例条件：</strong>独立补丁审查：作者与两个Reviewer都只看到正常.en: Conditions for this example: an independent patch review: the author and both reviewers only saw the normal input vendor/a.py, and not the myvendor/a.py counterexample.

多个评审因同样资料或假设而犯同类错。.en: Several reviewers make the same kind of mistake because they share the same material or assumption.

不同测试或观察，不只是不同措辞。.en: A different test or observation, not just different wording.

通信与任务交互协议，不替代审查质量。.en: A protocol for communication and task interaction; it is no substitute for review quality.

无法排除包含匹配Bug.en: Cannot rule out a containment-matching bug

同意不能新增边界证据.en: Agreement adds no new boundary evidence

能真正区分错误实现.en: Genuinely tells a wrong implementation apart

独立会话与独立错误是不同概念。相同模型、相同输入、相同测试容易共享漏点。.en: An independent session and an independent error are different notions. The same model, the same input and the same test readily share blind spots.

可把审查任务分成契约核对、反例生成和运行证据复查，让新增工作确实带来不同证据。.en: A review task can be split into checking the contract, generating counterexamples and re-checking the run evidence, so that the extra work really does bring different evidence.

A2A能帮助系统发现对方、交换任务状态；它不自动提供全局事务、权限或“多票就是真.en: A2A can help systems discover one another and exchange task state; it does not automatically provide global transactions, permissions, or any guarantee that "more votes means true".

不要混淆：</strong>把多数投票包装成可靠性认证，会掩盖相关失败，尤其在高.en: Do not conflate: dressing a majority vote up as a reliability certificate hides correlated failures, especially at high-risk but low-frequency boundaries.

两个审查Agent都通过，为什么不能把错误率直接相乘？.en: Both review agents passed it, so why can the error rates not simply be multiplied?

第31课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 31. Reading order: confirm the runtime contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

21｜可靠执行：重试、幂等、崩溃与状态恢复.en: 21｜Reliable execution: retries, idempotence, crashes and state recovery

超时证明没收到响应，不证明远端没做事。下图将副作用与回执分开，解释unknown.en: A timeout proves that no response arrived; it does not prove that the far end did nothing. The figure below separates the side effect from the acknowledgement, and explains the unknown state, idempotency keys and reconciliation. Adding a transaction to the local database alone cannot remove the risk of duplicate execution at the far end.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F33.html\">超时.en: Related step-by-step process: A timeout tells you nothing arrived, not that nothing happened. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F24.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatLesson 29 · Material can influence a model without thereby gaining permission

超时出现的位置，位于“请求”与“响应”之间.en: The place where a timeout appears is between "request" and "response"

本例条件：</strong>独立消息发送例：业务操作op-7到达远端，远端已提交.en: Conditions for this example: an independent message-sending example: the business operation op-7 reaches the remote side, which commits it, but the success response is lost in the network. The message service in the figure is a teaching assumption, not a real send.

外部世界发生变化，例如新增消息。.en: The outside world changes — a new message, for instance.

调用方没在期限内得到可用响应。.en: The caller did not get a usable response within the deadline.

当前证据无法确认成功或失败。.en: The current evidence cannot confirm either success or failure.

放大图解：超时出现的位置，位于“请求”与“响应”之间.en: Enlarged figure: where a timeout appears, between the "request" and the "response"

超时进入unknown，恢复必须先核对副作用.en: A timeout goes to unknown, and recovery must check the side effects first

远端实际状态.en: Actual state at the far end

记录unknown并按op-7查询.en: Record unknown and query by op-7

可返回已存在结果.en: The existing result can be returned

看第二行：远端成功与本地知道成功是两件事。网络可以隔断它们。.en: Look at the second row: the remote side succeeding and the local side knowing it succeeded are two different things. The network can cut between them.

把unknown写成failed再重发，会在不支持幂等的服务里产生第二条消息。.en: Writing unknown down as failed and sending it again produces a second message on a service that does not support idempotence.

恢复方法取决于远端能力：按业务键查询、同键幂等重试、人工对账，不能用更长摘要消除.en: How you recover depends on what the remote side can do: query by business key, retry idempotently with the same key, or reconcile by hand. A longer summary cannot close this information gap.

不要混淆：</strong>把客户端重试次数限制为1只能限制重复次数，不会从原理.en: Do not conflate: limiting the client to one retry limits how often it repeats; it does not guarantee exactly once in principle.

每个可读位置用于被查询比较的一组数。 例：与Q点积得到匹配分数。.en: The set of numbers each readable position offers for a query to compare against. Example: its dot product with Q gives the match score.

要求业务效果恰好一次的语义目标。 例：至少一次传输加幂等可帮助实现，不是任意系统.en: A semantic goal requiring the business effect to happen exactly once. Example: at-least-once delivery plus idempotency can help achieve it; no system guarantees it automatically.

幂等键绑定的是同一次业务意图，不是每次HTTP尝试.en: An idempotency key is bound to one business intent, not to each HTTP attempt

本例条件：</strong>独立操作：给订单O7创建一次退款R1。第一次超时后需.en: Conditions for this example: an independent operation: create one refund R1 for order O7. After the first timeout a retry is needed. The same refund intent should keep the key refund:O7:R1; a second, new refund must not reuse that key.

用户想产生的那一个业务结果。.en: The one business result the user wants to bring about.

为完成这个意图的一次网络提交。.en: One network submission made to carry out that intent.

真正产生副作用的一侧识别相同操作键。.en: The side that actually produces the side effect recognises the same operation key.

查询/返回已有R1，不另建.en: Query and return the existing R1; do not create another

每次随机新键.en: A new random key each time

变成新意图，可能重复.en: Becomes a new intent, so it may duplicate

不同业务意图，需要新键.en: A different business intent needs a new key

本地表能记录“我发过”，但若在远端提交后、本地记账前崩溃，本地仍不知道。需要下游.en: A local table can record "I sent it", but if the crash falls after the remote side commits and before the local entry is written, the local side still does not know. The downstream has to support deduplication by the same key, or results that can be verified.

键之外还应绑定请求参数；同键但不同金额不能静默复用旧结果。保存期和冲突行为需写进.en: Besides the key, the request parameters should be bound in as well; the same key with a different amount must not silently reuse the old result. The retention period and the conflict behavior belong in the contract.

“恰好一次”通常只能在明确事务和去重边界内谈，不能从一个本地SQLite表推到任.en: "Exactly once" can usually only be spoken of within clear transaction and deduplication boundaries; it cannot be extrapolated from one local SQLite table to any external system.

不要混淆：</strong>用订单号作为唯一键过粗，会把同一订单多笔合法操作错误.en: Do not conflate: using the order number as the unique key is too coarse and wrongly merges several legitimate operations on the same order; a random number per request is too fine.

外部动作成功、日志没来得及确认：为什么本地事务无法保证只执行一次？.en: The external action succeeded but the log never got to confirm it: why can a local transaction not guarantee exactly-once execution?

成功写入但没有确认：重试怎样变成重复副作用.en: Written successfully but not confirmed: how a retry becomes a duplicated side effect

补记成功，不重复副作用.en: Record the success afterwards, without repeating the side effect

崩溃发生在两个独立提交之间。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商.en: The crash falls between two independent commits. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

CAS是比较预期版本/值仍匹配后再更新的受控操作。TOCTOU是检查与使用之间发.en: CAS is a controlled operation that updates only after comparing that the expected version or value still matches. TOCTOU is the race in which something changes between the check and the use: a separate "look at the version, then write" is not automatically equivalent to an atomic CAS.<span class="concept-micro">If a patch was produced from version 7 and the version is already 8 at commit time, overwriting directly should be refused and the work redone; a concurrent insert between the comparison and the write has to be prevented as well.

检查时与使用时目标发生变化的竞争问题。 例：批准文件A之后实际操作不能悄悄变成文.en: A race in which the target changes between the time of checking and the time of use. Example: after file A is approved, the actual operation must not quietly become file B.

事务把一组数据库操作放在规定的提交边界内。ACID分别指原子性、一致性、隔离性、.en: A transaction puts a group of database operations inside a defined commit boundary. ACID stands for atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability; the guarantee you actually get also depends on the isolation level, the configuration and the resource boundary.<span class="concept-micro">A database transaction committing does not mean another mail service commits along with it. Writing the two operations into the same function does not automatically make a cross-system transaction.

原子替换防半写，CAS防覆盖，它们不是一回事.en: Atomic replacement prevents a half-written file and CAS prevents an overwrite; they are not the same thing

本例条件：</strong>独立文件例：A读取r7并生成补丁；B先把文件改到r8.en: Conditions for this example: an independent file example: A reads r7 and generates a patch; B changes the file to r8 first; A still tries to write its own result.

读者看到完整旧文件或完整新文件，而非半份。.en: A reader sees either the complete old file or the complete new one, never half of one.

只有版本等于预期值才执行更新。.en: The update runs only if the version equals the expected value.

检查与使用之间状态变化的竞态。.en: The race in which the state changes between the check and the use.

完整覆盖了r8；仍丢更新.en: Overwrites r8 completely; the update is still lost

在协调边界内比较r7与当前r8.en: Compare r7 with the current r8 inside the coordinating boundary

不一致，拒绝覆盖并重新取证.en: Inconsistent: refuse to overwrite and gather the evidence again

一次写得“完整”仍然可能是错误内容。原子性只解决可见半写，不能证明你基于最新版本.en: One write being "complete" can still mean the content is wrong. Atomicity only deals with a visible half-write; it is no proof that you were working from the latest version.

先检查hash，再隔一段无锁写入，仍可能在中间被其他进程修改。比较与更新必须由同.en: Checking the hash first and then writing without a lock some time later still leaves room for another process to change the file in between. The comparison and the update must be protected by the same coordinating mechanism.

数据库事务只能包住参与它的资源；普通文件、远程API与数据库之间还要设计恢复和补.en: A database transaction can only wrap the resources that take part in it; recovery and compensation still have to be designed across ordinary files, remote APIs and the database.

不要混淆：</strong>不要把rename/replace、CAS、事务、f.en: Do not conflate: rename/replace, CAS, transactions and fsync are not interchangeable terms: they concern visibility, conditional update, consistency and durability respectively.

Retry、Resume、Replay、Cancel，对动作的含义不同.en: Retry, resume, replay and cancel mean different things for an action

本例条件：</strong>独立长任务：op1读文件成功，op2写文件结果未知，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent long task: op1 read a file successfully, the result of op2's file write is unknown, and op3's test has not started. After a restart, the judgment has to be made from this set of states.

从持久状态继续未完成任务。.en: Continue an unfinished task from persisted state.

重放事件或计算，副作用需区分。.en: Replay the events or the computation; side effects must be treated separately.

要求停止后续推进，并不撤销已提交效果。.en: Asks that further progress stop; it does not undo effects already committed.

对本例会做什么.en: What it does in this example

必须满足的条件.en: The conditions that must be met

先核验或幂等保护.en: Verify first, or protect with idempotency

核对op2，再决定是否跑op3.en: Check op2, then decide whether to run op3

不能把unknown当未执行.en: unknown must not be treated as not executed

默认不重新发送外部写.en: By default an external write is not sent again

不再启动op3.en: does not go on to start op3

op2已提交效果仍需说明.en: the effect op2 has already committed still has to be accounted for

恢复不是从聊天摘要最后一句继续，而是核对真实动作状态与环境版本。.en: Recovery does not continue from the last sentence of a chat summary; it checks the real state of the actions and the version of the environment.

事件重放常用于重建状态；若事件处理器顺手重复发送消息，就把纯重建变成了第二次副作.en: Event replay is commonly used to rebuild state; if the event handler sends its messages again along the way, a pure rebuild turns into a second round of side effects.

取消信号应传播到工具与子任务，但工具能否停止要看它自身契约，报告中应保留未确定项.en: A cancel signal should propagate to the tools and the subtasks, but whether a tool can stop depends on its own contract, and the report should keep the items that remain undetermined.

不要混淆：</strong>把四个操作都实现为“重新从头跑脚本”，会让长任务可靠.en: Do not conflate: implementing all four operations as "run the script again from the start" leaves the reliability of a long task entirely superficial.

三层各重试三次，为什么最底层会被打27次？.en: Three layers each retrying three times: why does the bottom one get hit 27 times?

22｜工程质量：从需求到测试，再到真正可交付的代码.en: 22｜Engineering quality: from requirements to tests, and on to code that can really be delivered

先写出要守住的行为，再用会失败的反例证明确实需要修改。测试通过必须绑定被测代码版.en: First write down the behavior to be held to, then prove with a counterexample that fails that a change really is needed. A passing test has to be bound to the version of the code under test; change the file afterwards and the old green result no longer proves what is being delivered.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F34.html\">测试.en: Related step-by-step process: A test looks for counterexamples; it does not stamp code green. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F30.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 18 · Code retrieval cannot rely on "semantically similar" aloneLesson 05 · When reading a metric, first ask what its denominator is

完成条件应包含“不能改变什么”，不只包含一个成功例.en: A completion condition should include "what must not change", not just one successful example

本例条件：</strong>独立需求：目录exclude支持vendor/。明确.en: Conditions for this example: an independent requirement: the directory exclude supports vendor/. The semantics adopted are explicitly a prefix at the repository root, not extended to matching directories at every level.

新功能必须支持的输入。.en: The input the new feature must support.

不应该误伤的相邻输入。.en: Neighboring input that must not be broken.

改动前后必须维持的接口与行为。.en: The interface and behavior that must hold before and after the change.

原函数参数与返回类型.en: The original function's parameters and return type

第三行必须先定义，否则不同实现都能声称合理。验收把含糊词“目录”变成精确范围。.en: The third row has to be defined first, or several different implementations could all claim to be reasonable. Acceptance turns the vague word "directory" into a precise scope.

测试不仅验证新增路径，也应证明没有扩大匹配范围和破坏接口。.en: A test should not only exercise the new path but also show that the matching scope was not widened and the interface not broken.

Agent可据此报告哪项通过、哪项缺证据，而不是只说“功能已实现”。.en: On that basis an agent can report which items passed and which lack evidence, instead of only saying "the feature is implemented".

不要混淆：</strong>验收写得越多不一定越好；保留能区分实际错误实现的条件.en: Do not conflate: more acceptance conditions are not always better; keep the conditions that tell a genuinely wrong implementation apart, and avoid treating internal implementation details as an external contract.

把“支持exclude”变成可以验收的输入输出表.en: Turning "support exclude" into an input and output table that can be accepted

输入与条件。</strong>需求：exclude=[\"a\"]时不构建a及其.en: Input and conditions.The requirement: with exclude=["a"], a and its subdirectories are not built while ab still takes part; an empty exclude leaves the original behavior unchanged.

预期均排除。.en: Both are expected to be excluded.

预期保留，区分目录边界与字符串前缀。.en: Expected to be kept, which separates a directory boundary from a string prefix.

所有原候选仍按原规则处理。.en: All the original candidates are still handled by the original rule.

路径是否规范化、大小写是否敏感.en: Whether the path is normalized, and whether case matters

先查实际平台要求，不能凭空追加跨平台承诺。.en: Check the actual platform requirements first; cross-platform promises must not be added out of thin air.

对当前补丁运行这组行为测试.en: Run this set of behavioral tests against the current patch

通过后再看是否有真实集成风险。.en: Once it passes, then look at whether there is a real integration risk.

把过程连起来。</strong>验收不是“代码能运行”，而是覆盖能区分正确实现与.en: Join the steps up. Acceptance is not "the code runs"; it is covering the inputs that tell a correct implementation from the usual wrong ones.

边界与反例。</strong>示例需求仅含声明条件；生产项目还需按真实目录、构建.en: Limits and counterexamples. The example requirement contains only the conditions stated; a production project must add the real directories, build system and user constraints.

长期任务如何避免每次重新开始或虚假完成？.en: How does a long task avoid starting over each time, or finishing falsely?

需重跑受影响检查.en: The affected checks must be re-run

验收证据绑定最终产物。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型.en: Acceptance evidence is bound to the final artifact. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

绿色测试需要绑定“真的运行过”和“当前版本”.en: A green test has to be bound to "it really ran" and "the current version"

本例条件：</strong>独立记录：测试命令退出0，但0项被收集；另一次有12.en: Conditions for this example: independent record: the test command exited 0, but 0 items were collected; another run had 12 passing, but it ran on r7 while the final code has since changed to r8.

测试框架实际找到多少项。.en: How many items the test framework actually found.

实际运行而非跳过的测试数。.en: The number of tests that actually ran rather than being skipped.

测试时对应的代码与环境版本。.en: The code and environment version the test corresponded to.

仍显示旧绿灯.en: Still shows the old green light

不能自动外推到r8.en: Cannot be extrapolated to r8 automatically

这些测试定义的性质成立.en: The properties these tests define do hold

先检查有没有实际执行，再检查测的是什么版本，最后检查用例能不能击中目标缺陷。三关.en: First check whether anything actually ran, then check which version was tested, and last check whether the cases can hit the target defect. All three gates are needed.

变异测试可以故意放回错误实现；如果仍全绿，说明测试没有分辨力。.en: Mutation testing can deliberately put a wrong implementation back in; if everything is still green, the tests have no discriminating power.

验证后格式化、生成代码或改配置也会改变对象，应重新执行受影响检查或证明不影响。.en: Formatting, generating code or changing configuration after verification also changes the object, so the affected checks have to be run again or shown not to be affected.

不要混淆：</strong>不能把“测试没有发现问题”改写成“没有任何问题”，尤.en: Do not conflate: "the tests found no problem" cannot be rewritten as "there is no problem at all", least of all when both coverage and environment are limited.

测试命令退出0，为什么仍可能一条有效测试都没做？.en: The test command exits 0 — so why may not a single effective test have run?

Review是否值得，取决于新证据而非固定多走一轮.en: Whether a review is worth it depends on new evidence, not on always doing one more round

本例条件：</strong>独立两种修改：A修正文档错别字；B改变并发扣库存。比.en: Conditions for this example: two independent changes: A fixes a typo in a document; B changes concurrent stock deduction. The verification each one needs is compared, rather than forcing every task through the same heavy process.

错误出现的可能性与后果。.en: How likely an error is, and what follows from it.

再加一步能发现哪些已有流程看不到的问题。.en: Which problems the existing process cannot see that one more step would reveal.

重复审查小问题却没有实质推进。.en: Reviewing small problems over and over without any real progress.

检查语义与diff.en: Check the semantics and the diff

完整架构重设计通常无收益.en: A complete architectural redesign usually pays nothing

只看格式和命名远远不够.en: Looking at format and naming is nowhere near enough

已发现小局部问题.en: A small local problem has been found

直接修复并重跑受影响测试.en: Fix it directly and re-run the affected tests

每次都重走分析—设计循环.en: Going round the analysis–design loop every time

存在根本需求冲突.en: There is a fundamental conflict of requirements

回到设计边界澄清.en: Back to clarifying the design boundary

不能把大问题当小修补过去.en: a large problem must not be patched over as a small one

适度审查不是少做测试，而是让验证强度与真实风险相匹配。.en: Proportionate review does not mean doing fewer tests; it means matching the strength of verification to the real risk.

独立Reviewer应有明确检查任务，例如寻找竞态反例，而不是再复述一次作者说明.en: An independent reviewer should have a definite checking task, such as looking for a race counterexample, rather than restating the author's explanation over again.

衡量Review的收益要看实际发现的缺陷、返工与时间，不以报告长度或轮数作为质量.en: Measure what a review gains by the defects actually found, the rework and the time; do not take the length of the report or the number of rounds as quality.

不要混淆：</strong>模型不确定时不断追加Reviewer，可能让相关错误.en: Do not conflate: piling on more reviewers when the model is uncertain can let correlated errors be reinforced by more text; supply real evidence or change the method of verification instead.

测Prompt的行为契约，不要把每个字节都当业务要求.en: Test the prompt's behavioral contract; do not treat every byte as a business requirement

快照看着没变不等于性质没坏：怎样让测试能杀死错误实现？.en: A snapshot that looks unchanged does not mean the property is intact: how can a test be made to kill a wrong implementation?

23｜Evaluation：怎样证明一次优化真有收益.en: 23｜Evaluation: how to prove an optimization really pays off

两个平均成功率之间的差值，不能告诉你哪些题退化。先看同题配对表：两边都成功、新版.en: The difference between two average success rates cannot tell you which questions regressed. Look first at the paired table over the same questions — both succeeded, only the new version won, only the old version won, both failed — and then at cost, variance and grader error.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F36.html\">涨了.en: Related step-by-step process: It went up ten points — so why can we not conclude anything yet?. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F35.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 05 · When reading a metric, first ask what its denominator isO12 · Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task

Task、Trial、Trace、Outcome分别计数，分母才不会乱.en: Count tasks, trials, traces and outcomes separately and the denominator stays straight

本例条件：</strong>独立评测：两个任务T1/T2，各运行3次。T1结果[.en: Conditions for this example: an independent evaluation: two tasks T1/T2, each run 3 times. T1 gives [success, success, failure] and T2 gives [failure, failure, success].

一份固定问题与验收条件。.en: A fixed set of questions and acceptance conditions.

对同一任务的一次独立尝试。.en: One independent attempt at the same task.

该次尝试的执行过程。.en: The execution process of that attempt.

按验收规则得到的结果。.en: The result obtained under the acceptance rule.

一次尝试层面的比例.en: A proportion at the level of a single attempt

至少成功一次的Task.en: Tasks with at least one success

允许3次挑成功，口径不同.en: Allowing 3 tries and taking the success is a different basis

每题全部成功.en: Every attempt on a question succeeds

稳定可靠性更严格.en: Consistent reliability is a stricter bar

三个百分比都能从同一记录得出，却回答不同问题。报告不写分母就可能把50%包装成1.en: All three percentages can be derived from the same record, yet they answer different questions. A report that leaves the denominator out can dress 50% up as 100%.

重复试验帮助估计同一任务的波动，但不等于新增更多独立任务；置信区间和抽样要考虑这.en: Repeated trials help estimate the variation within the same task, but they are not the same as adding more independent tasks; confidence intervals and sampling must allow for that clustering.

Trace用来解释为什么失败，Outcome用来汇总是否完成，不能只保留一个最终.en: A trace is there to explain why something failed and an outcome to summarize whether it finished; keeping only one final green light is not enough.

不要混淆：</strong>失败运行的费用、耗时不能从总成本里删掉，否则“每成功.en: Do not conflate: the cost and the time of failed runs cannot be dropped from the total, or "cost per successful task" is systematically understated.

pass@k类指标通常关心k次尝试至少一次成功；pass^k类指标强调多次全成功.en: pass@k-style metrics usually care about at least one success in k attempts; pass^k-style metrics stress succeeding every time. The exact basis of an estimate depends on the benchmark, and stopping after one success must not be conflated with being reliable every time.<span class="concept-micro">Under an independent, equal-probability assumption of p=0.8, at least one success in 3 attempts is 0.992 and all 3 succeeding is 0.512. If real tasks are correlated or differ in difficulty, it has to be computed differently.

通常分别指k次至少一次成功的估计与多次全成功等可靠性口径，具体按基准定义。 例：.en: These usually mean, respectively, an estimate of at least one success in k tries and reliability bases such as succeeding every time over several tries; the exact definition follows the benchmark. Example: with p=.8 and 3 independent tries, at least one success is .992 and success every time is .512.

C(n,k)、!：组合数量与阶乘.en: C(n,k), !: the number of combinations and the factorial

n!表示1到n整数连乘，0!=1；C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n-k)!)表示从.en: n! means the integers from 1 to n multiplied together, with 0!=1; C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n-k)!) is the number of ways to choose k of n distinct objects without replacement and without regard to order. It is not a model confidence C.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: C(4,2)=6. With n=10, c=3 and k=2, 1−C(7,2)/C(10,2)=24/45, about 0.533333.

pass@k与pass^k，一个看机会，一个看稳定.en: pass@k and pass^k: one looks at the chance, the other at the stability

本例条件：</strong>独立概率例：每次独立成功率p=0.8，k=3。独立同.en: Conditions for this example: an independent probability example: each independent attempt succeeds with p=0.8, and k=3. Independent and identically distributed is an assumption that a real task may not satisfy. n=5,c=2 is used separately to explain the pass@2 estimate without replacement.

k次里至少一次成功。.en: At least one success in k attempts.

k次全部成功的可靠性口径。.en: A reliability basis in which all k attempts succeed.

从已有n个样本挑k个的组合计数。.en: The number of combinations when choosing k out of n existing samples.

多试几次至少成功一次的机会会提高，但全部成功的要求更严格。它们不互相矛盾。.en: More attempts raise the chance of succeeding at least once, but requiring every attempt to succeed is a stricter demand. The two do not contradict each other.

若用户只能承担一次生产执行，应优先关注单次成功与副作用安全，而不是允许挑最好结果.en: If the user can only afford one production run, what matters first is success on that single run and the safety of its side effects, not a score obtained by picking the best of several results.

样本估计使用组合数时，不能把c/n直接代入独立公式并宣称与无放回估计完全相同。.en: When a sample estimate uses combinations, c/n cannot be substituted into the independent formula and then declared exactly the same as the estimate without replacement.
